G. Proposed Calculation of the ASC Payment Rates and the ASC Conversion Factor
In the August 2, 2007 ASC final rule (72 FR 42493), we established our policy to base ASC relative payment weights and payment rates under the revised ASC payment system on APC groups and the OPPS relative payment weights. Consistent with that policy, and the requirement at section 1833(i)(2)(D)(ii) of the Act that the revised payment system be implemented so that it would be budget neutral, the initial ASC conversion factor (CY 2008) was calculated so that estimated total Medicare payments under the revised ASC payment system in the first year would be budget neutral to estimated total Medicare payments under the prior (CY 2007) ASC payment system (the ASC conversion factor is multiplied by the relative payment weights calculated for many ASC services in order to establish payment rates). That is, application of the ASC conversion factor was designed to result in aggregate Medicare expenditures under the revised ASC payment system in CY 2008 being equal to aggregate Medicare expenditures that would have occurred in CY 2008 in the absence of the revised system, taking into consideration the cap on ASC payments in CY 2007, as required under section 1833(i)(2)(E) of the Act (72 FR 42522). We adopted a policy to make the system budget neutral in subsequent calendar years (72 FR 42532 through 42533; § 416.171(e)).
In the CY 2008 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (72 FR 66857 through 66858), we set out a step-by-step illustration of the final budget neutrality adjustment calculation based on the methodology finalized in the August 2, 2007 ASC final rule (72 FR 42521 through 42531) and as applied to updated data available for the CY 2008 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period. The application of that methodology to the data available for the CY 2008 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period resulted in a budget neutrality adjustment of 0.65.
For CY 2008, we adopted the OPPS relative payment weights as the ASC relative payment weights for most services and, consistent with the final policy, we calculated the CY 2008 ASC payment rates by multiplying the ASC relative payment weights by the final CY 2008 ASC conversion factor of $41.401. For covered office-based surgical procedures, covered ancillary radiology services (excluding covered ancillary radiology services involving certain nuclear medicine procedures or involving the use of contrast agents, as discussed in section XIII.D.2. of the CY 2023 OPPS/ASC proposed rule (87 FR 44715 through 44716)), and certain diagnostic tests within the medicine range that are covered ancillary services, the established policy is to set the payment rate at the lower of the PFS unadjusted nonfacility PE RVU-based amount or the amount calculated using the ASC standard ratesetting methodology. Further, as discussed in the CY 2008 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (72 FR 66841 through 66843), we also adopted alternative ratesetting methodologies for specific types of services (for example, device-intensive procedures).
As discussed in the August 2, 2007 ASC final rule (72 FR 42517 through 42518) and as codified at § 416.172(c) of the regulations, the revised ASC payment system accounts for geographic wage variation when calculating individual ASC payments by applying the pre-floor and pre-reclassified IPPS hospital wage indexes to the labor-related share, which is 50 percent of the ASC payment amount based on a GAO report of ASC costs using 2004 survey data. Beginning in CY 2008, CMS accounted for geographic wage variation in labor costs when calculating individual ASC payments by applying the pre-floor and pre-reclassified hospital wage index values that CMS calculates for payment under the IPPS, using updated Core Based Statistical Areas (CBSAs) issued by OMB in June 2003.
The reclassification provision in section 1886(d)(10) of the Act is specific to acute care hospitals. We believe that using the most recently available pre-floor and pre-reclassified IPPS hospital wage indexes result in the most appropriate adjustment to the labor portion of ASC costs. We continue to believe that the pre-floor, pre-reclassified hospital wage indexes, which are updated yearly and are used by several other Medicare payment systems, appropriately account for geographic variation in labor costs for ( printed page 70675) ASCs (89 FR 23424). -Therefore, the wage index for an ASC is the pre-floor and pre-reclassified hospital wage index for the fiscal year under the IPPS of the CBSA that maps to the CBSA where the ASC is located.
On July 21, 2023, OMB issued OMB Bulletin No. 23-01, which provided the delineations of all Metropolitan Statistical Areas, Metropolitan Divisions, Micropolitan Statistical Areas, Combined Statistical Areas, and New England City and Town Areas in the U.S. and Puerto Rico based on the standards published on July 16, 2021, in the Federal Register (86 FR 37770) and 2020 Census Bureau data. (A copy of this bulletin may be obtained at https://www.whitehouse.gov/​wp-content/​uploads/​2023/​07/​OMB-Bulletin-23-01.pdf.) As discussed in the FY 2025 IPPS/LTCH PPS final rule with comment period (89 FR 69253 through 69266), we finalized our proposal to use the new CBSAs delineations issued by OMB in OMB Bulletin No. 23-01 for the IPPS hospital wage index beginning in CY 2025. Therefore, because the ASC wage indexes for the calendar year are the pre-floor and pre-reclassified IPPS hospital wage indexes for the fiscal year, in the CY 2025 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (89 FR 94362 through 94363) we finalized our proposal to include the new OMB delineations into CY 2025 ASC wage indexes. We believe that using the revised delineations based on OMB Bulletin No. 23-01 will increase the integrity of the ASC wage index system by creating a more accurate representation of current geographic variations in wage levels. In addition to adopting the revised delineations based on OMB Bulletin No. 23-01, we also finalized our proposal to limit year-to-year ASC wage index value changes to no more than a 5-percent decrease, similar to the policy of other Medicare payment systems under Parts A and B. This 5-percent cap, implemented in a budget neutral manner through the wage index scalar, mitigates any large negative impacts of adopting the new delineations and prevents large year-to-year declines in wage index values as a means to reduce volatility in Medicare payments.
The proposed CY 2027 ASC wage indexes reflect the OMB labor market area delineations (including the revisions to the OMB labor market delineations discussed previously, as set forth in OMB Bulletin No. 23-01). We note that, in certain instances, there might be urban or rural areas for which there is no IPPS hospital that has wage index data that could be used to set the wage index for that area. When all of the areas contiguous to the CBSA of interest are rural and there is no IPPS hospital that has wage index data that could be used to set the wage index for that area, our policy has been to determine the ASC wage index by calculating the average of all wage indexes for urban areas in the State (75 FR 72058 through 72059). For CY 2026, we applied this methodology to ASCs located in CBSA 35 (Rural North Dakota) (90 FR 53911). For CY 2027, we proposed to continue to apply a proxy wage index based on this methodology to ASCs located in CBSA 35 (Rural North Dakota). In other situations, where there are no IPPS hospitals located in a relevant labor market area, we apply our current policy of calculating an urban or rural area's wage index by calculating the average of the wage indexes for CBSAs (or metropolitan divisions where applicable) that are contiguous to the area with no wage index. For CY 2027, we proposed that we continue to apply a proxy wage index based on this methodology to ASCs located in CBSA 25980 (Hinesville, GA). Further, the proposed CY 2027 ASC wage index includes our policy finalized in the CY 2025 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period that limits wage index changes to decrease by no more than 5 percent from the final CY 2026 ASC wage index value. As we discussed in the April 2025 Update to the Ambulatory Surgical Center Payment System (Change Request 14017), to limit wage index changes by no more than 5 percent from the final CY 2026 ASC wage index, some counties may require a transition CBSA before being fully reflected in the OMB labor market delineations as set forth in OMB Bulletin No. 23-01.
We received one public comment on our proposal. The following is a summary of the comment we received and our response.
Comment: A commenter supported policies to mitigate the effects of inadequate wage indices on rural ASCs and requested greater alignment between the ASC and OPPS wage-index methodologies. The commenter stated that, unlike hospitals, ASCs cannot obtain geographic reclassification to another labor market area and do not receive the frontier-state wage-index floor of 1.0. As an example, the commenter noted that the projected CY 2027 rural wage index applicable to ASCs in South Dakota is 0.7979, while hospitals in the State receive a wage index of at least 1.0 under the frontier-state floor. The commenter requested that CMS extend hospital geographic-reclassification and frontier-state wage-index-floor policies to ASCs.
Response: We appreciate the concerns the commenter has raised. The reclassification provision in section 1883(d)(10) of the Act is specific to acute care hospitals. The reclassification provision does not apply to an area but reflects the circumstances of the reclassified hospital and its own reported wages. Therefore, complete alignment between ASC and OPPS wage index methodologies is not currently possible. While we believe that using the most recently available pre-floor and pre-reclassified IPPS hospital wage indexes results in the most appropriate adjustment to the labor portion of ASC costs, we will continue to monitor wage index differences between the OPPS and ASC payment systems and may take the commenter's recommendation into consideration in future rulemaking.
After consideration of public comments we received, we are finalizing our proposal to use the most recently available pre-floor and pre-reclassified IPPS hospital wage indexes to the labor-related share to create the final CY 2027 ASC wage indexes and to limit wage index decreases by no more than 5 percent from the final CY 2026 ASC wage index for a particular CBSA. The final CY 2027 ASC wage indexes reflect the OMB labor market area delineations (including the revisions to the OMB labor market delineations discussed previously, as set forth in OMB Bulletin No. 23-01) unless the county is otherwise in a transition CBSA. Additionally, based on the absence of IPPS hospitals, we are also finalizing our proposal to apply a proxy wage index based to ASCs located in CBSA 25980 (Hinesville, GA) and in CBSA 35 (Rural North Dakota).
2. Calculation of the ASC Payment Rates
a. Updating the ASC Relative Payment Weights for CY 2027 and Future Years
We update the ASC relative payment weights each year using the national OPPS relative payment weights (and PFS nonfacility PE RVU-based amounts, as applicable) for that same calendar year and uniformly scale the ASC relative payment weights for each update year to make them budget neutral (72 FR 42533). The OPPS relative payment weights are scaled to maintain budget neutrality for the OPPS. We then scale the OPPS relative payment weights again to establish the ASC relative payment weights. To accomplish this, we hold estimated total ASC payment levels constant between calendar years for purposes of maintaining budget neutrality in the ASC payment system. That is, we apply the weight scalar to ensure that ( printed page 70676) projected expenditures from the updated ASC payment weights in the ASC payment system are equal to what would be the current expenditures based on the scaled ASC payment weights. In this way, we ensure budget neutrality and that the only changes to total payments to ASCs result from increases or decreases in the ASC payment update factor.
As discussed in section II.A.1.a. of this final rule with comment period, we are using the CY 2025 claims data to be consistent with the OPPS claims data for this final rule with comment period. Consistent with our established policy, we proposed to scale the CY 2027 relative payment weights for ASCs according to the following method. Holding ASC utilization, the ASC conversion factor, and the mix of services constant from CY 2025, we proposed to compare the estimated total payment using the CY 2026 ASC relative payment weights with the estimated total payment using the CY 2027 ASC relative payment weights to take into account the changes in the OPPS relative payment weights between CY 2026 and CY 2027.
In consideration of our policy to provide a higher ASC payment rate with ASC complexity adjustment codes for certain primary procedures when performed with add-on packaged services, we included estimated total spending and estimated utilization for these codes in our budget neutrality calculation for CYs 2023 and 2024. For this final rule with comment period, our proposed ASC complexity adjustment codes for CY 2027 did not impact the ASC weight scalar.
Additionally, as discussed in section XIII.E. of the CY 2025 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (89 FR 94342 through 94361), section 4135(a) and (b) of the CAA, 2023, titled “Access to Non-Opioid Treatments for Pain Relief”, amended sections 1833(t)(16) and 1833(i) of the Act, respectively, to provide for temporary separate payments for non-opioid treatments for pain relief. As discussed in further detail in section XIII.E. of the CY 2025 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period, for qualifying non-opioid products, we finalized applying an 18 percent payment limitation on the volume-weighted payment average of the top 5 services associated with the use of the qualifying non-opioid product. In CY 2024, four of these qualifying nonopioid products were separately payable without the 18 percent payment limitation—HCPCS Codes C9089 (Bupivacaine implant, 1 mg), J0666 (Inj, bupivacaine liposome), J1096 (Dexametha opth insert 0.1 mg), and J1097 (Phenylep ketorolac opth soln). Therefore, to maintain budget neutrality, we estimated the total anticipated reduction in ASC spending for these qualifying non-opioid products for CY 2025 as a result of the 18 percent payment limitation required by section 4135 of the CAA, 2023. Based on the updated 18 percent payment limitations and CY 2025 utilization, we estimate that the proposed CY 2027 payment limitations will not impact the ASC weight scalar.
We proposed to use the ratio of estimated CY 2026 to estimated CY 2027 total payments (the weight scalar) to scale the proposed ASC relative payment weights for CY 2027. The proposed CY 2027 ASC weight scalar was 0.809. Consistent with historical practice, we proposed to scale, using this method (with an ASC weight scalar rounded to the nearest thousandth), the ASC relative payment weights of covered surgical procedures, covered ancillary radiology services, and certain diagnostic tests within the medicine range of CPT codes, which are covered ancillary services for which the ASC payment rates are based on OPPS relative payment weights.
We proposed that we would not scale ASC payment for separately payable covered ancillary services that have a predetermined national payment amount (that is, their national ASC payment amounts are not based on OPPS relative payment weights), such as drugs and biologicals that are separately paid or services that are contractor-priced or paid at reasonable cost in ASCs. Any service with a predetermined national payment amount, would be included in the ASC budget neutrality comparison, but scaling of the ASC relative payment weights would not apply to those services or the portion of those services. The ASC payment weights for those services without predetermined national payment amounts would be scaled to eliminate any difference in the total payment between the current year and the update year.
Historically, the device portions of device-intensive procedures were not scaled so that payment for device portions would remain constant between the OPPS and ASC payment systems. However, due to increased utilization of orthopedic procedures in the ASC setting, ASC expenditures on device portions of device-intensive procedures represent a substantially larger share of total ASC expenditures than in prior years. We estimate that spending attributable to device portions increased from approximately 5.4 percent of total ASC expenditures in CY 2016 to roughly 32.4 percent of total ASC expenditures in 2026. As device expenditures account for an increasingly significant share of total ASC spending, large year-to-year increases in the estimated device portions of surgical procedures require correspondingly larger reductions to the non-device portions of surgical procedures and certain ancillary services to maintain budget neutrality.
The change in the proposed ASC weight scalar for CY 2027 illustrates this effect. Specifically, the ASC weight scalar would decrease from 0.872 in CY 2026 to a proposed 0.809 in CY 2027. This reduction is largely attributable to the substantial increase in expenditures for device portions of device-intensive procedures under the ASC payment system. In turn, this increase in device portions results from the proposed budget-neutral increase in OPPS payment rates for surgical procedures that would offset the drug payment reductions associated with our proposed payment policy for 340B acquired drugs as a result of the OPPS Drug Acquisition Cost Survey.
As the ASC payment system uses the OPPS conversion factor to determine payment for the device portions of device-intensive procedures, this alters the payment relativity between services under the OPPS because the entire portion of ASC payment rates for non-device-intensive procedures is based on the lower ASC conversion factor. Because of the proposed large increase in the device portions for device-intensive procedures in CY 2027 as a result of the proposed 340B drug payment policy, we solicited comment on whether the device portions of device-intensive procedures calculated using the OPPS conversion factor should continue to be excluded from the ASC weight scaler, or alternatively, whether these device portions should be subject to scaling through the ASC weight scaler. We estimated that treating device expenditures for device-intensive procedures as scalable prospective expenditures would increase the proposed ASC weight scaler from 0.809 to 0.865 in CY 2027 and would reduce the device portions of device intensive procedures by approximately 14 percent.
For any given year's ratesetting, we typically use the most recent full calendar year of claims data to model budget neutrality adjustments. We proposed to use the CY 2025 claims data to model our budget neutrality adjustment for CY 2027.
We received public comments on our proposal. The following is a summary of ( printed page 70677) the comments we received and our responses.
Comment: Commenters opposed the proposed CY 2027 ASC weight scalar of 0.809, stating that the secondary scaling adjustment unnecessarily reduces ASC payments, widens the disparity with HOPD payments, and discourages migration to lower-cost ASCs. Many commenters urged CMS to eliminate the ASC weight scalar because continued annual application is not statutorily required, or alternatively to establish a single budget-neutrality calculation using combined OPPS and ASC utilization and service mix. Some commenters supported CMS's alternative of including device portions of device-intensive procedures in scalable expenditures, which would increase the scalar to approximately 0.865 and mitigate reductions for non-device-intensive services, although some recommended phasing in or partially applying this approach. Other commenters opposed scaling device portions because device acquisition costs are fixed and warned that the resulting approximately 14-percent reduction could impair access to device-intensive procedures. These commenters recommended maintaining the device-payment exclusion and instead removing the 340B-related OPPS conversion-factor increase from the ASC ratesetting and scalar calculations so that a hospital drug-payment policy does not distort ASC payment rates.
Response: We appreciate the public comments we received on our proposed ASC weight scalar for CY 2027 and our comment solicitation on whether the device portions of device-intensive procedures calculated using the OPPS conversion factor should continue to be excluded from the ASC weight scalar, or alternatively, whether these device portions should be included in the expenditures subject to scaling through the ASC weight scalar. We agree with commenters that our budget neutrality adjustment places the budget neutrality burden on non-device portions of surgical procedures subject to the ASC weight scalar; however, we remain concerned with both the potential payment reduction and payment asymmetry between the OPPS and ASC payment systems from applying the ASC weight scalar to the device portions of device-intensive procedures. We believe that applying the ASC weight scalar to device portions of device-intensive procedures would significantly reduce the ASC payment rate for such procedures and could potentially reduce future access to device-intensive procedures in the ASC setting which are predominantly performed in the hospital outpatient setting. For these reasons, we are not revising our methodology to include device portions as subject to scaling through the ASC weight scalar. We also considered the commenters' recommendation to use an OPPS conversion factor that excludes the 340B-related OPPS budget neutrality adjustment. Unfortunately, this approach would introduce the same payment asymmetry between the OPPS and ASC payment systems for device portions of device-intensive procedures as applying the ASC weight scalar to device portions as well as continuing the budget neutrality burden placed on non-device portions. For these reasons, we did not believe adopting an alternative OPPS conversion factor was appropriate. Therefore, for CY 2027, we are finalizing our proposal to continue our longstanding policy of using the ratio of total payments based on the CY 2026 relative payment weights to total payments based on the CY 2027 relative payment weights to scale the ASC relative payment weights, while continuing to exclude the device portions of device-intensive procedures from expenditures subject to scaling. We will continue to explore alternative methodologies that maintain budget neutrality under the ASC payment system—which preserves the Part B trust fund and reduces beneficiary cost-sharing—while advancing payment policies that expand access to site-neutral options for beneficiaries.
Comment: Commenters opposed proposed CY 2027 ASC payment reductions for ophthalmic, interventional pain, and dialysis vascular-access procedures. Commenters stated that the reductions would occur despite the overall ASC payment update and, in some cases, while corresponding HOPD payments would increase. They stated that the reduced payments do not adequately reflect the costs of the staff, supplies, devices, imaging, equipment, and other resources required to furnish these services, particularly in independent and rural ASCs. Commenters expressed concern that continued reductions could limit access, encourage consolidation, delay time-sensitive care, or shift services to more costly HOPDs or other less desirable treatment alternatives.
With respect to ophthalmic services, commenters opposed reductions for cataract, glaucoma, retinal, and other procedures, including vitreoretinal procedures described by CPT codes 67036, 67041 through 67043, 67108, 67110, 67113, 67210, 67227, and 67228. Commenters requested that CMS verify that the claims data capture all associated device, supply, and equipment costs; consider HOP Panel review and site-of-service substitution; publish relevant claims-volume and trimming information; and provide procedure-specific explanations for any reductions that are finalized. Commenters also requested that CMS reverse or reassess reductions for interventional pain procedures described by CPT codes 62321, 62323, 64479, 64483, 64490, 64493, 64633, and 64635 and evaluate the cumulative effects of successive payment reductions on beneficiary access. Finally, commenters opposed the effect of the reduced ASC weight scalar on dialysis vascular-access services, particularly non-device-intensive procedures such as CPT code 36902 and supported including device expenditures in the weight-scalar calculation. Commenters generally requested that CMS adopt payment methodologies that more accurately recognize ASC resource costs, stabilize or increase payment for these services, and preserve access to care in lower-cost non-hospital settings.
Response: We appreciate the comments regarding our proposed CY 2027 ASC payment rates for the procedures identified by the commenters and understand the concerns raised regarding the potential effects of payment reductions on beneficiary access. ASCs currently do not submit cost reports, so the absence of these data limits our ability to independently assess whether our proposed rates adequately reflect the costs of the staff, supplies, devices, imaging, equipment, and other resources. Additionally, the HOP Panel advises on OPPS matters and the ASC budget neutrality calculation is outside the scope of its charter. We did not revise claims trimming or the underlying ratesetting methodology involved—the payment rate reductions for these procedures are driven by the ASC budget neutrality adjustment providing a corresponding decrease in total nondevice portion expenditures in response to the increase in OPPS device portion expenditures adopted under the ASC payment system.
For the reasons previously described with respect to our budget neutrality methodology, we are finalizing our longstanding budget neutrality calculation because of concerns about underpayment of the significant device costs associated with device-intensive procedures and the importance of preserving beneficiary access to device-intensive procedures in the ASC setting. We intend to continue monitoring beneficiary access to non-device- ( printed page 70678) intensive procedures in the ASC setting and may consider future payment policies to address this issue.
After consideration of the public comments we received, we are finalizing our proposal to use scaled OPPS relative weights to establish ASC relative payment weights and to use the ratio of CY 2026 to CY 2027 total payments (the weight scalar) to ASC relative payment weights for CY 2027. We are also finalizing our proposal to continue using the OPPS conversion factor, which we are finalizing as $99.970 for CY 2027 in this final rule with comment period, to continue maintaining device portions between the OPPS and ASC payment systems for device-intensive surgical procedures. While we understand the concerns raised by interested parties regarding the payment reductions for non device-intensive procedures for CY 2027, we currently are not adopting an alternative methodology and are maintaining our longstanding calculation of budget neutrality under the ASC payment system and holding device portions constant between the OPPS and ASC payment systems for device-intensive procedures. We will continue to explore alternative methodologies to address concerns with the payment rates for non-device intensive procedures under the ASC payment system while providing budget neutrality under the ASC payment system for future rulemaking. The final CY 2027 ASC weight scalar is 0.814. Consistent with historical practice, we are finalizing our proposal to scale the ASC relative payment weights of covered surgical procedures, covered ancillary radiology services, and certain diagnostic tests within the medicine range of CPT codes, which are covered ancillary services for which the ASC payment rates are based on OPPS relative payment weights.
b. Updating the ASC Conversion Factor
Under the OPPS, we typically apply a budget neutrality adjustment for provider-level changes, most notably a change in the wage index values for the upcoming year, to the conversion factor. Consistent with our final ASC payment policy, for the CY 2017 ASC payment system and subsequent years, in the CY 2017 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (81 FR 79751 through 79753), we finalized our policy to calculate and apply a budget neutrality adjustment to the ASC conversion factor for supplier-level changes in wage index values for the upcoming year, just as the OPPS wage index budget neutrality adjustment is calculated and applied to the OPPS conversion factor.
For CY 2027, we calculated the proposed adjustment for the ASC payment system by using the most recent CY 2025 claims data available and estimating the difference in total payment that would be created by introducing the proposed CY 2027 ASC wage indexes. Specifically, holding CY 2025 ASC utilization, service-mix, and the proposed CY 2027 national payment rates after application of the weight scalar constant, we calculated the total adjusted payment using the CY 2026 ASC wage indexes and the total adjusted payment using the proposed CY 2027 ASC wage indexes which included the 5-percent cap on wage index decreases for an ASC. We used the 50 percent labor-related share for both total adjusted payment calculations. We then compared the total adjusted payment calculated with the CY 2026 ASC wage indexes to the total adjusted payment calculated with the proposed CY 2027 ASC wage indexes and applied the resulting ratio of 1.0016 (the proposed CY 2027 ASC wage index budget neutrality adjustment) to the CY 2026 ASC conversion factor to calculate the proposed CY 2027 ASC conversion factor.
Section 1833(i)(2)(D)(v) of the Act requires that the ASC conversion factor be reduced by a productivity adjustment in each calendar year. Section 1886(b)(3)(B)(xi)(II) of the Act defines the productivity adjustment to be equal to the 10-year moving average of changes in annual economy-wide private nonfarm business multifactor productivity (MFP). We finalized the methodology for calculating the productivity adjustment in the CY 2011 PFS final rule with comment period (75 FR 73394 through 73396) and revised it in the CY 2012 PFS final rule with comment period (76 FR 73300 through 73301) and the CY 2016 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (80 FR 70500 through 70501). The proposed productivity adjustment for CY 2027 was projected to be 0.8 percentage point, as published in the FY 2027 IPPS/LTCH PPS proposed rule (91 FR 19496) based on IGI's 2025 fourth quarter forecast.
Section 1833(i)(2)(C)(i) of the Act requires that, if the Secretary has not updated amounts established under the revised ASC payment system in a calendar year, the payment amounts shall be increased by the percentage increase in the Consumer Price Index for all urban consumers (CPI-U), U.S. city average, as estimated by the Secretary for the 12-month period ending with the midpoint of the year involved. The statute does not mandate the adoption of any particular update mechanism, but it requires the payment amounts to be increased by the CPI-U in the absence of any update. Because the Secretary updates the ASC payment amounts annually, we adopted a policy, which we codified at § 416.171(a)(2)(ii)), to update the ASC conversion factor using the CPI-U for CY 2010 and subsequent calendar years.
In the CY 2019 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (83 FR 59075 through 59080), we finalized a policy to apply the hospital market basket update (which is the inpatient hospital market basket percentage increase reduced by the productivity adjustment) to ASC payment system rates for an interim period of 5 years (CY 2019 through CY 2023), during which we would assess whether there was a migration of the performance of procedures from the hospital setting to the ASC setting as a result of the use of a hospital market basket update, as well as whether there were any unintended consequences, such as less than expected migration of the performance of procedures from the hospital setting to the ASC setting. At that time, the most recently available full year of claims data to assess the expected migration applying the productivity-adjusted hospital market basket update during the interim period was within the period from CY 2019 through CY 2022. However, the impact of the COVID-19 PHE on health care utilization, CY 2020 in particular, was tremendously profound, particularly for elective surgeries, because many beneficiaries avoided healthcare settings, when possible, to avoid possible infection from the SARS-CoV-2 virus. As a result, it was nearly impossible to disentangle the effects from the COVID-19 PHE in our analysis of whether the higher update factor for the ASC payment system caused increased migration to the ASC setting. To analyze whether procedures migrated from the hospital setting to the ASC setting, we needed to use claims data from a period during which the COVID-19 PHE had less of an impact on health care utilization. Therefore, for CY 2024, we finalized our proposal to extend the 5-year interim period an additional 2 years through CY 2024 and CY 2025 which we subsequently extended through CY 2026 in the CY 2026 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (90 FR 53914 through 53915). We believed hospital outpatient and ASC utilization data from CYs 2023 through 2025 would enable us to more accurately analyze whether the application of the hospital market basket update to the ASC payment ( printed page 70679) system had an effect on the migration of services from the hospital setting to the ASC setting. We revised our regulations at § 416.171(a)(2)(iii), (iv), (vi), (vii), and (viii) which establish the annual update to the ASC conversion factor, to reflect these extensions.
For the CY 2027 OPPS/ASC proposed rule, we proposed to extend our utilization of the hospital market basket update factor in the ASC payment system for one additional year, through CY 2027, as we continue to review and evaluate hospital outpatient and ASC utilization data, as well as the migration of surgical procedures between settings. In conjunction with our proposal, we proposed revising our regulations at § 416.171(a)(2)(iii), (iv), (vi), (vii), and (viii), which establish the annual update to the ASC conversion factor, the 2.0 percentage point reduction for ASCs that fail to meet the standards for reporting ASC quality measures, and the productivity adjustment, to reflect this one-year extension.
We received public comments on this proposal. The following is a summary of the comments we received and our responses.
Comment: Most commenters supported CMS's proposal to extend use of the productivity-adjusted hospital market basket, rather than the CPI-U, as the ASC payment update factor through CY 2027. Commenters stated that the hospital market basket better reflects ASC cost growth because ASCs purchase similar supplies, equipment, devices, and implants as HOPDs and compete for the same clinical workforce. They also stated that aligning the ASC and OPPS update factors supports migration to lower-cost ASCs, reduces payment disparities, and generates Medicare and beneficiary savings, and many commenters urged CMS to make the hospital market basket update policy permanent rather than extending it for one year. Other commenters opposed the extension, stating that hospitals and ASCs have different cost structures and patient populations and that the hospital market basket does not accurately measure ASC input costs. These commenters recommended that CMS collect minimally burdensome ASC cost data and develop an ASC-specific market basket, while some supporters stated that any new index should apply consistently to both ASCs and HOPDs to preserve alignment between the payment systems.
Response: We appreciate the feedback from commenters. We did not propose to collect ASC-specific cost data in our CY 2027 OPPS/ASC proposed rule. ASCs currently do not submit cost reports, so we are unable to discern if there is a meaningful difference in the cost structures between the hospital and ASC setting and if such differences would necessitate a different update factor. We agree with commenters that providing the same annual update mechanism under the OPPS and ASC payment systems can support the migration of services to the lower-cost ASC setting. We are finalizing our proposal to apply the productivity-adjusted hospital market basket update to the ASC payment system for CY 2027.
2. CY 2027 Final ASC Conversion Factor
For CY 2027, we finalized our proposal to utilize the final inpatient hospital market basket percentage increase of 3.2 percent reduced by the productivity adjustment of 0.9 percentage point, resulting in a final hospital market basket update of 2.3 percent for ASCs meeting the quality reporting requirements. Therefore, we are finalizing our proposal to apply a 2.3 percent hospital market basket update factor to the CY 2026 ASC conversion factor for ASCs meeting the quality reporting requirements to determine the CY 2027 ASC payment amounts. The ASCQR Program affected payment rates beginning in CY 2014 and, under this program, there is a 2.0 percentage point reduction to the hospital market basket update factor for ASCs that fail to meet the ASCQR Program requirements. We refer readers to section XIV.E. of the CY 2019 OPPS/ASC final rule with comment period (83 FR 59138 through 59139) and section XIV.E. of this final rule with comment period for a detailed discussion of our policies regarding payment reduction for ASCs that fail to meet ASCQR Program requirements.
For CY 2027, we are adjusting the CY 2026 ASC conversion factor ($56.322) by a wage index budget neutrality factor of 1.0018 in addition to the productivity-adjusted hospital market basket update of 2.3 percent, discussed previously, which results in a final CY 2027 ASC conversion factor of $57.721 for ASCs

content:
Tanzania Opposition Leader Lissu Cleared of Treason but Jailed for Incitement - allAfrica.com
Tanzania Opposition Leader Lissu Cleared of Treason but Jailed for Incitement
Tanzanian opposition leader Tundu Lissu.
A Tanzanian court on Friday sentenced opposition leader Tundu Lissu to four years in jail for inciting unrest, after earlier in the day clearing him of treason - meaning he avoided a possible death sentence. The verdict follows a disputed presidential election and a deadly crackdown on protesters, in a case that has drawn international condemnation and raised concerns about political freedom in the country.
A panel of three judges at the High Court in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania's commercial capital, convicted the 58-year-old leader of the country's main opposition party, Chadema, over remarks he made calling for electoral reforms.
"We are satisfied that through his statements, the accused intended to disrupt elections and instigate violence," a judge told a courtroom packed with supporters, French news agency AFP reported.
Keep up with the latest headlines on WhatsApp | LinkedIn
Lissu has been detained since April 2025. He has denied any wrongdoing, arguing that his campaign was lawful and the charges against him politically motivated.
Facing heavy security, Tanzania protesters fear repeat of election violence
His arrest came six months before the October 2025 vote, shortly after he launched a drive for changes to Tanzania's electoral system under the slogan "No Reforms, No Election".
Prosecutors argued that his statements were intended to disrupt the vote and threaten the government, amounting to treason.
Lissu, a lawyer who represented himself during the trial, maintained that his comments had been taken out of context and that he had committed no crime.
"My hope is that you will carry that heavy historical burden without bias, with courage and with the dignity carried by your judicial oaths," he told the panel in his closing arguments.
Tanzania's Hassan makes historic Russia visit amid frayed ties with West
The trial drew criticism from British and European Union lawmakers, who described it as politically driven and called for Lissu's immediate release.
"The use of capital punishment against a political opponent risks turning the justice system into an instrument of political repression," they wrote in a letter to President Samia Suluhu Hassan.
Security was tightened across Dar es Salaam and around the courthouse ahead of Friday's verdict, as Lissu's supporters gathered for the hearing.
Groups were mobilising to travel to the city, police said on Wednesday, warning against "those who want to stage a coup".

Lissu's arrest, Chadema's disqualification and alleged abductions of government critics helped fuel protests during last year's presidential election.
Hassan won with 98 percent of the vote after her two main challengers, including Lissu, were excluded. The opposition dismissed the result as a "mockery" of democracy.
A government-appointed commission put the death toll at at least 518, blaming protesters for the violence. Opposition groups and human rights organisations say the authorities killed thousands.
Accusations that security forces used excessive force have been rejected by the government. The election was fair and transparent, Hassan has insisted, blaming foreigners for the unrest.

zh_title: 澳门谴责外国对国家安全审判的批评
summary: 澳门猛烈抨击外国对国家安全审判的批评中国劳工公告牌星期日，2026 年 11 月 8 日·香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 澳门猛烈抨击外国对国家安全审判的批评 澳门政府和立法机构谴责欧盟、美国和联合国机构批评该市首个国家安全案件审判，称其为内政并拒绝干涉。澳门政府和立法机关强烈谴责欧盟对外行动署、美国国会及行政当局委员会的“不实言论”。
content:
澳门猛烈抨击外国对国家安全审判的批评中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
澳门谴责外国对国家安全审判的批评
澳门政府和立法机关谴责欧盟、美国和联合国机构批评该市首例国家安全案件审判，称其为内政并拒绝干涉。
澳门政府和立法机关强烈谴责欧盟对外行动署、美国国会及行政当局中国问题委员会、联合国人权办公室和欧洲议会个别议员就澳门首例国家安全案件审判所发表的“不真实言论”。
澳门政府在一份声明中表示，被告欧锦山是中国公民，法院对他的案件的处理——他被判危害国家安全罪——纯粹是澳门特别行政区的内部事务。政府表示，法院严格按照法律规定和事实证据作出判决和量刑，驳斥所谓的无理干涉和无端指责。任何组织和个人不得以“人权”、“自由”为幌子，从事危害国家安全的非法活动。
香港立法机关还发表声明称，审判过程充分保障了欧金山作为嫌疑人的程序权利。声明称，任何针对澳门司法机构合法审判的攻击或施压，都是严重违反法治的行为。立法机关呼吁外界尊重判决，坚决反对一切无端批评、诽谤和干预澳门司法程序的行为。
该案是澳门国家安全法颁布以来首例国家安全案件。政府敦促外部势力停止作出毫无根据的指控，并尊重澳门的法律制度。

Macau slams foreign criticism over national security trial | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Macau slams foreign criticism over national security trial
Macau government and legislature condemned EU, US and UN bodies for criticising the city's first national security case trial, calling it internal affairs and rejecting interference.
Macau’s government and legislature have strongly condemned what they described as “untrue statements” by the European Union’s External Action Service, the US Congressional-Executive Commission on China, the United Nations human rights office and individual European Parliament members over the city’s first national security case trial.
The Macau government said in a statement that the defendant, Ou Kam San, is a Chinese citizen, and the court’s handling of his case – in which he was convicted of endangering national security – is purely an internal affair of the Macau Special Administrative Region. The court made its verdict and sentencing strictly in accordance with legal provisions and factual evidence, the government said, rejecting what it called unwarranted interference and groundless accusations. It added that no organisation or individual may use “human rights” or “freedom” as a shield to engage in illegal activities that harm national security.
The territory’s legislature also issued a statement saying the trial process fully protected Ou Kam San’s procedural rights as a suspect. It said any attack on or pressure against Macau’s judiciary for carrying out a lawful trial represents a serious violation of the rule of law. The legislature called on outside parties to respect the verdict and firmly opposed all unfounded criticism, slander and intervention in Macau’s judicial process.
The case is the first national security trial since Macau’s national security law was enacted. The government urged external forces to stop making what it called baseless accusations and to respect Macau’s legal system.

title: Beijing Has Little Reason to Welcome America’s Midterm Results
zh_title: 北京没有理由欢迎美国的中期选举结果
summary: 北京没有理由欢迎美国的中期选举结果——《外交官》台北选民20多年来没有选择独立或统一，孟加拉国的唯一不变是政治暴力朝鲜在俄罗斯-乌克兰战争中的表现中国的同伴经济：花钱请人跟我玩印度是在扩大对克什米尔伊斯兰教活动的控制吗？新法律最终会结束亚洲工厂的侵犯人权行为吗？危机中湄公河伊洛瓦底江海豚的谨慎希望 英伟达在哈萨克斯坦巴基斯坦合资企业的承诺和陷阱
content:
北京没有理由欢迎美国的中期选举结果——《外交官》

巴基斯坦的人工智能战争
2026 年美国中期选举：对澳大利亚的影响
当选民主党参议员詹姆斯·塔拉里科 (James Talarico) 在 2026 年 11 月 3 日选举日向支持者挥手致意。他是 1988 年以来首位当选德克萨斯州参议员的民主党人。
总的来说，北京没有理由庆祝美国中期选举结果。民主党接管国会使中国的战略考量变得更加复杂，威胁到北京从唐纳德·特朗普总统日益交易性的外交政策中获得的一些优势，也许最重要的是，这表明了中国共产党宁愿世界忘记的事情：美国民主仍然有自我纠正的能力。
在解释原因之前，有两个条件是必不可少的。
首先，特朗普背离了长期以来强调联盟、民主价值观、多边机构和捍卫基于规则的国际秩序的美国传统外交政策共识，这不能仅用特朗普的个性来解释。三大结构性发展使美国外交政策的调整不可避免。
美国维持冷战后自由国际秩序的成本越来越高。美国的盟友往往过度依赖美国的安全保障，而华盛顿的国内经济和财政压力却在增加。与此同时，中国非凡的经济、工业和军事崛起从根本上改变了全球力量平衡，使得 20 世纪 90 年代的单极安排越来越不可持续。俄罗斯入侵乌克兰加剧了这两个问题，给华盛顿带来了额外的安全负担，同时暴露了维持国际规则以对抗顽固的修正主义国家的困难。
美国必须做出调整。如果没有特朗普，这种调整可能会更加渐进地进行，理想情况下，随着旧秩序的演变，新的机构和责任会出现。相反，我们正在经历一个国际混乱的危险时期，既定规则的崩溃速度快于替代规则的建立速度。即使特朗普卸任后，美国外交政策也不可能也不应该完全回到特朗普上台前的状态。
第二个资格涉及总统权力。特朗普将继续担任总统两年。美国总统在外交事务上享有相当大的权力，与国内政策制定相比，美国总统通常面临的国会限制更少。民主党国会不能简单地扭转特朗普的对华外交政策，尽管它可以通过立法和预算、加强监督并改变政治激励措施。因此，与立即的战略逆转相比，任何变化都更有可能产生边际后果。
尽管如此，北京有充分的理由看待中期结果

Democratic Senator-elect James Talarico waves to supporters on election day, Nov. 3, 2026. He’s the first Democrat to be elected a senator in Texas since 1988.
On balance, Beijing has little reason to celebrate the United States’ midterm election results. The Democratic takeover of Congress complicates China’s strategic calculations, threatens some of the advantages Beijing has gained from President Donald Trump’s increasingly transactional foreign policy, and, perhaps most importantly, demonstrates something the Chinese Communist Party (CCP) would rather the world forget: U.S. democracy retains the capacity to correct itself.
Before explaining why, two qualifications are essential.
The first is that Trump’s departure from the traditional U.S. foreign policy consensus – which has long emphasized alliances, democratic values, multilateral institutions, and the defense of a rules-based international order – cannot be explained by Trump’s personality alone. Three structural developments have made an adjustment in U.S. foreign policy unavoidable.
The post-Cold War liberal international order has become increasingly expensive for the United States to maintain. U.S. allies have often depended excessively on U.S. security guarantees, while Washington’s domestic economic and fiscal pressures have grown. Meanwhile, China’s extraordinary economic, industrial, and military rise has fundamentally altered the global balance of power, making the unipolar arrangements of the 1990s increasingly unsustainable. Russia’s invasion of Ukraine has exacerbated both problems, imposing additional security burdens on Washington while exposing the difficulty of maintaining international rules against determined revisionist powers.
The United States must adjust. Without Trump, that adjustment might have occurred more gradually, ideally allowing new institutions and responsibilities to emerge as the old order evolved. Instead, we are experiencing a dangerous period of international disorder in which established rules are breaking down faster than replacements can be constructed. Even after Trump leaves office, U.S. foreign policy neither can nor should return entirely to its pre-Trump form.
The second qualification concerns presidential power. Trump remains president for another two years. U.S. presidents enjoy considerable authority over foreign affairs, generally facing fewer congressional constraints than in domestic policymaking. A Democratic Congress cannot simply reverse Trump’s diplomacy with China, although it can pass legislation and budgets, increase oversight, and change political incentives. Any change is therefore more likely to be consequential at the margins than an immediate strategic reversal.
Nevertheless, Beijing has good reasons to view the midterm results with concern.
China prefers a transactional U.S. president to one guided by enduring principles and institutional commitments. During his first term, Trump surprised Beijing by launching a trade war that challenged decades of U.S. economic engagement. Chinese leaders initially struggled to understand his methods. Over time, however, Trump’s transactionalism became more pronounced, and Beijing learned to negotiate with him.
Trump has embraced the G2 language, signaling recognition of China as the United States’ principal peer competitor. He has treated Taiwan increasingly as a bargaining instrument, including through delays in arms sales. And he has accepted the language of “constructive strategic stability” advanced by Xi Jinping, opening the possibility of an understanding that prioritizes bilateral accommodation over traditional U.S. commitments.
Beijing recognizes the advantages of this approach. On November 2, the day before the midterms, the South China Morning Post, owned by Chinese conglomerate Alibaba Group, published an article titled “Will ‘strategic stability’ with China go out the window if Trump loses the midterms?” It warned that a Republican loss of the House could test the emerging strategic-stability framework. Yet it also expressed confidence that Trump would continue trying to stabilize relations with Beijing. The concern is revealing. Beijing has learned to work with Trump’s approach and would prefer that it remain largely undisturbed.
Congressional pressure could let values retake a place in U.S. China policy. It could also make Taiwan’s security less vulnerable to presidential bargaining. U.S. policy would remain pragmatic, but democratic values would be harder to exclude from relations with China.
Congress could also encourage the repair of the United States’ relationships with allies in Europe, North America, and the Indo-Pacific. Stronger cooperation with Canada, European democracies, Japan, South Korea, Australia, and other partners would reinforce the democratic world’s collective economic, technological, and military strength. Beijing benefits when Washington quarrels with its allies; it faces greater constraints when they coordinate.
The Iran war presents another consideration. Stronger congressional oversight could increase pressure to end the conflict sooner. China has little reason to welcome an early U.S. disengagement from a war that consumes Washington’s military resources, financial capacity, diplomatic attention, and political energy. A prolonged conflict distracts Washington from the Indo-Pacific and its strategic competition with China.
Advanced semiconductor exports provide an especially revealing example of where Congress could make a difference. Despite substantial bipartisan support for restricting China’s access to sensitive U.S. technology, Trump permitted sales of certain advanced Nvidia chips, including the H200, while retaining restrictions on the most sophisticated products. His administration connected these transactions to financial returns for the United States.
Republican congressional majorities had largely avoided directly confronting Trump’s decisions, despite objections from some China hawks. A Democratic Congress could be considerably more assertive, using hearings, legislation, and budgetary authority to tighten export restrictions. Beijing would certainly prefer fewer such constraints.
Trump’s second administration has generated serious controversies over executive power, the Iran war, sweeping tariffs, allegations of corruption and conflicts of interest, the handling of Epstein-related records, and the politicization of law enforcement. Critics see these developments as threats to constitutional government, the separation of powers, and the rule of law. These concerns deserve scrutiny through democratic institutions, with allegations distinguished from established wrongdoing.
As someone who has devoted much of his life to advancing democracy and human rights, I am particularly sensitive to democratic deterioration. I have heard from compatriots inside China that U.S. democracy has lost considerable appeal. Some friends have even joked that China’s official Xinhua News Agency no longer needs to fabricate negative stories about Washington. Its propagandists need only translate U.S. news reports. That observation contains a painful truth. The United Sates’ democratic weaknesses have provided authoritarian propaganda with powerful material.
Yet the midterm elections demonstrate something Beijing’s propagandists cannot easily explain away. Americans dissatisfied with their government’s direction have used the ballot box to change the balance of political power. The midterm elections created new opportunities for oversight and constitutional checks on the presidency.
On specific policy issues, one may agree or disagree with the voters who produced this outcome. That is not the essential point. The essential point is that U.S. democracy works. It retains the capacity to recognize mistakes, restrain power, and correct its course peacefully.
For Beijing, this is not a welcome result at all. A divided U.S. government can complicate Trump’s transactional diplomacy. A united democratic alliance can constrain China’s geopolitical ambitions. But a self-correcting U.S. democracy challenges something more fundamental: the CCP’s claim that authoritarian governance offers a superior political model.

印度灯光节吸引民众前往新北淡水 - 聚焦台湾
印度灯光节吸引民众前往新北淡水
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
周六，舞者们以表演拉开了在新北淡水渔人码头举行的 2026 年排灯节庆祝活动的序幕。印度台北同乡会供图
中新社台北11月7日电 2026年排灯节庆祝活动周六在新北淡水渔人码头举行，以印度音乐、舞蹈和美食为特色，台湾高中管乐队表演印度传统曲目。
印度台北协会（ITA）在新闻稿中表示，这项年度活动由印度台北协会（ITA）和新北市政府共同主办，吸引了众多游客和政要齐聚一堂，庆祝印度文化并体验南亚传统。
印度驻台湾代表处表示，排灯节也称为排灯节，象征着光明战胜黑暗、正义战胜邪恶，传统上与​​繁荣和新的开始联系在一起。
出席开幕式的台湾官员包括国安会秘书长吴钊燮、外交部副部长葛葆萱和新北市政府顾问柯庆忠。
他们与印度驻台湾代表尼纳德·德什潘德 (Ninad Deshpande) 一起点燃传统油灯（称为 diyas）以纪念这一时刻。
印度驻台湾代表尼纳德·德什潘德(Ninad Deshpande)。印度台北同乡会供图
德什潘德表示，今年的庆祝活动是印台关系的一个里程碑，长荣航空将于12月1日开通台北和新德里之间的直飞航班，恢复两地间中断六年的直达客运服务。
德什潘德说：“这条航线不仅仅是一条飞行路线，它是加深我们在商业、旅游、文化和人际关系方面联系的重要桥梁。”
此前运营台北-新德里航线的中华航空于 2020 年因 COVID-19 大流行而暂停了该服务。
ITA 赠送两张往返机票，以庆祝长荣航空即将开通直飞航班。
节日从下午 4 点开始。至晚上 8:30以传统和现代印度舞蹈表演为特色，还有提供烤饼和咖喱等菜肴的小吃摊。
其中一大亮点是台北市立成功中学管乐团的跨文化表演，带来精选的印度经典曲目。
ITA 表示，这支著名的台湾学生乐队已有 70 多年的历史，他们解决了印度音乐复杂的节奏和独特的细微差别。
印度驻台湾代表尼纳德·德什潘德 (Ninad Deshpande) 与台北市成功中学乐团代表合影。印度台北同乡会供图

Indian Festival of Lights draws crowds to New Taipei's Tamsui

Dancers kick off the 2026 Diwali Festival celebration held at Tamsui Fisherman's Wharf in New Taipei on Saturday with a performance. Photo courtesy of the India Taipei Association
Taipei, Nov. 7 (CNA) The 2026 Diwali Festival celebration was held at Tamsui Fisherman's Wharf in New Taipei on Saturday, featuring Indian music, dance and cuisine, with a Taiwanese high school concert band performing traditional Indian pieces.
The annual event, co-hosted by the India Taipei Association (ITA) and the New Taipei City government, attracted visitors and dignitaries who gathered to celebrate Indian culture and experience South Asian traditions, the ITA said in a news release.
Diwali, also known as the Festival of Lights, symbolizes the victory of light over darkness and good over evil, and is traditionally associated with prosperity and new beginnings, said the ITA, India's representative office in Taiwan.
Among the Taiwan officials attending the opening ceremony were National Security Council Secretary-General Joseph Wu (吳釗燮), Deputy Foreign Minister Baushuan Ger (葛葆萱) and New Taipei City government adviser Ke Ching-chung (柯慶忠).
They joined India's Representative to Taiwan Ninad Deshpande in lighting traditional oil lamps, known as diyas, to mark the occasion.
India's Representative to Taiwan Ninad Deshpande. Photo courtesy of the India Taipei Association
Deshpande said this year's celebration marked a milestone in India-Taiwan relations, as EVA Air is set to launch direct flights between Taipei and New Delhi on Dec. 1, restoring nonstop passenger services between the two destinations after a six-year hiatus.
"This route is more than just a flight path -- it is a vital bridge deepening our ties in business, tourism, culture and human connection," Deshpande said.
China Airlines, which previously operated the Taipei-New Delhi route, suspended the service in 2020 amid the COVID-19 pandemic.
The ITA gave away two round-trip tickets to celebrate EVA Air's upcoming direct flights.
The festival ran from 4 p.m. to 8:30 p.m. featuring traditional and contemporary Indian dance performances and food stalls offering dishes such as naan and curry.
A highlight was a cross-cultural performance by the concert band of Taipei Municipal Chenggong High School, which presented a selection of classic Indian pieces.
The renowned Taiwanese student band, which has a history of more than 70 years, tackled the intricate rhythms and unique nuances of Indian music, the ITA said.
India's Representative to Taiwan Ninad Deshpande pose with a representative of the concert band of Taipei Municipal Chenggong High School. Photo courtesy of the India Taipei Association

美中熱線！貿易議題交鋒 美要求放寬稀土出口、陸關切關稅未調降 | 全球財經 | 全球 | 聯合新聞網
Your browser does not support HTML5 Audio! 😢
大陸國務院副總理何立峰（左起）與美國貿易代表葛里爾、財政部長貝森特舉行視訊通話。新華社
深圳「川習會」前夕，大陸國務院副總理何立峰6日晚間與美國財政部長貝森特和貿易代表葛里爾舉行視訊通話，美方警告北京立即採購農產品及放寬稀土出口的承諾，中方則對美方遲遲未調降300億美元關稅商品的經貿限制措施表達「嚴正關切」。
中美元首預計在11月中旬亞太經合會（APEC）期間舉行今年第三度「川習會」前，新華社報導，北京時間11月6日晚間，中美經貿中方牽頭人何立峰與美方牽頭人貝森特和貿易代表葛里爾舉行視訊通話。
美國貿易代表署（USTR）透露，葛里爾在通話中指出，中方必須採取實際行動，全面履行其以往的承諾，尤其是在農產品採購、稀土和其他關鍵礦產方面，川普政府將持續推動美中貿易平衡，監督承諾履約狀況，為美國農民、農牧業、製造商與勞工創造長遠利益。
另據美國財政部新聞稿，貝森特強調，中方全面及立即執行2025年10月釜山峰會承諾的重要性，並對近期中方的動作表示關切，這些承諾是否有進展得看實際成果，美方將密切評估中方的落實情況。
新華社報導，雙方圍繞落實好中美元首會晤重要共識和經貿磋商成果，就彼此關心的重要經貿問題進行深入交流，中方就近期美對華經貿限制措施表達嚴正關切。
北京方面已暗示，關稅讓步仍是其主要訴求之一。大陸商務部5日表示，大陸願意增加購買美國農產品，但前提是雙方達成的300億美元對300億美元對等降稅安排落地，通過共同降低關稅、減少非關稅壁壘、擴大市場准入等方式，為兩國農產品貿易創造更多有利條件。
今年9月「川習會」後，大陸在9月底公布中美「300億對300億」對等降稅商品清單，美方將針對約300億美元的大陸進口商品調降關稅，涉及玩具、家電、嬰幼兒用品、廚衛用品及節慶用品等；陸方則將對約300億美元的美國進口商品提供降稅待遇，涵蓋農產品、個人護理用品、醫療器械及煤炭等產品。
紐約時報六日又報導，和輝達執行長黃仁勳關係密切的前新加坡資料中心公司MegaSpeed中國大陸籍高階主管黃樂（音譯，Alice Huang），是大陸國安部間諜，任務是蒐集黃仁勳的情資。
美國股市6日靠晶片股反彈止穩，本周通膨數據和科技業財報將考驗反彈能否延續。投資人仍在評估資料中心建設可能放慢的程度，以及聯準會（Fed）若再升息對AI投資和企業獲利的影響。
人工智慧（AI）新創公司Anthropic首次公開發行股票（IPO）計畫遭遇了美國期中選舉後拋售潮，導致潛在投資人重新評估該公司合理上市價，知情人士透露，目前市場討論的估值區間已降至1.2兆至1.3兆美元，較先前預估市值縮水許多。
紐時報導，美國情治單位認定輝達執行長黃仁勳淪為北京女間諜黃樂（Alice Huang）鎖定目標，試圖促美供應最先進晶片，幾個小時後英國金融時報則爆料，美方懷疑黃仁勳曾和黃樂交往。
第31屆聯合國氣候變遷大會（COP31）預定9日到20日在土耳其安塔利亞舉行，而主辦國廢棄物處理問題，凸顯出迅速降低全球暖化氣體排放雖有發展潛力，執行上也相當困難。
波克夏公司（Berkshire Hathaway）7日公布上季財報，第3季營業利益年減5.8%至127.1億美元，主因保險業務表現疲弱，這段期間動用96億美元買回自家股票，顯示巴菲特接班人亞伯認為波克夏股價遭低估。

中美经贸中方牵头人、国务院副总理何立峰（左一）星期五（11月6日）晚，与美方牵头人、美国财政部长贝森特（右一）和贸易代表格里尔举行视频通话。 （新华社）
中美元首预计本月中旬在深圳会晤，两国经贸高层在会晤前举行视频通话。美国敦促中国履行稀土供应和农产品采购承诺，中国则就近期美国对华经贸限制措施表达“严正关切”。
受访学者分析，此次通话是在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议前的一次“履约对表”，双方坚持各自立场，凸显两国在经贸关系上的分歧与挑战。
中美经贸中方牵头人、中国副总理何立峰与美方牵头人、美国财政部长贝森特和贸易代表格里尔于新加坡时间星期五（11月6日）晚举行视频通话。
据新华社发布的消息，双方围绕落实好中美元首北京和华盛顿会晤共识和经贸磋商成果，就彼此关心的重要经贸问题进行了“坦诚、深入、建设性”的交流。中方对美方近期出台的经贸限制措施表达“严正关切”，双方同意继续加强合作，妥善管控分歧。
美国财政部发布的简报则说，贝森特在通话中强调“中国全面、立即落实在釜山所作承诺的重要性”，并对中国近期的行动表达关切。贝森特指出，双方能否持续取得进展，取决于能否实现具体成果，美国将密切评估中国的落实情况。
格里尔也强调，中国采取具体行动全面落实既往承诺“至关重要”，特别是在农产品采购、稀土及其他关键矿产方面。
中美元首去年10月在韩国釜山会晤，达成贸易休战协议。美国同意取消针对中国商品加征的芬太尼关税，并暂缓实施对中国加征对等关税；中国承诺在三年里每年采购2500万吨美国大豆，以及170亿美元（约220亿新元）其他美国农产品等。协议期原定一年，今年9月中国国家主席习近平访美期间，双方同意延长至明年1月10日。
不过，近期双方在协议落实、经贸限制措施等问题上各有不满。中国商务部星期六（7日）就美国以涉及古巴为由制裁两家中国企业发表声明，批评美国升级对华制裁打压，密集出台歧视性限制措施，严重损害中国企业权益，破坏中美经贸关系稳定。
美国则多次抱怨未获得足量稀土及其他关键矿产。格里尔10月对彭博社说，中国稀土供应量和速度均未达到双方商定的水平。贝森特9月也曾指出，中国在履行非大豆农产品的采购承诺方面进度落后。
美国5月宣布，除了履行釜山协议的大豆采购承诺，中国同意于2026年至2028年每年再至少采购170亿美元美国农产品。但中国今年首九个月进口的美国非大豆农产品仅72亿美元，为2019年以来同期最低水平。
中国商务部新闻发言人星期四（5日）回应说，中国对扩大采购美国农产品持开放态度，但前提是双方落实“300亿对300亿”对等降税安排。
这些分歧为即将举行的“习特三会”增添了不确定性 。清华大学战略与安全研究中心副研究员孙成昊接受《联合早报》采访时指出，最新中美经贸高层通话，是深圳会晤前的一次“履约对表”。
他认为，中期选举失利后，特朗普更需要向美国农民和企业展示成果，因此催促中国兑现采购和供货承诺。中国则关注双方能否对等落实共识，“双方一个直接分歧是既有承诺和下一步合作怎么衔接”。
新加坡南洋理工大学公共政策与全球事务副教授骆明辉受访时说，这次通话显示双方在元首会晤前坚持各自立场。“中国暂缓或犹豫落实采购承诺，是因为希望美国撤回部分关税措施，并取消贸易限制。”
骆明辉预计深圳会晤会有一些容易达成的“低垂果实”，例如更多美中贸易、投资理事会的细节、人工智能领域进展等，但不太可能取得重大突破。
孙成昊指出，美国近期提出扩大对外投资限制的规则草案，中国已公开反对。“深圳会晤值得关注的是，双方能否明确各项承诺的执行顺序和时间表，以及出现新的限制措施时能否及时磋商，避免影响已经谈妥的合作。”
新加坡管理大学李光前商学院金融学副教授傅方剑指出，美方催促中国履行采购承诺，但对中国而言，双方已就对等降税达成共识，美国应调整相关关税，再要求中国扩大采购。此外，美国近期对中国企业的制裁没有停止，这种“不友好的态度”，也是中国没有像美国预期那样采购美国农产品的原因之一。

title: 廖亦武：黃之鋒獲諾貝爾和平獎的可能

content: – 29岁的黄之锋6年刑满之际，中共香港当局又在他即将获释之际，再次判处他10年有期徒刑。這真可谓数千年来，史无前例的国家犯罪。甚至比重判老人黎智英更加令人发指。所以，在推特上，这是继美国中期选举特朗普惨败、乌克兰反侵略战争之后，最引人关注的新闻。 我因此重发8年前《支持和呼吁将諾貝爾和平獎授予香港雙學三子黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰》的采访。我以此祝福狱中的黄之锋，保重身体，大家会为你继续争取的 ————————– 2018年2月5日，流亡作家廖亦武接受香港本土媒體《眾新聞》的採訪，谈到雙學三子黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰獲諾貝爾和平獎的可能 – 問：您覺得這次提名，對香港人及香港的民主運動，代表了什麼意義呢？ 答：2014年的香港雨傘運動的某一天，柏林下着雨，我正在參加2009年諾貝爾文學獎得主赫塔-穆勒的新書發佈會。越洋電話中突然傳來消息，北京的地下詩人王藏，因撐傘聲援香港佔中而被捕入獄，接着又有十幾位藝術家入獄。我將這連鎖反應告訴赫塔-米勒，我們一塊拍了那張撐傘比中指、高喊「北京獨裁者滾蛋」的照片。在那一刻，我覺得時光倒流，我想起1989天安門大屠殺，也是和黃之鋒、周永康、羅冠聰相仿佛的一批年輕人，佔領了天安門廣場，要求對話和民主。卻發生戒嚴和屠殺，成千上萬人倒在血泊中。我在那夜寫作了《大屠殺》： 權力永遠會勝利。永遠會一代又一代傳下去。 自由也會死灰復燃。一代又一代死灰復燃。像黎明到來之前那一丁點光亮…… 2014年香港雨傘運動是1989年天安門學潮的歷史延續，特別是在獨裁中國利用全球資本主義，公然挑戰全人類普世價值的當口，雙學三子被美國國會議員們提名角逐諾貝爾和平獎的消息，就特別振奮人心。這證明西方有良知的人們，在高度關注香港人的抗爭。雖然武裝到牙齒的強權令手無寸鐵的香港人「節節敗退」，但德國詩人里爾克說：「挺住意味着一切。」年輕人會贏得時間。如果他們真得獎了，時間的天秤就會倒過來，世界會因此而改變。 問： 您覺得在劉曉波去世後，及對中國對香港步步進逼下，中國政府會如何看待這次和平獎提名？ 答：中國政府的看法不重要，只有想從中國政府那兒撈取好處的人，才覺得這樣一個寡廉鮮恥的政府的看法重要，比如藝術明星艾未未，為了自由出入中國，而在劉曉波之死和六四死亡人數上混淆視聽，與中國政府如出一轍。 法國著名作家和記者法拉奇在傳世之作《人》中寫道：「我認為人類尊嚴最美好的紀念碑是伯羅奔尼薩斯半島上的那個東西。它不是一座偶像，也不是一面旗幟，而是三個希臘字母：OXI。意思是『不』。」「為什麼還要忍受痛苦，為什麼要鬥爭，為什麼要冒從山上被狂風刮到井底與魚為伍的風險呢？因為這是作為一個男人，一個女人，總之是作為一個人而不是作為一隻綿羊而生存的唯一方法。」 問：觀察過去的諾貝爾和平獎，少有第一次提名便獲獎。您認為，未來香港獲獎的機會高嗎，會否獲得國際的支持？諾貝爾和平獎委員會應如何看待這次提名？ 答：觀察是沒用的。劉曉波得獎之際，我曾寫了一篇文章，摘錄如後：「劉曉波對探監的劉霞説：『這個獎是給所有八九六四亡靈的。』接著他哭起來。我沒有哭，可這句話像石頭，壓了我許多天。是的是的，在中國異見者看來，諾貝爾奬至高無上，只有近3000名死難者的代表，才有資格獲得。 「所以這些年，劉曉波和我等等的重大議題之一，是提名『天安門母親』的發起者丁子霖教授為諾貝爾獎候選人，我們寫過若干文章，公開聯名推薦至少五次以上。丁子霖的兒子在六四凌晨被槍殺，風聲鶴唳中，她作為遇難者家屬，第一個打破沉默，向國際社會指控劊子手政府。接著的20餘年，丁子霖夫婦一直被軟禁，但他們根據一星半點線索，經過若乾地下渠道，逐個尋訪，竟然串聯了180多位六四難屬，形成影響深遠的『天安門母親』群體。大夥兒互相激勵，蒐集屠殺證據，記錄真相，在海外出版成冊，並年復一年上書當局，追究罪責，令獨裁者坐臥不安。 「劉曉波對我説：丁子霖的工作令人想起1986年諾貝爾和平獎得主埃利‧威塞爾，後者的寫作主題是納粹滅絕猶太人的記憶。頒獎辭中，『把個人關注化作對所有暴力、仇恨和壓迫的普遍譴責』，也適用於丁子霖。」 我們多年的努力沒有結果。劉曉波自己希望丁子霖得獎，結果很意外，他坐牢、得獎、被謀殺，成為一個燈塔般的道義巨子。 作為過來人，我希望黃之鋒等人堅韌不拔，香港、他們的故鄉的人們，也應該鼓勵他們堅韌不拔。香港社會的民主抗爭在世界上影響愈大，他們愈有可能得獎。特別是在目前，獨裁中國處於四處挑釁的高危時期，西方正紛紛檢討和調整過去多年對中國的綏靖主义失誤。在重新匯聚的歷史潮流中，香港是一個抵抗的典範，所以黃之鋒他們得獎的可能性，與世界大勢密切相關。

title: 台湾无党籍立委高金素梅涉接受中国资金违反国安法等罪嫌被起诉

content:
资料照片：台湾无党籍立法委员高金素梅(左)在日本东京靖国神社前抗议，要求该神社将其祖先灵位移除。(2005年6月14日)
台湾高等检察署星期五(11月6日)起诉无党籍立法委员高金素梅和三名助理，指控高金素梅涉嫌接受中国资金约新台币1.7亿元，在台湾发展组织，违反《国家安全法》和《贪污治罪条例》。检方对高金素梅求刑14年，对疑似已偷渡出境的前办公室主任张俊杰求刑15年。高金素梅否认所有指控，并表示将在审判中提出证据，证明自己清白。
高检署星期一以被告身份传唤高金素梅，并收押两名助理，随后侦结此案。检方以《国家安全法》中“为大陆地区公务机构发展组织”罪，以及《贪污治罪条例》中“职务上行为收受贿赂”等罪嫌，起诉高金素梅等四人。
高金素梅是台湾泰雅族原住民，2001年以无党籍身份当选原住民选区立法委员至今。
高检署说，高金素梅利用立委职权，就职务上行为，尤其是反军购、两岸、外交与国防等重要议题，依中共授意指示在国会配合发声，影响议事进行，内外勾连，所犯情节极为重大，且侦查中推诿卸责，毫无悔意，建请法官从重处以有期徒刑14年。
高检署也指出，张俊杰以接受中共捐赠原乡部落建设经费为名，透过亲友账户等管道，将新台币1亿7千多万元资金汇入台湾，引进中共资源发展组织。
台湾自由时报报道，检调人员查出，高金素梅明知张俊杰长期提供巨额资金或中共直接捐赠资金为其竞选，她却涉嫌依中共官员及派遣人员授意指示，在立法院内召开反日记者会、对台湾驻日代表处质询删除预算、质询反对军购、透过程序委员会委员身份影响法案审议等，严重影响议事运作；此外，她也针对两岸、外交等议题进行抗议发声，对台湾主权完整、国家安全及社会安定造成重大危害。
台湾中央社的报道说，检调人员查出，高金素梅、其办公室前后任主任张俊杰、陈智葟及助理林怡君等4人自2005年到2016年，将其部落工作队及国会团队统合称“祖灵之邦团队”，以“一套人马，两块招牌”方式运作，由张俊杰、陈智葟同龄团队竞选、问政及联系原乡部落，林怡君则在台湾与中国大陆两边穿梭，接受中共官员指示并传达。
报道说，张俊杰今年6月即遭台北地方检察署以涉嫌诈领助理费起诉，在移到法院审理后以新台币1,000万元交保并佩戴电子手环监控行踪，但他在9月6日破坏手环逃匿，疑似已从基隆偷渡出海。
对于被高检署起诉，高金素梅当天在其脸书帐号上发表声明强调自身清白，否认起诉书中对她的所有指控。
“我没有为中共发展组织，也没有收取任何陆资，起诉书所载犯行均非事实，不能因查缉张俊杰逃亡失利，就草率起诉，转移焦点。”她说，起诉书提到她因靖国神社事件而赴日本及联合国抗议、反对军购等，都是她一贯主张，“并非中共授意，也没有任何对价，更没有一毛钱流入我的口袋。”
她也表示，将在审判中提出相关证据，捍卫自身清白，“决不妥协”。
在高金素梅被检调约谈后，北京当局指责台湾执政的民进党政府是在“操弄司法”，“罗织罪名”，破坏两岸交流合作。

日本挑选28个优先项目进行370万亿日元投资 - 日本时报
日本挑选28个优先项目进行370万亿日元投资
周五，首相高市早苗在东京总理大臣官邸出席日本增长战略会议。 |集集
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
消息人士周五称，政府已选择了包括半导体和人工智能在内的 28 项优先产品和技术，用于总额超过 370 万亿日元的公共和私人投资，这是其增长战略的支柱。
该名单是在当天由首相高市早苗主持的日本增长战略委员会会议上公布的。
高市在会上表示：“大规模、战略性的投资支持措施对于建立国内半导体供应链至关重要。”
这28项优先项目是从17个战略领域的62个产品和技术中选出的。预计它们将产生显着的经济溢出效应。
政府将在年底前制定实施方案，将未来五年作为密集投资期。
优先项目包括垂直和物理人工智能、数据中心、生物制药、量子计算、造船和关键矿物的精炼。

Japan picks 28 priority items for ¥370 trillion in investments - The Japan Times
Japan picks 28 priority items for ¥370 trillion in investments
Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi attends a meeting of the Council for Japan's Growth Strategy at the Prime Minister's Office in Tokyo on Friday. | JIJI
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
The government has selected 28 priority products and technologies, including semiconductors and artificial intelligence, for public and private investments totaling over ¥370 trillion, which are a pillar of its growth strategy, sources said Friday.
The list was presented at the day’s meeting of the Council for Japan’s Growth Strategy, chaired by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.
“Large-scale and strategic investment support measures are essential for establishing a domestic semiconductor supply chain,” Takaichi said at the meeting.
The 28 priority items were picked from 62 products and technologies in 17 strategic fields. They are expected to have significant economic spillover effects.
The government will formulate an implementation plan by the end of the year, designating the next five years as a period for intensive investments.
The priority items include vertical and physical AI, data centers, biopharmaceuticals, quantum computing, shipbuilding, and the refining of critical minerals.

content:
特朗普和美国国会将就关税的经济成本发生冲突 - 日本时报
特朗普和美国国会将就关税的经济成本发生冲突
2025 年 4 月，唐纳德·特朗普总统在华盛顿白宫玫瑰园就关税问题发表讲话时，美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克手握一张图表。路透社
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads 电子邮件 打印 书签故事 复制链接
众议院民主党领袖哈基姆·杰弗里斯承诺“停止特朗普愚蠢的关税抬高美国人的物价”。即将上任的参议院财政委员会主席罗恩·怀登表示，他将重申国会对贸易政策的权威。就连德克萨斯州共和党参议员特德·克鲁兹也感叹“关税让一切都变得太贵了”。
但限制唐纳德·特朗普总统的关税权力并不容易或迅速，而且在即将上任的民主党领导的国会中，任何这样做的努力都可能会引发两党的内讧。
尽管总统在周二大选前调整了政策，但他正在酝酿一些潜在的贸易壁垒。特朗普可能会宣布一系列与工业产能过剩相关的新关税，这将影响十多个经济体的进口——甚至在民主党一月份掌权之前。

Trump and U.S. Congress set to clash over economic costs of tariffs - The Japan Times
Trump and U.S. Congress set to clash over economic costs of tariffs
U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick holds a chart as President Donald Trump delivers remarks on tariffs in the Rose Garden at the White House in Washington in April 2025. | REUTERS
X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Bluesky Threads Email Print Bookmark story Copy link
Hakeem Jeffries, the leader of House Democrats, promises to “stop the stupid Trump tariffs jacking up prices on Americans.” Ron Wyden, incoming Senate Finance Committee chairman, says he’ll reassert congressional authority over trade policy. Even Senator Ted Cruz, the Texas Republican, lamented that “tariffs have made everything too expensive.”
But curbing President Donald Trump’s tariff powers won’t be easy or quick, and there’s a risk any efforts to do so in the incoming Democratic-led Congress will spur infighting in both parties.
While the president tempered his policies ahead of Tuesday’s election, he has several potential trade barriers in the pipeline. Trump could announce a new set of duties linked to excess industrial capacity that would hit imports from more than a dozen economies — even before Democrats take control in January.

民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧（前左）7日在溪北公園舉行「慧聚繁星，板橋會贏」造勢晚會，活動近尾聲時，行政院長卓榮泰（前右）壓軸登場站台。中央社記者趙世勳攝 115年11月7日
（中央社記者黃旭昇新北7日電）行政院長卓榮泰今晚在板橋站台推薦民進黨新北市長參選人蘇巧慧，是專業、深入基層且有宏觀遠見的人選，他說，希望市議會議員過半，將來蘇巧慧推動市政就不會像他這樣辛苦。
卓榮泰今天晚上參加蘇巧慧的板橋區溪北公園造勢晚會，蘇巧慧帶領市議員參選人大進場時，引起群眾歡呼搖旗幟的熱情歡迎，但也有支持者在拉扯中發生肢體衝突。
卓榮泰以「大師兄」身分出席，又引起另一波高潮。致詞時，他也逐一介紹板橋區市議員參選人，希望鄉親支持能夠「全壘打」進議會，讓議會過半，將來蘇巧慧若當選，施政就不會像他一樣辛苦，不必經常在立法院被糟蹋。
卓榮泰以台語演講表示，他在立院面對一些「烏魯木齊（指粗製濫造）」的法案，不副署還不行。錢坑法案一直來，統籌分配款撥至地方、要中央通過一條條的錢坑法案，目的是要破壞國家財政，影響國力，拖慢國家進步的腳步。「台灣的腳步慢不得，所以，該拒絕我們就要拒絕」。
他表示，這次縣市長選舉，雙北若勝選就是贏得台灣。卓榮泰推崇蘇巧慧的專業，並批評對手國民黨市長參選人李四川過去曾協助韓國瑜（前高雄市長）面對罷免案，質疑這樣的經驗是否值得借鏡。
卓榮泰也推崇蘇巧慧深入基層、提出在地人民的需求，能夠招商引資，也向中央提出全民普發1萬元AI紅利、台北港智慧物流園區、淡海AI園區等建議；行政院規劃考量後，已經決定在淡海新市鎮開闢AI新基地「淡海智慧科學城」，預計將於民國118年進駐使用。
對於卓榮泰晚間的站台助選，李四川上午接受聯訪時被問，行政院6日決定對「老人福利法」修法不副署的看法，他說，長者健保費排富補助不副署，蘇巧慧應該要問卓榮泰為何不副署，影響新北市照顧逾80萬的長輩，應該要給長輩交代。
同一時間受訪的民眾黨主席黃國昌說，政府幫長者代繳健保費的政策，是30年前台北市長陳水扁率先推出，減輕「三明治」家庭經濟壓力，深受長者支持。但因縣市政府財政能力不一，民眾黨創黨主席柯文哲在2024年參選總統時，才會提此政策落實長者醫療平權。
黃國昌說，立法院三讀通過修法後，民進黨執政的縣市表示歡迎，同黨縣市長參選人也提出同樣的政見，但卓榮泰竟然不副署，是再次赤裸展現民進黨的雙標以及權力的傲慢。（編輯：林恕暉）1151107

中新社台北11月7日电 台湾外交部7日谴责中方发表损害中华民国主权的虚假言论，称台海两岸互不隶属的事实是无法改变的。
外交部在一份新闻稿中表示，中国国家主席习近平与加蓬总统恩圭马会谈后，中国外交部于周五发表联合声明。该声明包括中非国家重申坚持“一个中国原则”，外交部称其歪曲了联合国大会第2758号决议。
1971年通过的联合国第2758号决议没有提及台湾，只涉及中国在联合国的代表权问题。北京将该决议解释为赋予其代表台湾的权利，并声称台湾是其领土的一部分。
外交部指责中国政府多次利用双边会议向其他国家施压，要求其发表损害中华民国主权的言论。
外交部表示，中华民国是一个主权、独立的国家，从未受过中华人民共和国的统治，并补充说，只有台湾民选政府才有权在国际上，包括在联合国系统内代表其人民。
外交部还指责中国将“一个中国原则”纳入与其他国家签署的双边文件中，试图破坏国际秩序，并敦促加蓬不要落入北京的政治操纵之手。

MOFA condemns China over statement undermining ROC sovereignty

Taipei, Nov. 7 (CNA) Taiwan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) on Saturday condemned China for making a false statement undermining the Republic of China's (ROC) sovereignty, saying that the fact that the two sides of the Taiwan Strait are not subordinate to each other is something that cannot be changed.
In a press release, MOFA said China's Foreign Ministry issued a joint statement on Friday following talks between Chinese President Xi Jinping (習近平) and Gabonese President Brice Clotaire Oligui Nguema. The statement included the Central African country's reaffirmation of its adherence to the "One China principle" and what MOFA described as a distortion of United Nations General Assembly Resolution 2758.
U.N. Resolution 2758, adopted in 1971, does not mention Taiwan and addresses only the issue of China's U.N. representation. Beijing interprets the resolution as giving it the right to represent Taiwan, which it claims as part of its territory.
MOFA accused the Chinese government of repeatedly using bilateral meetings to pressure other countries into making statements that undermine the ROC's sovereignty.
The ROC is a sovereign, independent country that has never been ruled by the People's Republic of China (PRC), the ministry said, adding that only Taiwan's democratically elected government has the right to represent its people internationally, including within the United Nations system.
MOFA also accused China of seeking to undermine the international order by inserting its "One China principle" into bilateral documents it signs with other countries, and urged Gabon not to fall for Beijing's political manipulation.

# 纽时揭中国两家芯片商获美批准处理英伟达芯片“形同空壳”

美国特朗普政府批准多家中国企业，购买或组装英伟达（Nvidia）先进人工智能芯片H200，但《纽约时报》调查发现，其中两家获批企业在中国的登记办公室形同空壳，不但现场空无一人，物业管理人员也表示从未听过公司名称。调查又发现，相关企业股东与遭美国列入贸易黑名单的中国基金及军方供应商存在关联，引发外界质疑美国政府是否充分审查芯片买家背景，以及能否防止先进技术流入受限制企业。

发表时间： 07/11/2026 - 18:49

 12 分钟 浏览时间

 纽时揭中国两家芯片商获美批准处理英伟达芯片“形同空壳” © Jeffrey McWhorter / AP

 作者： [华盛顿特约记者 陈米亚](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E9%99%88%E7%B1%B3%E4%BA%9A/ "华盛顿特约记者 陈米亚")

广告

继续浏览后续

《纽约时报》周六（7日）报道，其中一家企业新矩阵（New Matrix）成立仅约17个月，今年获美国商务部批准，负责将英伟达H200芯片组装成人工智能电脑。然而，记者最近前往该公司位于北京西北郊一个新建工业园区的登记地址，发现办公室只是一个空置的灰色房间，天花板电线外露，应有照明设备的位置也空无一物，完全没有公司营运迹象。

记者查阅大楼公司名录，找不到新矩阵的名称；向工业园区物业管理处查询，接待员及经理均表示没有该公司的纪录。新矩阵的网站亦缺乏基本企业资讯，截至11月6日，没有列出任何员工、招聘职位或公司发展历史。

此外，中国企业登记资料显示，新矩阵部分股东与中国私募股权基金智路资本（Wise Road）及其创办人李斌存在关联。美国政府2024年已将智路资本列入商务部实体清单，指其协助中国政府收购具有战略重要性的半导体企业。

两名研究相关企业登记资料及中文资讯的分析人士向《纽约时报》表示，他们认为新矩阵可能是与智路资本有关企业的掩护公司。报道指出，新矩阵是第二家获准处理英伟达H200芯片、但在登记地址找不到实际营运迹象的中国企业。

另一家公司麦格纳科技（Maginfra）今年9月已被《纽约时报》揭发有类似情况。该公司获美国批准取得H200芯片，负责将芯片组装成人工智能伺服器，再交付其他客户。记者当时走访其在中国的登记地址，发现一间上锁的小房间内只有几张椅子及空置办公桌，没有公司招牌。大楼工作人员表示，从未见过有人使用该办公室，接待处职员亦称没有听过这家公司。

分析人士认为，麦格纳科技可能是中国科技企业浪潮（Inspur）的关联公司。两家公司共享部分人员及专利，并具有政府持股背景。美国政府此前已将浪潮列入实体清单，指其涉及中国军方相关活动。

《纽约时报》进一步调查发现，其他获准购买或处理H200芯片的中国企业，也与遭美国制裁的公司或中国军事供应商有关联。其中，浙江银盾云科技与云端运算企业范围智能计算技术集团存在联系。范围智能曾向军事承包商提供云端服务，并为河北省国防部门的卫星计划提供云端运算支援。该公司亦曾成立子公司，专门发展服务中国政府及军方的量子通信技术。

另一家获批企业上海嘉唐，则源自国有企业大唐电信。大唐电信为中国军方提供芯片技术，其控制机构中国电信科学技术研究院亦曾参与开发军方密码技术。

曾在特朗普第一任期及拜登政府期间担任白宫国家安全委员会中国事务主任的托宾（Liza Tobin），质疑美国商务部及英伟达是否充分调查获批企业的背景。她向《纽约时报》表示：“我非常担心，无论是商务部还是英伟达，都没有进行必要的尽职调查，以确保许可条款得到遵守。”

特朗普于2025年12月批准英伟达向中国出售H200芯片，放宽拜登政府时期的部分出口限制。根据安排，在台湾组装的芯片必须先运往美国，再转运至中国，美国政府则可收取相当于芯片价值25%的关税。

美国商务部据报已批准约24家中国企业购买或处理H200，包括百度、比亚迪及特斯拉上海。路

透社此前报道，阿里巴巴、腾讯、字节跳动及中兴康讯已取得相关许可。

美国商务部工业与安全局表示，当局会仔细审查所有申请，评估国家安全风险，并指出2025年已就违反出口管制规定的企业处以3亿2,400万美元罚款，2026年亦增聘超过90名执法人员，加强监管。

英伟达发言人里佐（John Rizzo）则表示：“中国军方依赖美国技术，这完全没有道理。”他称，中国政府已严格限制H200进口，以扶持本土芯片企业，而英伟达有限度的对华销售仍有助美国就业及制造业。

《纽约时报》指出，截至7月底的季度，销往中国客户的H200芯片收入，占英伟达数据中心业务收入不足1%。不过，中国企业仍透过东南亚数据中心寻求使用英伟达芯片，令美国当局更难掌握设备的最终使用者。

报道没有证明上述企业已将H200芯片转交中国军方，但两家获批企业的登记办公室均缺乏实际营运迹象，加上多家企业与受制裁公司及军方供应商存在关联，已引起外界关注美国放宽芯片出口限制后，现行审查及监管措施能否有效防止敏感技术落入不应取得的企业手中。

# 联合国人权办对港澳重刑判罚表担忧 外交部驻澳门公署：坚决反对

联合国人权事务高级专员办事处（简称联合国人权办）周五在社媒平台X上发文称，“在香港和澳门特别行政区根据国家安全法律施加严厉刑罚的做法令人深感担忧。昨天，民主活动人士黄之锋在香港被判处第二次重刑，这意味着他因行使基本权利和自由而被判处16年监禁”。

发表时间： 07/11/2026 - 14:40 更改时间： 07/11/2026 - 14:48

 7 分钟 浏览时间

 联合国人权事务高级专员福尔克尔·蒂尔克资料图片 © 美联社图片

 作者： [弗林](https://www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%BD%9C%E8%80%85/%E5%BC%97%E6%9E%97/ "弗林")

广告

继续浏览后续

联合国人权办续指：“在澳门国家安全法实施后的首例已知案件中，法院在闭门审理后判处前立法会议员区锦新12.5年监禁，区锦新在此期间未由其自行选择的辩护律师代理”。

联合国人权办表示：“（联合国人权事务高级专员）蒂尔克（Volker Türk）再次呼吁，对于在香港和澳门特别行政区以及中国其他地方以国家安全为由作出的定罪和判刑，应根据其国际人权义务进行仔细审查”。

此前，正就初选47人案服刑的前香港众志秘书长黄之锋，去年6月在狱中被捕，被控2020年串谋勾结罗冠聪等危害国安。他今年9月认罪，周四在香港高等法院被判囚10年，当中两个月零两日与47人案刑期同期执行，即黄之锋被加监9年10个月。

周五，澳门初级法院刑事法庭裁定区锦新仅两项“颠覆国家政权罪”罪名不成立，其余罪名成立，判处区锦新12年零6个月有期徒刑。他被起诉触犯了三项“颠覆国家政权罪”、三项“与澳门特别行政区以外的组织、团体或个人建立联系作出危害国家安全的行为罪”，以及一项“违反保密罪”。现年69岁的区锦新曾任澳门立法会议员长达20年，亦是当地民主派代表人物之一。

欧盟对外行动署周五通过新闻稿表示：“欧盟对澳门前立法会议员、欧盟公民区锦新于11月6日被判处12年零6个月有期徒刑表示遗憾。这是澳门自2009年《维护国家安全法》通过以来，首例依据该法作出的定罪，证实了该特别行政区政治多元化和言论自由的削弱。我们对公众、媒体和外交官的旁听受到限制感到遗憾”。

新闻稿指出，“2025年7月30日被捕后，区锦新已被不得与外界交流地监禁近一年。欧盟重申，尊重人权和基本自由是《澳门基本法》和‘一国两制’的中心要素。必须确保澳门居民的各项受保护权利和自由得到充分保障，这符合《澳门基本法》、《1987年中葡联合声明》以及澳门在《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》下的承诺”。

周六，中国外交部驻澳门特派员公署发表声明称，“11月6日，澳门特区初级法院依法就区锦新危害国家安全案件作出判决。外交部驻澳门特派员公署坚决支持特区法院上述判决。判决情况公布后，欧盟对外行动署、美国国会及行政当局中国委员会、联合国人权高专办及欧洲议会个别议员对法院依法判决说三道四，污蔑澳门法治、人权状况。外交部驻澳门特派员公署对此强烈不满、坚决反对”。

该机构表示，“我们再次敦促有关国家及国际机构切实尊重中国主权、切实尊重澳门法治，立即停止以任何形式干预澳门事务和中国内政！”

content:
黄仁勋：我们的互动没有异常之处图像来源: Markus Schreiber/AP Photo/picture alliance
（德国之声中文网）这名中国籍女子名叫黄乐（Huang Le，音译），又名爱丽丝（Alice Huang）。美国政府从2024年底、拜登任内尾声，开始调查总部位于新加坡的公司Megaspeed，怀疑它协助中国规避美国的高科技禁令，替中国企业获取英伟达的先进芯片。黄乐是Megaspeed公司的高管。美国政府对她的电子监控已持续一段时间。
监控黄乐的过程中，美国情报机构发现她跟黄仁勋有往来。 《纽时》的报导称，由于黄仁勋对美国总统特朗普在中美核心关切议题上的思考有深入了解，加上美国几乎完全依赖英伟达等企业，维持尖端AI大模型研发领域的主导地位，因此，黄乐与黄仁勋的关系“让人不得不怀疑黄女士是否也在搜集英伟达的内部信息”。
该报导引述多位知情者说法，称黄乐曾在个人社群媒体上发布多张跟黄仁勋的合照，还曾向投资人炫耀两人的关系，借此募集资金。 2024年6月一张被发布在领英（LinkedIn）的照片显示，黄仁勋和黄乐曾在台北的酒吧参加过同一场科技业高层的聚会；隔年5月在台北的一场人工智能供应商的商务晚宴后，他们也曾被看到一起走出餐厅。
英伟达发言人里佐（John Rizzo）回应，黄仁勋身为执行长，跟客户企业的高层见面是他的工作，他与黄乐的互动并不反常。他还表示，像Megaspeed这样的客户，不会接触到英伟达内部敏感的商业机密，更是完全碰不到涉及国安的资讯。
黄仁勋本人29日接受彭博新闻采访，强调英伟达已经进行查核，确保Megaspeed没有非法向中国出口AI处理器，至于他和黄乐的往来，跟他与其他中国客户并无二致：“我们的关系和互动都是跟Megaspeed有关的，而且都完全正常，没有异常之处。”他称黄乐目前已不在Megaspeed任职。
针对此争议，Megaspeed公司向《纽时》表示其现任领导阶层非常严肃看待这件事，已外聘顾问来彻查内部，并全力配合美国政府。黄乐并未回应置评请求。中国驻华盛顿大使馆发言人刘畅则批评美国对中国展开一场“毫无根据的抹黑和诽谤”行动。有记者在周五（10月30日）的中国外交部例行新闻会上问及该报道，发言人郭嘉昆说，有关报道捕风捉影，纯属是对华的污蔑抹黑。

summary: 中国反对美国因第三方指控对企业实施制裁中国劳工公告牌星期日，2026 年 11 月 8 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 中国反对美国因第三方指控而对企业实施制裁 北京强烈谴责华盛顿对两家中国公司的单方面制裁，据报道，这是首次与古巴有关的此类举措。商务部表示，这些措施违反了国际法，并敦促美方纠正错误。中国商务部对美国对两家中国企业实施最新制裁表示强烈反对
content:
中国反对美国因第三方指控对企业实施制裁中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
中国反对美国因第三方指控对企业实施制裁
北京强烈谴责华盛顿对两家中国公司的单方面制裁，据报道，这是首次与古巴有关的此类举措。商务部表示，这些措施违反了国际法，并敦促美方纠正错误。
中国商务部对美国最新制裁两家中国企业表示强烈反对，称此举违反国际法和国际关系基本准则。
商务部发言人在11月7日的一份声明中表示，华盛顿以涉嫌与第三方有牵连为由对中国企业实施单方面制裁。该发言人没有透露第三方的名字，但此前有媒体报道称，此次制裁与古巴有关，这也是美国首次以此为由惩罚中国实体。
商务部表示，此次制裁是美国对华限制更广泛升级的一部分，其中包括多项歧视性措施，严重损害中国企业的合法权益。此类行为背离了两国领导人达成的重要共识，损害了中美经贸关系的稳定。
“我们敦促美方尽快纠正错误做法。” “中方保留采取必要措施维护自身合法权益的权利。”
美国国务院早些时候宣布对两家中国公司实施制裁，但没有具体说明它们的名称或指控的确切性质。

China opposes US sanctions on firms over third-party allegations | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
China opposes US sanctions on firms over third-party allegations
Beijing has strongly condemned Washington's unilateral sanctions against two Chinese companies, reportedly the first such move linked to Cuba. The commerce ministry says the measures violate international law and urged the US to correct the mistake.
China's commerce ministry has voiced strong opposition to the latest US sanctions against two Chinese companies, calling the move a violation of international law and basic norms of international relations.
In a statement on 7 November, a commerce ministry spokesperson said Washington had imposed unilateral sanctions on Chinese firms on the grounds of alleged involvement with a third party. The spokesperson did not name the third party, but earlier media reports suggested the sanctions were linked to Cuba and marked the first time the US had penalised Chinese entities on such grounds.
The ministry said the sanctions were part of a broader escalation of US restrictions against China, including multiple discriminatory measures that seriously harm the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises. It added that such actions deviate from the important consensus reached by the leaders of both countries and undermine the stability of Sino-US economic and trade relations.
“We urge the US side to correct its wrongful practices as soon as possible,” the spokesperson said. “China reserves the right to take necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.”
The US State Department had earlier announced the sanctions against two Chinese companies, without specifying their names or the exact nature of the allegations.

title: 美军成立陆路封锁特遣队 特朗普称习近平同意伊朗不应有核武
source: 新闻汇总 - 茉莉花新闻网
summary: 美军成立陆路封锁特遣队 特朗普称习近平同意伊朗不应有核武 · 茉莉花新闻网 在新标签页中打开 原文链接www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%B8%AD%E4%B8%9C/20261107-%E7%BE%8E%E5%86%9B%E6%8B%9F%E5%AF%BB%E6%B1%82%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6%E4%BC%8A%E6%9C%97%E9%99%86%E8%B7%AF%E8%B4%B8%E6%98%93-%E7%BE%8E%E5%AE%98%E5%91%98%E

美军成立陆路封锁特遣队 特朗普称习近平同意伊朗不应有核武 · 茉莉花新闻网 在新标签页中打开
原文链接www.rfi.fr/cn/%E4%B8%AD%E4%B8%9C/20261107-%E7%BE%8E%E5%86%9B%E6%8B%9F%E5%AF%BB%E6%B1%82%E9%99%90%E5%88%B6%E4%BC%8A%E6%9C%97%E9%99%86%E8%B7%AF%E8%B4%B8%E6%98%93-%E7%BE%8E%E5%AE%98%E5%91%98%E7%A7%B0%E4%B9%A0%E8%BF%91%E5%B9%B3%E5%91%8A%E8%AF%89%E7%89%B9%E6%9C%97%E6%99%AE%E5%90%8C%E6%84%8F%E4%BC%8A%E6%9C%97%E7%BB%9D%E4%B8%8D%E5%BA%94%E6%8B%A5%E6%A0%B8
在对伊朗实施长达数月的海上封锁后，美国军方正组建一支特遣队，以加强华盛顿方面在限制德黑兰通过陆地边境和里海运输先进武器系统及其他受制裁物资方面的努力。
据路透社提前看到的一份声明显示，美国中央司令部将于周六晚些时候正式宣布成立这支此前未曾报道的特遣队。这支名为“铁门特遣队”（Task Force Iron Gate）的部队将驻扎在佛罗里达州坦帕市，并与其他美国政府机构协调行动。除了武器运输外，“铁门特遣队”还将关注军民两用物品和非法收入来源。
美国中央司令部司令库珀（Brad Cooper）在声明中表示：“加强美国中央司令部与美国各部门伙伴的合作，将进一步限制伊朗资助恐怖主义、重建武器工厂和补充军力的能力”。美国中央司令部估计，其海上封锁已阻止伊朗出口价值超过250亿美元的原油。
此外，《华盛顿邮报》外交事务专栏作家伊格内修斯（David Ignatius）周五报导指，鉴于美国公众对伊朗战争的愤怒，找到一条摆脱伊朗战事的脱身之路是最紧迫也是最艰巨的挑战。
美国总统特朗普（Donald Trump）威胁要恢复军事行动，战争部长赫格塞思也已为可能的局势升级做好准备。但美国财政部长贝森特在特朗普的支持下，已向中国进行接触，请求北京方面利用其对伊朗的影响力结束这场战争。据一位消息灵通的美国官员称，中方已将这一信息转达给了德黑兰。
一位消息灵通的美国官员告诉伊格内修斯称，9月两人在华盛顿会晤时，特朗普曾就伊朗问题向习近平寻求帮助，习近平私下告诉特朗普，他同意伊朗绝不应拥有核武器。伊格内修斯说，这一问题将在11月18日深圳峰会上再次出现。据该官员透露，普京也将出席，中方坚持要求此次会晤“很照本宣科”。
特朗普周五表示，美军对伊朗发动了有限打击，目标是伊朗的防空系统。伊朗媒体报道称，两枚导弹击中了格什姆岛。伊通社报导称，当地目击者表示，在听到岛上空传来飞机声后，两枚投射物击中了伊朗南部格什姆岛的苏扎地区。
特朗普在与记者交流时将此次军事行动描述为“小规模行动”。特朗普周五晚抵达佛罗里达州西棕榈滩后不久告诉记者：“他们摧毁了——他们建造了一个小型防空装置，我们大概在15分钟，也许5分钟内就摧毁了它”。
特朗普没有提供更多关于打击目标的细节。但美国官员报告称，伊朗的大部分防空系统在2025年6月以色列的轰炸中以及当前战争初期遭到摧毁或严重破坏。美方官员评估认为，伊朗会随着时间的推移，试图重建和加强其防空系统和其他军事基础设施。
值得一提的是，美军周五表示，华盛顿悬赏2000万美元，并“可能提供搬迁协助”，以获取有关伊朗核计划的信息。美国中央司令部在X平台上表示，美国国务院的“正义奖赏计划”，“悬赏高达2000万美元，并可能提供搬迁协助，以获取有关伊朗核计划的信息，包括其设施、设备和相关人员，例如在科学界的人”。
