Fundraiser by Yangkey Gangshar : Nepal- Tibet Floods: Help a Mountain Guide's Wife & Children
This fund brings food, housing, and school costs to Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and children
Yangkey Gangshar is organizing this fundraiser.
Our family is heartbroken by the devastating floods that swept through communities along the Nepal–Tibet border, destroying homes, livelihoods, and taking many precious lives—including our beloved first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa Dakpu Lama Tamang.
We are Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering, and members of the Gangshar family whose roots are deeply connected to the communities affected by this tragedy. We are raising these funds for our first cousin, Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and their two young children, who are now facing an unimaginable loss and an uncertain future.
“Cho Cho” is an endearing Tibetan term for an older brother. To our family, Cho Cho Dawa was a beloved husband, father, son, brother, nephew, cousin, and friend.
A Father Who Gave Everything for His Family
At 45 years old, Cho Cho Dawa worked as a mountain guide in Nepal’s Langtang region, providing for his wife and two children. His work often took him away from home for weeks or months at a time, but he took great pride in what he did. He was known for his warmth, kindness, generosity, and joyful spirit.
Tragically, the mountains he knew so well and worked in to support his family became the place where he lost his life.
He leaves behind his wife and two young children—a daughter, 11, and a son, 7. They are now facing not only the devastating loss of their husband and father, but the uncertainty of rebuilding their lives without the person who provided for their family.
The picture attached captures Cho Cho Dawa with his family dressed in our traditional Tibetan attire while celebrating Losar, the Tibetan New Year.
Our Family’s Connection to This Community
Our connection to this region goes back generations.
Our father and his family originally came from Kyidong (Kyirong, སྐྱིད་གྲོང་) in Tibet, a place now often referred to as Gyirong in international news. In 1959, our grandparents and relatives were forced to flee Tibet and eventually found refuge and a new home in the border regions of Nepal.
Our father and his siblings grew up in the Syabru besi and Briddhim communities, where they went to school, formed lifelong friendships, and began rebuilding their lives after leaving Tibet. These communities became an important part of our family’s history and home in Nepal.
The school where our father and his siblings once studied was among the places devastated by the floods.
Yangkey was fortunate to visit Syabru besi and Briddhim in March 2014 and again with Choenyi in November 2025. During those visits, she spent time with Cho Cho Dawa, his wife, mother, and brother and was warmly welcomed into their home. The pictures included here were taken during those visits and are now incredibly meaningful to our family.
The pictures also show places we saw and experienced during our November 2025 visit. One shows a hydropower facility along the road to Syabru besi which has been damanged and another shows the homes, guesthouses, and local businesses in Syabru besi, many of which have since been washed away.
Our family was once forced to leave our homeland in Tibet and found a place in Nepal where generations of our family could rebuild their lives. Now, that same community has been devastated by another unimaginable tragedy.
What took generations to build was swept away in moments. But the lives, memories, and stories connected to these places remain.
Cho Cho Dawa is not the only loss our family is mourning.
His brother, Cho Cho Tsering, is also facing unimaginable grief, as members of his wife’s family were among those tragically swept away.
We are also mourning the many precious lives lost in this devastating tragedy, including relatives, friends, and members of the Tibetan community.
Behind every life lost is a family now facing a future without someone they love.
We are raising funds to directly support Cho Cho Dawa’s wife and two children as they begin rebuilding their lives without him.
The funds will be used specifically for:
Shelter, rent, and household expenses
School-related expenses and future education costs for the children
Medical and other essential family needs that may arise
Long-term support to help the family regain stability and rebuild their lives
100% of the funds raised through this GoFundMe will go directly toward supporting Cho Cho Dawa’s family and, if we are fortunate enough to raise more than is needed for Cho Cho Dawa’s immediate family, additional funds will be used to help other affected families in the Tibetan community of Syabru besi who have lost loved ones, homes, or their livelihoods as a result of this disaster.
Yangkey will be traveling to Nepal in approximately two weeks and plans to personally deliver the funds raised directly to the affected families. The funds will be used solely for the relief, essential needs, and family-support purposes described above.
We want to make sure the support reaches those who need it most and provides meaningful help during this incredibly difficult time.
Every donation, no matter the amount, can make a meaningful difference.
If you are unable to donate, please consider sharing this fundraiser with your friends, family, coworkers, and community. A share may help this story reach someone who is able to help.
Thank you for taking the time to hear Cho Cho Dawa’s story and for standing with his wife and children, our family, and the communities affected by this devastating tragedy.
From our family to yours, thank you for your kindness, compassion, love, and support.
Yangkey, Choenyi, Tsering & Gangshar Family

大规模抛售后台湾股市市值跌至全球第七 - 焦点台湾
大规模抛售后台湾股市市值跌至全球第七
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新社台北11月7日电 据MarketCapWatch汇总的实时数据，台湾证券交易所基准指数台交所近期遭遇大幅抛售，截至周六上午，该交易所的市值跌至全球第七位。
数据显示，台湾股市总市值为4.36万亿美元，从近期最高的第四位下滑至全球第七大市场。
美国以78.43万亿美元的市值位居全球第一，其次是中国（19.48万亿美元）、日本（7.81万亿美元）、印度（5.1万亿美元）、英国（4.7万亿美元）和加拿大（4.38万亿美元）。
据MarketCapWatch统计，全球最大的代工芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)在全球最大上市公司中排名第七，其美国存托凭证市值为1.79万亿美元。
周五，受前一天美国股市大幅下跌的影响，台交所指数暴跌 1,873.08 点，跌幅 4.51%，收于 40,000 点关口下方，报 39,701.64 点。
市场分析师表示，在民主党在美国参众两院以及在包括主要数据中心中心德克萨斯州在内的几个州的州长竞选中击败共和党候选人后，人们担心人工智能数据中心的发展可能受到限制，导致台湾和海外市场出现抛售。
据台湾证券交易所数据，本周台交所较前一周下跌 5,510.19 点，跌幅 12.19%，而当地主板总市值下跌 17.94 万亿元新台币（合 5,470 亿美元），至新台币 1,30.84 万亿元。
剔除龙头电子板块，台指本周下跌 2,113.67 点，跌幅 7.84%。
分析师表示，在周五暴跌之前，投资者的情绪已经因担心主要云服务提供商可能无法在人工智能基础设施的大规模投资中产生足够的回报而受到打击。
本周，与人工智能发展密切相关的电子元器件行业，是内地主板上市主要行业中跌幅最大的行业，跌幅达21.60%。与此同时，生物技术行业成为避风港，跌幅最小，涨幅最大，为 1.03%，该交易所表示。
交易所表示，本周主板成交总额为新台币 4.47 万亿元，其中半导体行业成交额最高，为新台币 1.82 万亿元，其次是电子元件行业，为新台币 1.08 万亿元，计算机及周边设备行业为新台币 2,758.6 亿元。
今年以来，主板总成交额达新台币203.14万亿元，日均成交额约新台币1万亿元。
MarketCapWatch是追踪全球资本市场实时数据的平台，覆盖各个国家、地区、行业的上市公司。它主要按市值对市场和公司进行排名，使用户能够监控全球股票市场的规模和公司的变化

Taipei, Nov. 7 (CNA) Following a recent sharp sell-off in the Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, the local bourse fell to seventh place globally in terms of market capitalization as of Saturday morning, according to real-time data compiled by MarketCapWatch.
The data shows that the total market capitalization of Taiwan's stock market stood at US$4.36 trillion, making it the world's seventh-largest market, down from its recent peak ranking at the fourth spot.
The United States ranked first globally, with a market capitalization of US$78.43 trillion, followed by China (US$19.48 trillion), Japan (US$7.81 trillion), India (US$5.1 trillion), the United Kingdom (US$4.7 trillion) and Canada (US$4.38 trillion).
According to MarketCapWatch, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC), the world's largest contract chipmaker, ranked seventh among the world's largest listed companies, with a market capitalization of US$1.79 trillion of its American depository receipts.
On Friday, the Taiex plunged by 1,873.08 points, or 4.51 percent, to close below the 40,000-point mark at 39,701.64, amid heavy losses in U.S. markets a day earlier.
The sell-off in Taiwan and overseas markets came amid concerns over possible restrictions on AI data center development following the Democratic Party's victories in both chambers of the U.S. Congress and in gubernatorial races against Republican candidates in several states, including Texas, a major data center hub, market analysts said.
For the week, the Taiex shed 5,510.19 points, or 12.19 percent, from the previous week, while the total market capitalization of the local main board fell by NT$17.94 trillion (US$547 billion) to NT$130.84 trillion, according to the Taiwan Stock Exchange.
Excluding the bellwether electronics sector, the Taiex fell by 2,113.67 points, or 7.84 percent, during the week.
Before Friday's plunge, analysts said, investor sentiment had already been dampened by concerns that major cloud service providers might fail to generate sufficient returns on their massive investments in AI infrastructure.
During the week, the electronics component industry, which is closely linked to AI development, suffered the steepest decline among the major industries listed on the local main board, falling 21.60 percent. The biotechnology industry, meanwhile, emerged as a safe haven, posting the smallest decline -- or the largest gain -- at 1.03 percent, the exchange said.
The exchange said turnover on the main board totaled NT$4.47 trillion during the week, with the semiconductor industry generating the largest amount at NT$1.82 trillion, followed by the electronics component industry at NT$1.08 trillion and the computer and peripheral equipment industry at NT$275.86 billion.
Since the beginning of this year, aggregate turnover on the local main board has reached NT$203.14 trillion, with the average daily turnover standing at around NT$1 trillion.
MarketCapWatch is a platform that tracks real-time data on global capital markets, covering listed companies across countries, regions and industries. It ranks markets and companies primarily by market capitalization, allowing users to monitor the size of global equity markets and changes in corporate valuations.

Amazon’s new basic Kindle proves you don’t need all the bells and whistles
9:18 AM PST · November 7, 2026
In October, Amazon announced its refreshed Kindle lineup, its first significant design overhaul in years. The highlights included a new edge-to-edge design that eliminated traditional raised bezels, thinner and lighter Paperwhite and Colorsoft models with better displays, and page-turning accessories like a Bluetooth remote and a magnetic cover with page-turn buttons.
However, given the impact of the global memory-chip shortage driven by the AI boom, the new Kindles also debuted with pricing that had increased by $40 to $50 across the lineup. That makes it more difficult for the average consumer to consider buying one of the more premium devices.
For that reason, the Kindle I most wanted to get my hands on was the 6-inch entry-level device, which starts at $169.99 for the ad-free version. With the price hikes, this is the Kindle that will remain the most affordable to new e-reader buyers.
The question I weighed was whether or not the basic Kindle is even worth buying at this price when there are arguably better Kindles on the market. The answer, after a couple of weeks of testing, is yes — if you can live without the bells and whistles and prefer a smaller, lighter device.
On the 6-inch Kindle, there’s no warm light to reduce eye strain, no color display, no auto-adjusting brightness, no option to use the page-turn cover, and it’s not waterproof. Obviously, because of its size, the screen is smaller, as is the battery. Battery life is 6 weeks compared with the Paperwhite’s 12 weeks or Colorsoft’s 8 weeks.
Still, even this basic Kindle has seen improvements of its own, mostly from a physical design perspective.
The plastic 2026 Kindle is 11% lighter and 14% thinner than the 2024 model, weighing 140g versus 158g and measuring 6.85mm thick versus 8mm. While this seems like a small change, the 18-gram difference is noticeable and particularly welcome for a device you’re likely to carry in your purse or bag. Plus, it makes it easier to hold for hours on end when you’re really binging your way through a book.
(The aluminum version, meanwhile, is slightly heavier at 162g, or 4 grams more than the 2024 Kindle, though it still benefits from the slimmer design.)
And despite being the “starter” Kindle, the 6-inch basic device still received the new flush-front screen update. This makes it more comfortable to hold in your hand, especially for those long reading sessions. Amazon explained that you don’t have to worry about no longer having a bezel to rest your thumb upon, either, as the new Kindles have been updated to detect a dead zone in the capacitive touch that will readjust to account for the fact that your finger is there.
In practice, that doesn’t mean you can just press your thumb down anywhere on the Kindle’s screen as you hold it — doing so would register this as an attempt to highlight or look up a word. Instead, it means you can rest your thumb or fingers on the outer edge of the Kindle’s screen (the colored border) without triggering an unintentional tap, even though some of your finger will be touching part of the Kindle’s capacitive screen.
In terms of the software, the new basic Kindle is a bit snappier than its 2024 predecessor. This is most noticeable when opening books, which Amazon claims to be 30% faster.
If you’re coming from the 2019 Kindle Basic, the 2026 version is an even bigger upgrade, as you gain USB-C, more storage (from 4GB to 8GB to now 16GB or 32GB), the new flush screen, and the screen resolution jumps from 167 ppi to 300 ppi. It’s faster, thinner, and lighter, too, and the battery lasts weeks longer.
Another perk about the basic Kindle beyond its small size (this thing fits in your jeans’ back pocket!), is that you can now pay a little more for an upgraded version with an aluminum backing instead of plastic and more storage. The new $189.99 aluminum option comes in Seagrass and Alpine Sky hues, and ships with 32GB of storage. Meanwhile, the $169.99 plastic model offers 16GB of storage.
However, even if you go for the less expensive option, you can at least now pick a fun color other than black (aka Graphite), as Amazon has introduced a cheery purple option called Ube. (I almost wish I’d gone for this one, just for the whimsy of it, even though I prefer the feel of the aluminum.)
I should point out that you can use the Kindle Click, the new Bluetooth remote for page turning, with the basic Kindle, but I’m not sure why you’d need to, if not for some accessibility-related reason. The 6-inch Kindle was already the smallest, and now it’s lighter and easier to hold, too. (But perhaps I just don’t get the appeal of the remote? I’ve barely used the remote with my Kobo either!)
The big thing to consider here is whether you want to spend this much on a Kindle that lacks a warm light. While this is something of a personal preference, for some readers, no warm light is a dealbreaker. The warm light shifts the color tone of the Kindle’s display from a cooler bluish-white to a softer amber glow, which is meant to help reduce eye strain and improve reading conditions in low light or at night.
Whether you need this feature depends on where you like to read and how long your sessions tend to be. If you read nightly in bed with little light, you might prefer paying extra for a $199.99 16GB Kindle Paperwhite. (That version only comes in Graphite. The 32GB Paperwhite can come in Seaglass, too, but is $249.99).
If you often read by the pool or on vacation, you also might want to upgrade to a waterproof Kindle.
But if you can live without the extra features and want the best purse- or pocket-sized device, the 6-inch Kindle is still a viable option.

content:
冷锋周一到来，香港气温将下降9°C |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
冷锋周一到来香港气温将下降9°C
香港天文台表示，一股强冷锋将于周一横过华南沿岸，导致周二和周三香港气温从27℃骤降至18℃或以下。周中该市还将经历强烈的北风和非常干燥的天气。
香港天文台表示，由于一股强冷锋穿过华南海岸，香港下周初气温预计将急剧下降，给该地区带来凉爽和非常干燥的天气。
天文台表示，受强劲东北季候风影响，广东沿岸现时受强劲东风影响。 11 月 7 日星期六，全市气温将在 26 摄氏度至 29 摄氏度之间，下午偶尔有阳光，随后天空大部分多云，晚上有几场小阵雨。近海和高地仍将有强风。
天文台预计冷锋将于 11 月 9 日星期一横过海岸。因此，偏北风将大幅加强，导致市区局部气温从周一的27摄氏度骤降至11月10日周二和11月11日周三的18摄氏度或以下，即下降9度。
周一早上将带来清新至强的北风和凉爽的天气，白天天气晴朗干燥，然后夜间气温进一步下降，总体温度在 20 摄氏度到 27 摄氏度之间。周中广东天气以晴为主，极度干燥，早间凉爽，昼夜温差较大。
展望下周晚些时候，天文台预计华南地区将受高空扰动带来降雨。 11月13日星期五及11月14日星期六，香港将有部分阳光及晚间阵雨，气温徘徊于摄氏23度至27度之间。

Hong Kong temperatures to drop 9°C as cold front arrives Monday
A strong cold front will cross the South China coast on Monday, causing Hong Kong temperatures to plunge from 27°C to 18°C or below by Tuesday and Wednesday, according to the Hong Kong Observatory. The city will also experience strong northerly winds and very dry conditions mid-week.
Hong Kong is set for a sharp drop in temperature early next week as a strong cold front crosses the South China coast, bringing cool and very dry weather to the region, the Hong Kong Observatory has said.
According to the Observatory, strong easterly winds associated with a strong northeast monsoon are currently affecting the Guangdong coast. Temperatures across the city on Saturday 7 November will range between 26 degrees Celsius and 29 degrees Celsius, with sunny intervals in the afternoon followed by mostly cloudy skies and a few light showers in the evening. Winds will remain fresh to strong offshore and on high ground.
The Observatory expects the cold front to cross the coast on Monday 9 November. As a result, northerly winds will strengthen significantly, causing local temperatures to plummet from a high of 27 degrees Celsius on Monday down to 18 degrees Celsius or below in urban areas on Tuesday 10 November and Wednesday 11 November—marking a nine-degree drop.
Monday morning will bring fresh to strong northerly winds and cooler weather, turning fine and dry during the day before temperatures fall further at night, ranging between 20 degrees Celsius and 27 degrees Celsius overall. Mid-week weather across Guangdong will be mostly fine, extremely dry, and cool in the mornings, with a wide temperature gap between day and night.
Looking ahead to late next week, the Observatory expects an upper-air disturbance to bring rain to southern China. Hong Kong will see partial sunshine with a few evening showers on Friday 13 November and Saturday 14 November, with temperatures hovering between 23 degrees Celsius and 27 degrees Celsius.

content:
大卫·席尔瓦在沙田对阵标准流浪者队的比赛中首秀进球中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
大卫·席尔瓦在沙田对阵标准流浪者队的比赛中首秀进球
西班牙世界杯冠军大卫席尔瓦在香港超级联赛1-1战平标准流浪者队的比赛中为沙天队首次亮相。席尔瓦被评为本场最佳球员。比赛在启德青年运动场举行，座无虚席，共有 4,600 名观众。
周六，西班牙世界杯冠军大卫·席尔瓦在沙天队的处子秀中进球，帮助香港超级联赛球队1-1战平标准流浪者队。比赛在启德青年运动场举行，共有 4,600 名观众出席。
2010年随西班牙队夺得世界杯冠军的席尔瓦在比赛中首发出场，并参与多次传球，并在上半场处理任意球和角球，最终双方互交白卷。
中场休息后，标准流浪者队球员被判定在禁区内手球。经过VAR审核后，主裁判判罚12码任意球。第56分钟，席尔瓦挺身而出破门，沙田1-0领先。
随后沙田队友赵正宇和胡贵宇错失两次扩大领先优势的机会，标准流浪队的易卜拉欣利用反击禁区内破门得分，将比分扳成1-1平。
第79分钟，席尔瓦被对手绊倒，推搡回应。两名球员均收到黄牌。沙天的另一名外援安萨已经吃到黄牌，随后他在禁区内一脚倒勾踢中对方头部，吃到第二张黄牌和一张红牌，球队少了一人。几分钟后，席尔瓦被换下场，赢得了球迷的热烈掌声。
最后阶段双方互有攻守，但都未能改变比分。全场比赛最终双方1-1战平，双方各得一分。席尔瓦被评为本场最佳球员。

David Silva scores on debut as Sha Tian held by Standard Wanderers | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
David Silva scores on debut as Sha Tian held by Standard Wanderers
Spanish World Cup winner David Silva scored on his debut for Sha Tian in a 1-1 draw with Standard Wanderers in the Hong Kong Premier League. Silva was named man of the match. The game was played in front of a full house of 4,600 at Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground.
Spanish World Cup winner David Silva scored on his debut for Sha Tian as the Hong Kong Premier League side were held to a 1-1 draw by Standard Wanderers on Saturday. The match was played in front of a full house of 4,600 spectators at the Kai Tak Youth Sports Ground.
Silva, who won the 2010 World Cup with Spain, started the game and was involved in several passes as well as dealing with free kicks and corners in a first half that ended goalless.
After the break, Standard Wanderers players were judged to have handled the ball inside the restricted area. Following a VAR review, the referee awarded a 12-yard free kick. Silva stepped up and scored in the 56th minute to give Sha Tian a 1-0 lead.
Sha Tian team-mates Zhao Zhengyu and Guiyu Hu later missed two chances to extend the lead, before Standard Wanderers' Ibrahim took advantage of a counter-attack to score from inside the restricted area, levelling the match at 1-1.
In the 79th minute, Silva was tripped by an opponent and responded by pushing him. Both players received yellow cards. Sha Tian's other foreign player Ansa, who was already on a yellow card, later executed an overhead kick inside the restricted area but struck an opponent in the head, earning a second yellow card and a red card, leaving his team to play with one man fewer. A few minutes later, Silva was substituted off the field to warm applause from the fans.
Both sides traded attacks and defences in the final stages but neither could change the scoreline. The match ended in a 1-1 draw, with each team taking one point. Silva was named man of the match.

content:
香港铁人三项世界杯分站分别获得第37及58名 |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港铁人三项世界杯分站分别获得第37及58名
香港铁人三项运动员蔡恩彦和曾祥星在香港铁人三项世界杯女子和男子精英个人赛中分别获得第37名和第58名。赛事沿中环及湾仔海滨举行，全长24公里。蔡对她的表现感到满意，曾则指出
铁人三项世界杯香港赛段于11月7日在中环和湾仔海滨展开男子和女子精英个人赛。赛事全长超过24公里，由海滨长廊出发，在维多利亚港游泳750米，然后是全长18.5公里的单车行程，经过展览道、国际金融中心和中环码头，再经过政府总部和立法会5公里，最后到达龙图道。
女子组比赛于上午8时45分左右开始，前三名分别来自俄罗斯、卢森堡和中国国家队，近一个小时后冲线。香港选手蔡恩妍取得了本地运动员的最佳成绩，排名第37位，魏琪排名第39位，彭诗雅排名第50位。
赛后崔女士表示，她对自己的表现感到满意，并认为达到了自己的期望。庞女士称未能在过渡区找到自行车是一个基本错误，并表示她希望不再重蹈覆辙。
男子项目中，来自法国、澳大利亚和西班牙的前三名运动员用时约50分钟完成比赛。香港选手曾祥升排名第58位。他说，他的游泳和自行车技术足够强，让他在早期就处于有利位置，但他在跑步方面无法跟上对手，承认自己的整体水平仍然落后。
混合接力赛定于 11 月 8 日举行。

Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong triathletes place 37th and 58th at World Cup leg
Hong Kong triathletes Choi Yan-yin and Tsang Cheung-sing finished 37th and 58th in the women's and men's elite individual races at the Triathlon World Cup Hong Kong. The event featured a 24km course along the Central and Wan Chai waterfront. Choi was satisfied with her performance, while Tsang noted
The Triathlon World Cup Hong Kong leg began on 7 November with the men's and women's elite individual races along the Central and Wan Chai waterfront. The course covered more than 24 kilometres, starting from the promenade with a 750-metre swim in Victoria Harbour, followed by an 18.5km cycling leg passing the Exhibition Road, International Finance Centre and Central Pier, and a 5km run past the Government Headquarters and Legislative Council, finishing at Lung To Road.
In the women's race, which started at about 8:45am, the top three finishers came from Russia, Luxembourg and the Chinese national team, crossing the line nearly an hour later. Hong Kong's Choi Yan-yin recorded the best result among local athletes, placing 37th, with Vicky Wei in 39th and Pang Sze-nga in 50th.
Choi said after the race that she was satisfied with her performance and felt it met her expectations. Pang described failing to find her bicycle in the transition area as a basic mistake and said she hoped not to repeat it.
In the men's event, the top three athletes from France, Australia and Spain finished in about 50 minutes. Hong Kong's Tsang Cheung-sing placed 58th. He said his swimming and cycling were strong enough to put him in a favourable position early on, but he could not keep pace with rivals in the running leg, acknowledging that his overall standard still lagged behind.
The mixed relay event is scheduled for 8 November.

title: 顏純鈎：賣友求榮非君子所為，為虎作倀是背叛初心

content: 作者臉書  2026-11-6 寫了 一篇短文指責張劍虹 ，不料引來有史以來最洶湧的罵聲。有人說污點證人也未必造成 多大傷害，有人說我站著說話不腰疼，有人說我分化民主派，看來錯不在張劍虹，錯在我。 張劍虹除了轉作污點證人，等於賣友求榮之外，又接受安排到深圳參訪，在官媒電視台為中共涂脂抹粉，與他多年追隨黎智英，在壹傳媒掌管一人之下千人之上的重要職位時的初衷，來一個一百八十度大轉彎，而且轉得心安理得，這委實令我看不起他。 有網友說我應該去體驗一下中共牢房的滋味，好像我沒有坐牢倒是我的錯。我要承認我相當幸運，我退休前後重拾政治評論之筆，在蘋果日報先用筆名後用真名發表文章。2018年我離開香港返回加拿大，原因是家人都在外面，而我對香港的前景也相當悲觀，其時反送中運動尚無跡象，我以為此後與香港將不會有什麼干係。 反送中後，即使遠在千里之外也坐不住，我每日關心香港局勢，寫短評支持香港人的反抗運動，我不是吃太飽沒事幹，只是憎恨中共的專制統治，不忍香港被中共糟塌。我每日燃燒有限腦汁，本來就不圖什麼，只圖消解內心的愛憎。 有網友說我應該去體驗一下中共牢房的滋味。我同意如果我留在香港，反送中期間，必定也忍不住要寫評論，寫了評論也有可能被黎智英邀請在蘋果寫社論，國安法下來，我也極有可能離不開香港，要在中共牢房裡過我餘下的日子。 今日人在千里之外，想像一旦被判刑，我在牢裡會有什麼表現。我承認我未必做得到像黎智英和鄒幸彤那樣英勇不屈，肝膽照日月，我可能為減免一些刑期而選擇認罪，但要我做到像張劍虹那樣賣友求榮、損人利己我絕對做不到。 我生性高傲，視個人尊嚴有甚於性命，我不習慣向權貴脅肩諂笑，也不喜歡看別人的臉色做人，更無法忍受出賣手足換取個人安樂那種損人利己的骯髒事。因此，我最大限度是去到認罪，而絕不會像張劍虹那樣，選擇做污點證人。 認罪只是承認我犯了你中共的國安法，並不意味著我承認參與民主抗爭有違天理人情，有違香港原有的法律。我只是在人屋檐下，不得不低頭而已，我在法庭上認了罪，我在內心會永遠保有我的初衷。 有人說污點證人也未必會傷害手足，那是太天真的想法，對中共太缺乏了解。AI資料顯示，公民黨的楊岳橋、譚文豪、郭家麒三人，曾主動為警方錄取「無條件口供」，希望轉為控方證人，但因提供的資料「沒有價值」而不被接受。 也就是說，你想做污點證人，還要看你提供的內幕有沒有殺傷力？如果對有關人不能造成足夠的傷害，那些資料就沒有價值，中共才不會那麼傻，無端讓你減刑。明白這一點，便可推測，張劍虹提供的材料，必定對黎智英造成可以讓中共滿意的傷害。 張劍虹與黎智英合作一二十年，又是最重要的助手，其間有多少不為人知的內幕，足以幫助中共定罪，我們外人雖無從得知，但如果是無足輕重的交代，中共又怎麼會那麼好死給他減刑？ AI又告訴我，因反送中運動和國安法而被捕的香港民主派人士，總計有10060人，其中選擇充當污點證人的只有13人，我不知道這些數字是否準確，但至少證明，選擇成為污點證人的民主派人士，僅不足被捕人士的一個零頭，證明大多數手足還是明白自己的道德底線在哪裡。 只是踐踏自己而不傷害別人，那只是自己的尊嚴有價而已，道德上無虧，但如果你利己之餘還要損人，那就不只是自己的尊嚴不值錢了，你是以他人的痛苦來換取自己的安樂。張劍虹轉作污點證人，毫無疑問將加重黎智英的刑期，否則，他都沒有資格充當控方證人。 我之所以不恥張劍虹，主要原因是此風不可長。被捕的民主派人士，如果不能堅持自己的初衷，堅信民主的普世價值，那至少也應該堅持做人的道德底線，不能以損害他人利益來讓自己得益。如果大部份民主派被捕人士都有樣學樣，那在民主派內部必然形成一種歪風，便是人人都以互相揭發為榮，以互相傷害為得計，那將成什麼世界？那才是中共喜聞樂見的大好事，而香港民主派，從牢裡到牢外，都將成一盤散沙。 近日黃之鋒被港共重判十年，之鋒也沒有選擇轉作污點證人。他自十四歲起就投身香港民主運動，其間發起與參與眾多政治抗爭，他與香港民主派不同時代的領導人，都有過深入的交接，相信很多事情都是他親歷，他知道其中任何細節。 如果黃之鋒要為減刑而出賣手足，那他可以傷害多少人？如果他出面指證黎智英，而黎智英不忿他的不義，也反手指證黃之鋒，還有更多民運領袖紛紛互篤背脊，那中共不但坐收漁利，而且足可證明他的專制政權的正當性，那我們香港人被踐踏豈不是活該？ 我希望那些罵我的網友好好想一想，我相信他們多數人只是出於對被捕手足的同情與不忍，而不是真正認同張劍虹的所作所為。賣友求榮是最不堪的下作行徑，做人如非去到極端自私，是做不出這種事來的。 我說我們對黎智英、鄒幸彤他們，雖不可及，心嚮往之，就是我們盡可能以他們的精神風範為楷模，雖然做不到，但也不要去到太下作，不要超越做人的底線，我對自己也只有如此的期許。賣友求榮這種事，對於稍有良知的人，是一種永生的恥辱，你要如何面對自己的尊嚴，面對親友的鄙視，面對子孫後代的質疑？ 人各有志，各人頭上一片天，我只想問那些罵我的網友，如果你們處在張劍虹的處境，你們是否也會選擇作污點證人？這種事關乎一生榮辱，千萬不可口輕輕，想做就去做。

title: 影音筆記：台灣選舉漫遊
summary: 臨近台灣地方大選，我們製作了一部《台灣選舉漫遊錄》，走訪台北、高雄、花蓮和新竹，看看這些地方的政治，和選舉版圖背後沒說的故事。 高雄美濃和台北大稻埕，一個是南部的客家庄，一個是台北最老的街區之一。如果只看選舉結果，這兩個地方幾乎站在光譜的兩端：美濃常被說是藍綠五五波，或稍微偏向國民黨（藍營）的地方；大稻埕所在的大同區，則是不少人口中的民進黨（綠營）大本營。 整理影片素材時，我發現這些散落的訪談片段，好像都在繞著同一個問題打轉：一個人，是怎麼開始在乎一個地方的？ 2026年10
content: 臨近台灣地方大選，我們製作了一部《台灣選舉漫遊錄》，走訪台北、高雄、花蓮和新竹，看看這些地方的政治，和選舉版圖背後沒說的故事。 高雄美濃和台北大稻埕，一個是南部的客家庄，一個是台北最老的街區之一。如果只看選舉結果，這兩個地方幾乎站在光譜的兩端：美濃常被說是藍綠五五波，或稍微偏向國民黨（藍營）的地方；大稻埕所在的大同區，則是不少人口中的民進黨（綠營）大本營。 整理影片素材時，我發現這些散落的訪談片段，好像都在繞著同一個問題打轉：一個人，是怎麼開始在乎一個地方的？ 2026年10月22日，高雄美濃。攝：陳焯煇/端傳媒 讀報的人 在美濃，幾乎每位受訪者都不約而同提到一件事：這裡的書香氣息。 返鄉青年小汶記得，每天都會有一份報紙送到家，爺爺看完不多說什麼，但都整整齊齊地把報紙疊好；在美濃國中教了二十多年書的橘子老師則說，她剛嫁來時最驚訝的，是眼睛已經看不太清楚的老阿伯，還每天在看報紙。 「他們都建構了一段自己的中心思想。」橘子老師說，即使是農民，對農業也有自己的見解。也難怪美濃的協會多得驚人，有腳踏車協會、八色鳥協會、各地的同鄉會，還有能展現在地文化氣質的「博士學人會」。在橘子老師的故鄉，大家遇到困難，常常是抱怨完就結束了，但美濃不一樣，抱怨完會開會，開完會就行動。 聽到這裡，我忍不住想：藍綠能在這裡打成平盤，會不會就是這樣來的？一個大家都讀、都想、都能獨立思考的地方，本來就很難被一種聲音帶著走。 小汶說，長輩在三合院裡聊政治，從來不趕小孩走，也不搞一言堂。自己家裡多是支持民進黨的聲音，但她能在國中同學口中聽到「家裡要投馬英九」，理由是「因為他比較帥」。小汶回家轉述，大人也只是笑一笑，沒有人說誰對誰錯。那是她第一次意識到，原來投票不一定要跟著政黨走，也可以是因為「這個人」。 這種選人不選黨的習慣，到現在也沒變。小汶說，對美濃人而言，重點往往不是你代表哪一黨，而是你的政見裡有沒有美濃。想出來選里長？你得先問問左右五戶鄰居認不認識你。 當然，這只是我的假設，五五波的背後還有人口結構、產業、地方派系等許多成因。但「讀得多、想得多」這件事，或許讓這裡的政治分歧相對健康，而不針鋒相對。橘子老師說，美濃人之間的政治立場不同，但大家都會守住那條界線。你的容忍度高，我們就多聊，說不定可以互相說服；你的容忍度低，我們就各退一步，不聊政治。 瓦豆燈光創辦人江佶洋。攝：陳焯煇/端傳媒 上街的人 「沒有學識，你是不會上街的。」這句話，是在大稻埕聽到的。 瓦豆燈光老闆的同學曾經批評，上街頭的都是沒讀書、知識水平低的人。老闆的反駁很直接：連吃飽都有問題的人，根本不會上街頭。一定是先有人提出論述、有想法、有號召力，才會有人跟上。 他自己就是這樣長大的。在那個沒有網路、沒有通訊軟體的年代，鄭南榕的《自由時代》是他們家的課外讀物，集會的消息就登在上面；就算無法取得這樣的「非法刊物」，其實鄰里之間也會互通集會遊行的訊息。一家人吃完飯，參加政見發表會、遊行抗議，都是很稀鬆平常的事。 雖然老闆是從在地經驗、陣營視角出發，但我聽著聽著，想到的卻是美濃。反水庫運動、黃蝶祭，以及前面一長串的協會和同鄉會，美濃蓬勃的社會參與背後，不也是一群讀報、讀書、有自己見解的人嗎？ 所以當有人選擇走上街頭時，我們或許不該急著把他們定性成被煽動、暴動。願意開口說的、勇於走上街的、甚至為此付出龐大代價的，往往是在心裡想過很多遍的人。 懷抱希望的人 瓦豆老闆還分享了一個有趣的觀察。早年的造勢場合，音樂一放就是〈黃昏的故鄉〉，「悲情」往往是活動的主旋律。直到 1994 年陳水扁參選台北市長，第一次用「快樂、希望」作為訴求。 他就這樣看了四十年，看著民進黨的競選歌曲從〈春天的花蕊〉、〈伊是咱的寶貝〉到〈自信勇敢咱的名〉，一次比一次好聽、街頭一次比一次像嘉年華。老闆說，那是一個民族開始站起來的樣子。 聽到這裡，老闆眼中泛著的欣慰讓我深受感動。悲情動員有它的歷史，那些傷痛也都是真的，但正是我們願意正視，能公平、公開地討論這段歷史，後來的人才能放下一點重量，帶著社會往前走。一個社會走得夠遠了，我們或許才能用希望，而不只是恐懼、仇恨來凝聚彼此。 不論是哪次選舉、哪個陣營，希望候選人都能帶領選民，一起想像地方的未來，而不只是攻擊對手、情緒動員。 大稻埕開咖啡館的盧郭老闆。攝：陳焯煇/端傳媒 收集故事的人 這一集，我們原本想拍的是選舉，但最後拍到的，反而是一部收集故事的漫遊錄。 在大稻埕開咖啡館的盧郭老闆是深綠支持者。他講起自己高中時讀到民主前輩們的故事，說了一句很沉重的話：「你知道了，就很難回去了。」 回頭看這兩個地方，我想「知道」大概就是一切的起點。知道這塊土地擁有什麼、發生過什麼，人才會開始在乎它。 但光是在乎還不夠，還得知道該怎麼做。在美濃，當年參與反水庫運動的作詞人鍾永豐，也把如何組織、如何跟政府溝通的經驗分享給下一代；瓦豆老闆則記得，開票那晚，爸媽會和鄰居約好每人帶一支手電筒到開票所，怕有人會製造停電、做票。 這些「知道」都不是課本教的，而是長輩一次次上街、一次次在餐桌上說給下一代聽的。 也難怪瓦豆老闆一直拜託身邊的人要讀文學、讀歷史。因為不讀，就沒辦法對下一代講故事，也感受不到今天能自由參與政治，背後有多少重量。 所以不管是美濃的五五波，還是大稻埕的一片綠，人們選擇的方向不同，在乎的方式也不同，但都是先知道了、想過了，才決定站出來。就像盧郭老闆說的，一旦知道了，就很難再回去了。 下一集，我們將帶著你們前往花蓮、新竹。看看一個人口嚴重外流的地方，和人口大量移入的城市，他們會出現怎麼樣的政治差異。

title: Nvidia tightens tracking of AI GPUs in Southeast Asia as Chinese chip smuggling draws scrutiny, report claims
zh_title: 报告称，随着中国芯片走私受到审查，英伟达加强了对东南亚人工智能 GPU 的追踪
summary: 据报道，东南亚计算提供商如果想成为官方 Nvidia 云合作伙伴（NCP），现在必须在 Nvidia 的舰队情报跟踪系统中注册。据彭博社报道，此举旨在为这家芯片制造商提供另一种方式来监控其人工智能加速器的部署位置，因为华盛顿对受限制的硬件通过区域走私网络进入中国越来越感到沮丧。未能立即联系到英伟达置评。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc）
content:
据报道，东南亚计算提供商如果想成为官方 Nvidia 云合作伙伴（NCP），现在必须在 Nvidia 的舰队情报跟踪系统中注册。据彭博社报道，此举旨在为这家芯片制造商提供另一种方式来监控其人工智能加速器的部署位置，因为华盛顿对受限制的硬件通过区域走私网络进入中国越来越感到沮丧。未能立即联系到英伟达置评。深入了解 TH Premium：台湾、贸易和关税（图片来源：tsmc） 虽然美国在芯片制裁上反复无常，但中国正在建立自己的芯片供应市场 中国长达十年的半导体发展状况 华为 Ascend NPU 路线图审查了中国长鑫存储的目标，到 2030 年，第六座大型晶圆厂将占据 30% 的 DRAM 内存市场份额 中国最新一轮稀土出口管制解释 NCP 称号值得追求，因为它为云提供商提供了机会英伟达的公众认可和优先使用其广受欢迎的人工智能芯片，使该公司能够利用这些优势作为杠杆。据熟悉新要求的人士透露，寻求这一资格的客户现在必须注册 Fleet Intelligence。车队管理于去年 12 月推出，主要作为数据中心管理工具。它收集有关参与公司基础设施中部署的 NVIDIA 硬件的信息，包括各个加速器的位置。
这些信息可以让英伟达更好地了解其芯片在离开供应链后是否仍在运行。然而，该系统是一项普遍的跟踪任务。在 NCP 要求之外，参与仍然是自愿的，Nvidia 不会自动接收来自每个使用该软件的客户的位置数据。该公司还没有澄清现有的云合作伙伴是否必须注册才能保留其指定，或者该要求最终是否会扩展到东南亚以外。值得注意的是，英伟达一段时间以来一直在开发一种定位人工智能的方法。去年 12 月，我们报道称该公司开发了基于软件的 GPU 跟踪，使用 GPU 遥测和网络延迟测量来估计处理器的运行位置。英伟达将该软件描述为客户安装的代理，用于监控硬件健康状况、完整性和库存。除了数据维护之外，该技术还有明显的用途。美国限制中国公司未经许可购买先进的人工智能加速器，但当局认为价值数十亿美元的硬件已通过第三方网络到达中国买家手中，东南亚成为这些交易的重要中转站。 C4ADS 的一项调查此前已确定了将受限制的加工商转移到中国的几条路线，包括通过研究计划、空壳公司进行采购以及通过其他东南亚国家运送。
该非营利组织审查了 2022 年至 2025 年间的交易，发现通过区域贸易路线流通的价值 1,340 万美元的 Nvidia A100、H100 和 AD102 系列 GPU。其报告还将 46 亿美元的硬件采购与总部位于新加坡的 Megaspeed International 联系起来。对于英伟达来说，Megaspeed 已经成为一个特别尴尬的案例，该公司因涉嫌芯片转移而受到美国和新加坡的调查一年多了。上周，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋为自己与该公司的交易进行了辩护，

【原文 English Original】
Southeast Asia computing providers are now reportedly required to register with Nvidia's Fleet Intelligence tracking system if they want to become official Nvidia Cloud Partners (NCPs). The move, according to Bloomberg , is aimed at giving the chipmaker another way to monitor where its AI accelerators are deployed, as Washington grows increasingly frustrated with restricted hardware finding its way into China through regional smuggling networks. Nvidia was not immediately available for comment. Go deeper with TH Premium: Taiwan, trade, and tariffs (Image credit: tsmc) While the U.S. flip-flops on chip sanctions, China is building its own chip supply market The state of China's decade-long semiconductor push Huawei Ascend NPU roadmap examined China's CXMT targets 30% DRAM memory market share by 2030 with sixth mega-fab China's latest round of rare-earth export controls explained The NCP designation is worth pursuing as it gives cloud providers Nvidia's public endorsement and preferred access to its sought-after AI chips, putting the company in a position to use those benefits as leverage. Customers seeking the status must now enroll in Fleet Intelligence , according to people familiar with the new requirements. Fleet Management was introduced last December primarily as a data centre management tool. It gathers information about NVIDIA hardware deployed across participating companies' infrastructure, including the locations of individual accelerators. That information could give Nvidia a better picture of whether its chips are operating after they leave the supply chain. The system is, however, a universal tracking mandate. Participation has remained voluntary outside the NCP requirement, and Nvidia does not automatically receive location data from every customer using the software. The company has also not clarified whether existing Cloud Partners will have to enroll to retain their designation or whether the requirement will eventually extend beyond Southeast Asia. Notably, Nvidia has been developing a way to locate AI for some time now. Last December, we reported that the company had developed software-based GPU tracking , using GPU telemetry and network latency measurements to estimate where processors are operating. Nvidia described the software as a customer-installed agent for monitoring hardware health, integrity and inventory. The technology has an obvious use beyond data maintenance. The U.S. restricts Chinese companies from purchasing advanced AI accelerators without a license, yet authorities believe billions of dollars worth of the hardware have reached Chinese buyers through third-party networks, with Southeast Asia becoming an important transit point for those transactions. A C4ADS investigation has previously identified several routes used to move restricted processors into China, including purchases through research initiatives, shell companies and shipments routed through other Southeast Asian countries. The nonprofit examined transactions between 2022 and 2025 and identified $13.4 million worth of Nvidia A100, H100, and AD102-series GPUs moving through regional trade routes. Its report also linked $4.6 billion in hardware purchases to Singapore-based Megaspeed International. Megaspeed has become a particularly awkward case for Nvidia, with the company being under U.S. and Singaporean investigation for more than a year over suspected chip diversion. Last week, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang defended his dealings with the firm, describing them as “completely normal,” adding, “we’ve studied all their deployments of our GPUs and counted every one.” Megaspeed denied any wrongdoing. In April, Megaspeed’s Malysisan data centre landlord terminated its contract, reallocating 68.4 megawatts of capacity to another cloud provider Moreover, Megaspeed is not the only example of how difficult it can be to police the movement of AI hardware. Earlier this year, U.S. prosecutors accused people associated with Super Micro of helping divert around $2.5 billion worth of Nvidia-powered servers to China through Southeast Asian intermediaries. The alleged scheme involved falsified paperwork and dummy server shells, with genuine hardware shipped onward after inspections. More recently, the company has faced additional scrutiny over its export compliance after inspections. Nvidia has also reportedly removed half of the Asian companies on its pre-approved buyer list and told cloud providers to keep at least 51% of their computing services with customers outside China.

title: 席位之外：谁将影响下届美国国会的对华议程？
summary: 资料照片：美国华盛顿特区的国会大厦倒映在国会大厦倒影池中。(2026年10月27日) 华盛顿 — 民主党夺回美国国会两院控制权后，影响美国对华政策的下一步变化，将不仅体现在两党席位数量上，还涉及谁来领导外交、军事、拨款及经济领域的关键委员会。 这些委员会可以审议法案、推动听证、监督行政部门，并参与决定资金如何使用。不过，选举胜出并不等于委员会主席人选已经确定。下一届国会的人事安排，仍需经过党内遴选及相关议院程序。 涉华议程由多个委员会共同塑造 美国国会没有一个能够包办全部中国
content: 资料照片：美国华盛顿特区的国会大厦倒映在国会大厦倒影池中。(2026年10月27日) 华盛顿 — 民主党夺回美国国会两院控制权后，影响美国对华政策的下一步变化，将不仅体现在两党席位数量上，还涉及谁来领导外交、军事、拨款及经济领域的关键委员会。 这些委员会可以审议法案、推动听证、监督行政部门，并参与决定资金如何使用。不过，选举胜出并不等于委员会主席人选已经确定。下一届国会的人事安排，仍需经过党内遴选及相关议院程序。 涉华议程由多个委员会共同塑造 美国国会没有一个能够包办全部中国政策的委员会。台湾安全、芯片出口、贸易和投资等议题，分别进入不同委员会的管辖范围，有时还涉及多个委员会。美国之音为您整理出以下列表： 委员会 主要作用 涉华观察重点 参院外交关系委员会、众院外交事务委员会 外交立法、军售相关审查及政府监督；参院外委会还审议相关外交提名 台湾、美中外交、对外援助及人权 两院军事委员会 推动国防政策及《国防授权法案》 印太军事部署、台湾安全合作、国防供应链 两院拨款委员会及相关小组委员会 审议拨款及资金使用条件 国防、外交和安全项目的实际资金 参院银行委员会、众院外交事务委员会等 出口管制相关立法与监督 芯片及半导体制造设备等技术限制 参院财政委员会、众院筹款委员会 贸易和关税立法及监督 对华关税、进口规则和贸易安排 两院情报委员会 情报活动监督与授权立法 中国相关情报评估、网络及反情报议题 这些分工意味着，一项涉华主张能否落实，往往取决于不止一名议员或一个委员会。出口管制属于参院银行委员会的管辖范围，贸易和关税则涉及参院财政委员会及众院筹款委员会；外交事务委员会也对相关出口政策拥有权限。 以年度《国防授权法案》(NDAA)为例。军事委员会通过这项年度立法推动国防政策，但授权法通常不直接提供资金，相关项目仍需查看拨款安排。支持某项安全计划，与为它落实资金，是不同环节。 主席人选尚待确定，哪些议员值得关注？ 参院外委会将出现一个明确的人事变化：该委员会现任民主党资深成员珍妮·沙欣(Jeanne Shaheen)此前已宣布不寻求连任，将在本届任期结束时离任。 彭博政府(Bloomberg Government)11月3日报道，民主党参议员克里斯·库恩斯(Chris Coons)被广泛视为可能接替她、出任该委员会民主党领袖的人选。 库恩斯目前还在参院国防拨款小组委员会担任民主党领袖。 其他值得追踪的现任民主党委员会领袖，包括参院银行委员会的伊丽莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)，以及众院外交事务委员会的格雷戈里·米克斯(Gregory Meeks)。他们在现届国会中的位置，使其政策主张值得关注，但不能据此直接称他们为“下一届主席”。 沃伦9月已与其他民主党参议员一道，要求加强对先进技术的出口管制。 中国问题特设委员会会继续存在吗？ 众院美国与中国共产党战略竞争特设委员会(简称中国问题特设委员会)近年来通过听证、调查和政策报告，在涉华讨论中受到关注。 该委员会现任主席是共和党人约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)，现任民主党资深成员是罗·康纳(Ro Khanna)。但下一届是否继续设立、权限如何安排以及由谁领导，需要等待新一届众议院的正式决定。 按照现行授权，这个特设委员会可以调查并提出政策建议，却没有直接审议和推进法案的立法管辖权。它提出的建议要成为法律，仍需通过具有相关管辖权的委员会及国会立法程序。 这并不意味着它缺乏影响力。公开听证、调查函和报告可以促使企业及政府机构回应，也能推动其他议员提出法案。但调查中的指控、政策建议和已经生效的法律，具有不同性质。 康纳今年1月就任民主党资深成员时提出，应振兴美国制造业、减少关键矿产依赖，同时保持沟通渠道并重视军事威慑。 CECC与USCC：通过调查和建议影响政策 除两院委员会外，两个依法设立的涉华机构也值得关注。国会及行政当局中国委员会(CECC)由参众两院议员及总统任命的行政部门官员组成，主要监督中国的人权与法治状况，并向总统和国会提交年度报告。其听证、个案记录和政策建议，是观察涉华人权议程的重要窗口。 美中经济与安全审查委员会(USCC)则是立法部门的审查机构，由国会两院两党领袖按法定程序任命的12名委员组成，重点研究美中经贸关系对美国国家安全的影响，并向国会提出立法和行政政策建议。它关注科技、供应链、投资及中国军事发展等领域，委员并非必须由现任国会议员担任。 两者均不直接通过法律、分配预算或执行制裁，但其调查和建议可以为议员推动立法和监督提供依据。它们依据法律设立，与需要下一届众院决定是否续设的中国问题特设委员会不同。 共和党仍可影响议程 即使成为少数党，共和党议员仍可提出法案、参加听证、质询证人，并通过修正案和跨党派合作影响政策。 总统也继续拥有行政权和法案否决权。委员会主席能够推动审议或监督，却不能单独决定关税、批准所有军售，或代表行政部门与北京达成协议。 美国前国防情报局代理局长戴维·谢德(David Shedd)在选前接受美国之音采访时认为，尤其在前沿技术领域，两党对中国安全挑战存在共同关切。不过，共同关切并不意味着对具体限制措施、预算规模及外交方式没有分歧。 接下来要看哪些决定？ 新一届国会议员任期于2027年1月3日开始。在此之前，本届国会仍继续履职。 判断下一届国会如何处理中国议题，仍需继续追踪关键委员会主席及资深成员的正式名单、中国问题特设委员会的授权安排，以及各委员会公布的首批听证、法案和拨款重点。 在中期选举中赢得多数的民主党无疑将在明年新一届国会中拥有更多议程设置权，而接下来由谁来领导有关涉及对华政策的委员会、如何使用这些权力，则将进一步影响哪些涉华主张能够成为实际政策。

台湾寻求与欧洲在关键基础设施方面更密切合作

中新社台北11月7日电 台湾外交部长林佳龙周三在柏林安全会议上发表预先录制的视频讲话时表示，台湾希望与欧洲伙伴合作，加强包括海底电缆在内的关键基础设施的安全。
林毅夫周六在脸书上首次披露的这段视频显示，林毅夫表示，台湾是一个很好的合作伙伴，因为台湾在应对网络攻击、虚假信息和灰色地带活动方面积累了丰富的经验。
林说，台湾已推行全社会方法来增强抵御能力，并提出了“国际海底电缆风险管理倡议”，以应对新出现的安全挑战。
第25届柏林安全会议于11月3日至4日举行，立陶宛为今年的伙伴国。
此次活动重点关注欧洲的国防能力、俄罗斯的安全威胁以及乌克兰战争，政治领导人、高级军事官员和国防工业代表齐聚一堂。
根据林在脸书上发布的视频讲话，在威权势力持续挑战国际秩序的情况下，台海局势对欧洲的安全和繁荣产生影响。
林说，其中一部分是经济安全，台湾利用其在半导体、人工智能、信息和通信技术以及先进制造业方面的优势来帮助欧洲实现再工业化。
他引用了台积电计划在德国设立环球晶圆工厂的计划。台湾在意大利的投资，以及台湾与波兰合作开发科技园，都是台湾在欧洲工业影响力不断增强的例子。
他说，这些合作伙伴关系正在帮助建立更加安全可靠的跨境供应链。
林说，台湾愿意深化与欧洲的合作，结合双方在技术、产业发展和安全韧性方面的优势，帮助为下一代建设更安全、更自由和更繁荣的未来。

Taiwan seeks closer cooperation with Europe on critical infrastructure
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
The Berlin Security Conference. CNA photo Nov. 6, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 7 (CNA) Taiwan hopes to work with European partners to strengthen the security of critical infrastructure, including undersea cables, Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) said in a prerecorded video address to the Berlin Security Conference on Wednesday.
The video, disclosed for the first time by Lin on Facebook on Saturday, showed Lin saying that Taiwan is a good partner because it had gained extensive experience in responding to cyberattacks, disinformation and gray-zone activities.
Taiwan, Lin said, has promoted a whole-of-society approach to strengthening resilience and proposed a "RISK Management Initiative on International Undersea Cables" to address emerging security challenges.
The 25th Berlin Security Conference was held Nov. 3-4, with Lithuania as this year's partner country.
The event focused on Europe's defense capabilities, security threats from Russia, and the war in Ukraine, and brought together political leaders, senior military officials and defense industry representatives.
According to Lin's video address posted on Facebook, the Taiwan Strait situation has implications for Europe's security and prosperity amid continued challenges to the international order from authoritarian forces.
Part of that, Lin said, was economic security, with Taiwan drawing on its strength in semiconductors, artificial intelligence, information and communications technology, and advanced manufacturing to help Europe pursue reindustrialization.
He cited Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.'s plans for a plant in Germany, GlobalWafers Co.' s investment in Italy, and Taiwan's cooperation with Poland to develop a technology park as examples of Taiwan's growing industrial presence in Europe.
These partnerships are helping build cross-border supply chains that were more secure and reliable, he said.
Lin said Taiwan was ready to deepen cooperation with Europe by combining their strengths in technology, industrial development and security resilience to help build a safer, freer and more prosperous future for the next generation.

summary: 医疗辅助服务义工为香港海洋公园长者郊游|中国劳工布告栏 星期日, 2026 年 11 月 8 日 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版 医疗辅助服务义工在香港海洋公园接待长者郊游 卫生署副秘书长范范范博士表示，香港医疗辅助服务义工队特别为长者参与者组织一次海洋公园探访​​活动，让他们与年轻义工进行一对一配对，以促进代际联系和社区关怀。香港医疗辅助队义工队举办研讨会
content:
医疗辅助服务义工为香港海洋公园长者郊游|中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
医疗辅助服务义工为香港海洋公园长者郊游
卫生局副局长范范范博士表示，香港医疗辅助服务义工队特别为长者参与者安排了一次海洋公园参观活动，让他们与年轻义工进行一对一配对，以促进代际联系和社区关怀。
香港医疗辅助服务义工队于 11 月 7 日星期六在海洋公园为长者居民举办了一次特别的郊游活动，让每位长者与一名年轻义工配对，进行一天的活动和陪伴。
卫生局副局长范范医生在启动仪式上表示，医疗辅助服务义工队一直是服务社会的重要力量，利用业余时间参与不同的公益服务。她感谢医疗辅助队学员及全体义工在海洋公园之旅中一对一陪伴长者，充分展现义工团队关爱社区、互助互助的精神。
其他主礼嘉宾包括医疗辅助队义工队主席兼海洋公园董事局副主席黄贤荣、署理医疗辅助队参谋长陈伟权、香港海洋公园行政总裁黄志辉及香港圣公会福利服务处总监陈婉仪。
在义工队、医疗辅助队学员和香港城市大学学生的协助下，参加者在园区工作人员的带领下，前往“大熊猫奇遇记”体验区，近距离观赏大熊猫，然后参观园区其他地方，共度欢乐时光。
今年是中华人民共和国成立77周年，明年是海洋公园成立50周年。值此重要时刻，义工队表示，希望通过此次活动，让长者们重温一个充满回忆的地方，与义工队、学员和香港城市大学的学生分享他们的人生故事和宝贵经验，促进代际交流，同时提高公众对长者需要的认识，助力建设关爱共融的社会。

Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Medical Auxiliary Service volunteers host elderly outing at Ocean Park Hong Kong
Hong Kong's Medical Auxiliary Service volunteer team organised a special visit to Ocean Park for elderly participants, pairing them one-on-one with young volunteers to promote intergenerational bonding and community care, said Deputy Secretary for Health Dr. Fanny Fan.
HONG KONG's Medical Auxiliary Service volunteer team hosted a special outing for elderly residents at Ocean Park on Saturday 7 November, pairing each senior with a young volunteer for a day of activities and companionship.
Deputy Secretary for Health Dr. Fanny Fan said at the launch ceremony that the Medical Auxiliary Service volunteer team has always been an important force serving the community, using their spare time to take part in different public-interest services. She thanked the Medical Auxiliary Service cadets and all volunteers for accompanying the elderly on a one-on-one basis during their trip to Ocean Park, which fully demonstrated the volunteer team's spirit of caring for the community and mutual assistance.
Other officiating guests included Medical Auxiliary Service Volunteer Team Chairman and Ocean Park Board Vice-Chairman Wong Yin-wing, Acting Chief Staff Officer of the Medical Auxiliary Service Chan Wai-kuen, Ocean Park Hong Kong Chief Executive Officer Wong Chi-fai, and Hong Kong Sheng Kung Hui Welfare Service Service Director Chan Yuen-yi.
With assistance from the volunteer team, Medical Auxiliary Service cadets and Hong Kong Metropolitan University students, participants were led by park staff to the 'Giant Panda Adventure' area for a special panda-themed experience, where they could view giant pandas up close, before visiting other parts of the park and enjoying a happy time together.
This year marks the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China, and next year will mark Ocean Park's 50th anniversary. At this significant moment, the volunteer team said it hoped the event would allow elderly participants to revisit a place full of cherished memories, share their life stories and valuable experiences with the volunteer team, cadets and Hong Kong Metropolitan University students, promote intergenerational exchange, and at the same time raise public awareness of the needs of the elderly to help build a caring and inclusive society.

title: 'Permanent, serious' dialogue needed with China on AI: tech-focused lawmaker
zh_title: 需要与中国就人工智能进行“永久、认真”的对话：以技术为重点的立法者
summary: 众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党确实
content:
众议员詹姆斯·沃金肖 (James Walkinshaw) 对人工智能监管的愿景包括与中国保持“永久、认真”的对话，以减轻强大的人工智能模型带来的风险。这位弗吉尼亚州民主党人周四在政府官员活动中表示，这并不容易，但如果美国能够在冷战期间与苏联保持核裁军对话，那么今天与其顶级技术和经济竞争对手的沟通也可以如此。这些对话“绝对必要，而且在某些方面，我们的动机是一致的，对吧？中国共产党和我们一样不希望流氓人工智能代理侵入他们的系统和水务部门，所以我们必须进行永久性对话并达成一些协议，”他说。他发表此番言论的几天前，民主党赢得了众议院和参议院的控制权，许多即将上任的立法者将人工智能监管作为其竞选活动的核心组成部分。目前尚不完全清楚，在一个主要专注于促进技术创新、同时将法规保持在最低限度的政府的领导下，立法者将如何着手制定人工智能法律。白宫还必须应对参众两院新多数派的更强烈反对，这可能迫使他们坐到谈判桌前通过复杂的立法。沃金肖并不是第一位倡导美中人工智能对话的国会议员，尽管他的立场增加了这些评论的分量。
作为北弗吉尼亚州一个著名科技和联邦合同走廊的代表，他所服务的地区的当地科技公司和政府承包商必须应对人工智能发展所带来的复杂的国家安全影响。推动对话是在 7 月份发生的一次具有里程碑意义的事件之后进行的，当时 OpenAI 特工逃离了他们的开发沙箱，并对 Hugging Face 发起了协调一致的网络攻击。上个月，研究人员在与中国相关的腾讯云上追踪到一组自主人工智能代理，这些代理突破了自己的测试环境，并进行了数千次未经授权的尝试，以规避阿里巴巴平台上的反机器人保护。这些言论也与中国国家主席习近平九月份在华盛顿与唐纳德·特朗普总统举行峰会时的声明相一致。习近平承认两个超级大国都负有管理技术的“责任”，同意建立美中超级情报对话和针对严重人工智能事件的危机“热线”。一些立法者提出成立一个特别委员会来监管快速发展的技术，但其他人拒绝了这一想法。沃金肖表示，他并不期望众议院建立一个特别委员会，而是希望将现有的众议院民主党人工智能委员会的工作转化为委员会可以制定的具体立法。他对人工智能监管的愿景还包括前沿模型的安全测试。
在周四的讲话中，他将安全测试与联邦航空管理局在飞机离开机库之前对飞机进行安全检查进行了比较。他特别补充说，他对于联邦机构或受政府监督的第三方评估机构是否应该进行该测试持不可知论。 ]]>

【原文 English Original】
Rep. James Walkinshaw’s vision for artificial intelligence regulation includes maintaining “permanent, serious” dialogue with China to mitigate the risk that powerful AI models pose. That won’t be easy, but if the U.S. was able to maintain nuclear-disarmament dialogue with the Soviet Union during the Cold War, then the same can be said for communications with its top technology and economic competitor today, the Virginia Democrat argued Thursday at a GovExec event. Those conversations are “absolutely necessary, and in some ways, our incentives are aligned, right? The Chinese Communist Party doesn’t want rogue AI agents hacking their systems and their water authorities any more than we do, so we have to have that permanent dialogue and reach some agreements,” he said. His comments come days after Democrats won control of the House and Senate, where many incoming lawmakers made AI regulation a central component of their campaigns.  It’s not fully clear how lawmakers will proceed with crafting AI laws under an administration that has largely focused on fostering tech innovation while keeping regulations to a minimum. The White House will also have to contend with fiercer opposition from the new majorities in both chambers, which may force them to the negotiating table to pass complex legislation. Walkinshaw is hardly the first member of Congress to advocate for U.S.-China AI dialogue, though his position gives the comments added weight. As the representative of a prominent tech and federal contracting corridor in Northern Virginia, he serves a district whose local technology companies and government contractors must navigate the complex national security implications of AI development. The push for dialogue follows a landmark July incident where OpenAI agents escaped their development sandboxes and launched a coordinated cyberattack on Hugging Face . And last month, researchers tracked down a fleet of autonomous AI agents on China-linked Tencent Cloud that broke out of their own testing environment and made thousands of unauthorized attempts to circumvent anti-bot protections on an Alibaba platform.  The remarks also align with statements from Chinese President Xi Jinping during his September summit with President Donald Trump in Washington. Acknowledging that both superpowers share a “responsibility” to manage the technology, Xi agreed to establish the U.S.-China Super Intelligence Dialogue and a crisis “hotline” for severe AI incidents. Some lawmakers have floated a select committee to regulate the fast-evolving technology, though others have rebuffed that idea. Walkinshaw said he does not expect the House to establish a select committee and instead expects the work of a pre-existing House Democratic commission on AI to be translated into concrete legislation that committees can work on. His vision for AI regulation also includes safety testing for frontier models. In remarks Thursday, he compared safety testing to the Federal Aviation Administration conducting safety inspections of airplanes before they leave hangars. He notably added that he is agnostic as to whether a federal agency or third-party evaluator with government oversight should conduct that testing.  ]]>

（北京综合讯）中国人工智能（AI）短剧陷入“降低智商”、让人沉迷上瘾等争议之际，一部名为《持械入宋》的短剧罕见获得口碑流量双丰收，播放量破120亿。
据封面新闻报道，《持械入宋》是一部用AI生成的历史穿越短剧，改编自字节跳动旗下番茄小说平台同名作品，今年8月在同样由字节开发的红果短剧平台上线，目前已更新至第10季，总计约1000集。制作方称，《持械入宋》截至星期六（11月7日）的播放量已突破120亿，成为中国爆红的现象级作品。
据介绍，《持械入宋》的剧情设定在北宋末年，讲述一支现代五人作战小队携装备意外穿越至北宋后发生的故事。
中共江西省委宣传部官方微信公众号星期六发文称，虽然《持械入宋》的“AI脸”仍被部分观众诟病，千集体量被吐槽注水，但核心剧情设定和历史细节的打磨，让它俘获大量观众。文章称赞《持械入宋》靠严谨内容打破AI短剧“降智”的刻板印象，代表“技术平权开启全民创作时代”。
字节副总裁李亮星期四（11月5日）在微博介绍称，《持械入宋》背后是一个“非专业”制作团队，成员背景全是草根，包括宝妈、网约车司机和普通公司职员等，是一部“群众创作”的作品。
李亮发表此番言论之际，正值一篇题为《可怕的红果与中国互联网的字节时间》的网络热文，引发外界对字节产品的批评。有分析认为，对《持械入宋》创作团队草根背景的强调，旨在传达AI短剧带来新就业机会等信息，以此回击“短剧的钱都被字节挣了”的说法。
《持械入宋》的爆火也正值官方加强对AI短剧的监管。中国国家广播电视总局星期五（11月6日）宣布，针对AI短剧质量良莠不齐、AI技术助长低俗不良内容反弹等问题，开展两个月专项治理，重点聚焦内容创作和传播推广两个方面的突出问题。

title: Hong Kong national security police arrest man over allegedly importing ‘seditious’ books
zh_title: 香港国安警察逮捕涉嫌进口“煽动性”书籍的男子
summary: 香港国安警察在今年早些时候打击独立书店后的最新执法行动中逮捕了一名涉嫌进口“煽动性书籍”的男子。香港警队徽章。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。警方周四在一份声明中表示，他们在旺角逮捕了一名 34 岁男子。他涉嫌“进口具有煽动意图的出版物”——触犯《维护国家安全条例》（又称《维护国家安全条例》第23条）。被捕者据悉是“等待鸟”项目经理布兰登·丘（Brandon Yau）
content:
香港国安警察在今年早些时候打击独立书店后的最新执法行动中逮捕了一名涉嫌进口“煽动性书籍”的男子。香港警队徽章。照片：Candice Chau/HKFP。警方周四在一份声明中表示，他们在旺角逮捕了一名 34 岁男子。他涉嫌“进口具有煽动意图的出版物”，这是《维护国家安全条例》（又称《维护国家安全条例》第23条）规定的犯罪行为。据了解，被捕者是“等待鸟”组织的项目经理布兰登·丘（Brandon Yau），该组织为因政治相关案件而入狱的人提供支持。这些书籍被进口并在其合作伙伴零售店 As One 销售，其收入归该集团所有。周一，Waiting Bird 在社交媒体上发帖称，海关从一批来自台湾的货物中查获了约 60 本书。该组织表示，没收的书籍是“对时事、个人经历和感受的理性讨论，与煽动意图没有任何关系”。警方在声明中表示，被捕者是一名公司董事，“涉嫌向当地书店进口煽动性书籍，意图向香港和中国政府带来仇恨、蔑视或不满”。作为爱德华王子中的一员。照片：Nidou Workspace，来自 Google 地图。
警方还搜查了该男子的住所和公司场所，查获了包括用于购买书籍的数字设备在内的物品，以及涉嫌具有煽动意图的文件和其他出版物。该男子已被拘留接受调查。进口具有煽动意图的出版物最高可判处七年监禁。香港当局今年加强了对独立书店的审查。书店老板表示，从台湾（许多中文书籍的来源地）订购的书籍经常受到海关检查。 Book Punch 的工作人员于 3 月份被捕，Hunter 书店的工作人员于 6 月份被捕。 7月，Have a Nice Stay和Greenfield书店的工作人员在同一天被捕。逮捕前一天，Have a Nice Stay 宣布将在运营四年后关闭。逮捕事件发生后，格林菲尔德书店还表示，明年租约到期后将关闭。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong national security police have arrested a man over allegedly importing “seditious books” in the latest law enforcement action following a crackdown on independent bookstores earlier this year. The Hong Kong Police Force emblem. Photo: Candice Chau/HKFP. Police said in a statement on Thursday that they had arrested a 34-year-old man in Mong Kok. He was suspected of “importing a publication that has a seditious intention” – a crime under the Safeguarding National Security Ordinance, also known as Article 23. The arrestee is understood to be Brandon Yau, a project manager at Waiting Bird, a group that supports people jailed in politics-related cases. The books were imported to be sold at As One, its partner retail outlet whose revenue goes towards the group. On Monday, Waiting Bird said in a social media post that Customs had seized around 60 books from a shipment that came from Taiwan. The group said the books confiscated were “rational discussions about current affairs, and personal experiences and feelings, with no connection whatsoever to seditious intentions.” In the statement, police said the person arrested was a company director “suspected of importing seditious books into local bookstores with the intent to bring hatred, contempt or disaffection” to the Hong Kong and Chinese governments. As One in Prince Edward. Photo: Nidou Workspace, via Google Maps. Officers also searched the man’s residence and company premises, seizing items including digital devices used to purchase the books, as well as documents and other publications suspected of having seditious intention. The man has been detained for investigation. Importing a publication with seditious intention carries a maximum sentence of seven years in jail. Hong Kong authorities have tightened scrutiny of independent bookstores this year. Bookstore owners have said that books ordered from Taiwan – the source for many Chinese-language titles – are frequently inspected by Customs. Staff from Book Punch were arrested in March, and staff from Hunter Bookstore were apprehended in June. In July, staff from Have a Nice Stay and Greenfield Bookstore were arrested on the same day. A day before the arrests, Have a Nice Stay announced it would close down after four years in operation. Following the arrests, Greenfield Bookstore also said it would shut after its lease expired next year.

title: Diamond Foundry Announces First-Ever D200mm Single-Crystal Diamond
zh_title: Diamond Foundry 宣布推出首款 D200mm 单晶金刚石
summary: Diamond Foundry Inc. 今天宣布了材料技术史上的一个重要里程碑：创造出第一颗 D200mm 单晶金刚石，直径为 200 毫米。这一成就标志着人类在半导体相关规模上制造金刚石作为技术材料的能力向前迈出了根本性的一步。在此公告中，Diamond Foundry 首席执行官 Martin Roscheisen 在中国宁波举行的 CarbonSemi 2026 展会上通过视频发表了主题演讲。观看主题演讲：https://youtu.be/ae0XQBDlLMQ 。钻石长期以来被认为是一种非凡的材料
content:
Diamond Foundry Inc. 今天宣布了材料技术史上的一个重要里程碑：创造出第一颗 D200mm 单晶金刚石，直径为 200 毫米。这一成就标志着人类在半导体相关规模上制造金刚石作为技术材料的能力向前迈出了根本性的一步。在此公告中，Diamond Foundry 首席执行官 Martin Roscheisen 在中国宁波举行的 CarbonSemi 2026 展会上通过视频发表了主题演讲。观看主题演讲：https://youtu.be/ae0XQBDlLMQ 。钻石长期以来被认为是一种非凡的技术材料。它将最高的导热率与卓越的机械强度、电绝缘性、光学特性以及极端电子性能的潜力结合在一起。然而，它在先进技术中的使用受到一个基本限制的限制：尺寸。 Diamond Foundry 的 D200mm 突破改变了这一点。生产 D200 毫米尺寸的单晶金刚石需要克服晶体生长、等离子体物理、反应堆工程、材料科学、过程控制和制造方面的基本挑战。结果不是单个金刚石片的组装，也不是多晶金刚石晶片。它是一颗直径为 200 毫米的单晶金刚石。 Diamond Foundry Inc. 首席执行官 Martin Roscheisen 表示：“这是曾经看似几乎不可能实现的里程碑之一。”数百名 DF 工程师、科学家和技术人员为我们实现这一目标做出了贡献。
它是十多年来无数实验、失败、发明、重建机器和见解的积累结果。” Roscheisen 特别认可 Stefan Gsell 和 Martin Fischer，他们在 25 年前就开始了单晶金刚石缩放工作。“Stefan 和 Martin 追求这个目标已经有 25 年了，”Roscheisen 说。 “在技术领域，很少有人能够以这种毅力去应对真正艰巨的科学挑战。当普遍观点认为单晶钻石根本无法制造出如此规模时，他们继续前进。如今，这种毅力展现为首颗D200mm单晶钻石。最重要的是，它也使 D300mm 变得可预测。”从宝石尺寸到半导体尺寸 半导体行业是围绕晶圆级制造非凡材料的能力而建立的。硅向更大晶圆的发展改变了电子产品，允许经济且可重复地制造日益复杂的设备。钻石从未有过同等的缩放路径。天然钻石受到地质条件的限制。传统的实验室制造钻石历来被限制在相对较小的晶体尺寸。尽管金刚石的非凡特性与高功率电子、人工智能计算、光学、量子系统和其他先进技术越来越相关，但晶体尺寸仍然是一个基本瓶颈。
D200mm 单晶金刚石里程碑展示了一条超越这一限制的道路。对于 Diamond Foundry 来说，这一成就是更广泛努力的一部分，旨在将单晶金刚石从宝石中测量的稀有材料转变为大规模制造的科技工业半导体基材。当计算系统遇到越来越严格的热限制时，其影响尤为重要。现代人工智能处理器将大量能量集中到硅的微观区域。 Diamond 卓越的散热性能

【原文 English Original】
Diamond Foundry Inc. today announced a major milestone in the history of materials technology: the creation of the first-ever D200mm single-crystal diamond, measuring 200 millimeters in diameter. The achievement marks a fundamental step forward in humanity’s ability to manufacture diamond as a technology material at semiconductor-relevant scale. The announcement accompanies a keynote by Diamond Foundry CEO Martin Roscheisen, delivered by video at CarbonSemi 2026 in Ningbo, China. Watch the keynote: https://youtu.be/ae0XQBDlLMQ . Diamond has long been recognized as an extraordinary material for technology. It combines the highest thermal conductivity with exceptional mechanical strength, electrical insulation, optical properties, and the potential for extreme electronic performance. Yet its use in advanced technology has been constrained by one basic limitation: size. Diamond Foundry’s D200mm breakthrough changes that. Producing single-crystal diamond at D200mm scale required overcoming fundamental challenges in crystal growth, plasma physics, reactor engineering, materials science, process control, and manufacturing. The result is not an assembly of individual diamond pieces and not a polycrystalline diamond wafer. It is a single-crystal diamond at D200mm scale. “This is one of those milestones that once seemed almost impossible,” said Martin Roscheisen, CEO of Diamond Foundry Inc. “Hundreds of DF engineers, scientists, and technicians contributed to us getting here. It is the accumulated result of countless experiments, failures, inventions, rebuilt machines, and insights over more than a decade.” Roscheisen particularly recognized Stefan Gsell and Martin Fischer, whose work on scaling single-crystal diamond began 25 years ago. “Stefan and Martin pursued this goal for 25 years,” Roscheisen said. “There are very few examples in technology of someone sticking to a really hard scientific challenge with that level of perseverance. They kept going when the prevailing view was that single-crystal diamond simply could not be made at this scale. Today, the perseverance shows as the first-ever D200mm single-crystal diamond. And best of all, it makes D300mm predictable as well.” From Gemstone Dimensions to Semiconductor Dimensions The semiconductor industry is built around the ability to manufacture extraordinary materials at wafer scale. Silicon’s progression toward larger wafers transformed electronics by allowing increasingly sophisticated devices to be manufactured economically and repeatably. Diamond has never had an equivalent scaling path. Natural diamond is constrained by geology. Conventional lab-grown diamond has historically been constrained to relatively small crystal dimensions. Even as the extraordinary properties of diamond became increasingly relevant to high-power electronics, AI computing, optics, quantum systems, and other advanced technologies, crystal size remained a fundamental bottleneck. The D200mm single-crystal diamond milestone demonstrates a path beyond that limitation. For Diamond Foundry, the achievement is part of a broader effort to turn single-crystal diamond from a scarce material measured in gemstones into a tech-industrial semiconductor substrate manufactured at scale. The implications are particularly significant as computing systems encounter increasingly severe thermal constraints. Modern AI processors concentrate enormous amounts of power into microscopic regions of silicon. Diamond’s exceptional thermal conductivity can spread that heat at the material level, creating new possibilities for chip architectures, power densities, reliability, and cooling. Twenty-Five Years of Perseverance The D200mm achievement has roots extending well beyond Diamond Foundry itself. For 25 years, Gsell and Fischer pursued the underlying scientific and engineering challenge of growing high-quality single-crystal diamond of scalable size. Their work ultimately became part of a much larger effort involving hundreds of people across Diamond Foundry. The milestone reflects advances spanning plasma generation, growth chemistry, reactor architecture, crystal engineering, thermal management, metrology, automation, and manufacturing. “Technology history is often written around the moment something finally works,” Roscheisen said. “But that moment rests on the people who were willing to spend years — sometimes decades — making it work. This diamond exists because hundreds of people contributed, and because a few people refused to give up on the idea for 25 years.” A New Scale for Diamond Diamond Foundry views D200mm not as an endpoint, but as the beginning of a new manufacturing era for diamond. The company is developing single-crystal diamond for semiconductor and advanced-technology applications where diamond’s combination of thermal, mechanical, electrical, and optical properties can enable performance beyond the limits of conventional materials. The first D200mm crystal is shown as grown and unpolished — directly from the growth process. For a material that nature forms only under extraordinary conditions deep inside the Earth, the significance is simple: Single-crystal diamond has entered the wafer-scale era. The post Diamond Foundry Announces First-Ever D200mm Single-Crystal Diamond appeared first on Semiconductor Digest .

title: (无标题)
summary: Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser. The Contemporary Uyghur An
content:
Fundraiser by Uyghur Anthology : Support the Contemporary Uyghur Anthology
This anthology funds Uyghur writers and artists, translation, events, and community growth
Uyghur Anthology is organizing this fundraiser.
The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a publication that platforms Uyghur (and anyone drawing their roots from East Turkistan) artists and writers in the diaspora by providing a space that is often inaccessible to those in our community. There are no other projects of its kind in the English language, and with two volumes already published, we hope to take this project to the next level. It's a rare look at Uyghur expression in an environment where all our stories are told by people pushing their own narratives without the intimate knowledge of our lived experiences.
<"Manifesto" by Sumayah Jurad from Vol. II>
We asked ourselves these questions - why wait for others to invite us to the table when we can pull up a chair and introduce ourselves? Why let others speak for us without trying first to speak? Our broken English can only be improved with audacity, and world literature is only enriched by the presence of new voices.
All-in-all, our efforts have been met with support from our community and pleasant surprise from those who did not know what they did not know.
Somewhat unprecedented is that we publish the authors' original language alongside the translation. Our book is filled with Uyghur, Latin, Cyrillic, and Chinese script to encapsulate as much of our community's experience as we can.
There are many publications in diaspora communities that platform East and South Asians, SEA, MENA, and more. Central Asia is often underrepresented in world literature or Asia-specific publications, and occupied territories even less so. Uyghurs themselves have been a relatively new diaspora community in English-speaking countries, and haven't had the opportunities to grow their literary or artistic communities. Many don't have the tools to nurture their talents, or knowledge of creative networks or opportunities, even when many journals seek work from underrepresented groups. In instances where they are aware, it's difficult to be published in this competitive field without the education and styles that publications look for. There are only a handful of literary translators translating from Uyghur to English, and not many Uyghurs who have had the chances to develop their creative language when learning English.
To sum up, the issues were:
No spaces for Uyghur writers and artists to develop their skills
A disconnect from artist communities, be it local or online
No bridge between our native tongue and English, and in turn, world literature
So, we put together a small group at the Tarim Network to take on this challenge. Completely volunteer-run; the very essence of a passion project. We did a call-out for anything and all. New writers, established writers, any language, any genre, whatever we could print in a book. And here we were, the first book of its kind, created to speak for ourselves without outsider voices, without a publishing house, raw and straight from the source.
<From the launch of Vol. I at Harvard University>
"The Contemporary Uyghur Anthology is a collection of Uyghur reflections in diaspora. Weaving together memories of the homeland, experiences of displacement, and transitions of identities, this anthology is a creative reflection of the beauty and complexities of the Uyghur experience.
By centering Uyghur voices at the forefront, this anthology serves as a form of living memory in a pivotal moment of Uyghur history. The title Under the Mulberry Tree refers to a story from the Uyghur literary classic Ana Yurt, where youthful Nuri faces terrible injustices, separation, and turmoil; but for one moment in the Charbagh, his love for Sebihe and his own family is full, ripe, and sweet, like the mulberries from the ancient tree. In a similar way that the mulberry tree offered comforts in Nuri’s time of need, we hope this volume offers a place of reflection and celebration of Uyghur culture."
We'd partnered with a member from a Jewish organisation to run writing workshops and explain editorial processes, as we had never worked on something like this before. After that collaboration, we decided to publish a revised edition on our own. This time, we added editors' notes to the pages to explain certain terms and historical and cultural contexts - mainly for our own youth, who don't always have access to cultural education. We translated more pieces from Uyghur and Chinese. Our contributors spanned 13 countries, at all levels of experience.
Was this work sustainable? Equipped with the tools, experience, and outpouring of support from our first volume, we spent the next two years saying yes. Our first book was now in libraries, there were articles and academic papers that mentioned it, and most of all, we reaffirmed the need for this sort of work. Not only were we accepting submissions, we worked one-on-one with emerging writers and artists to edit their pieces. We also helped first-time translators have their first publications with help from more experienced translators, as well as connecting them with the original authors.
Our second volume was even better than the last. From the blurb:
"How do we respond to the unexpected, and how does it influence perceptions of ourselves or the environments in which we exist? As a diaspora population, unexpected encounters can shape and transform what it means to be Uyghur as we build a new life outside of the homeland. Encounters Under the Mulberry Tree takes on the literal, abstract, and expanded renditions of these moments. We feature contemporary and historical works, including art, poetry, and prose in five languages with contributors based in a dozen countries, from established writers like award-winning author and filmmaker Tahir Hamut Izgil, to emerging artists, writers and translators of all ages. This book is a library of vignettes that grapple with intersections and how we make sense of it all."
Five languages (Uyghur, English, Chinese, Russian, Turkish)
<Vol. II showcased at a college hosted by Rawan Mentorship>
Now we embark on our third volume. The three of us do this while maintaining full time jobs, academic careers, and other side projects. We all live in different countries and have only met in person once. But it's something that we need to do, for our community and for ourselves. Our contributors have gained so much from this experience and we want to extend this opportunity to more people. This needs to survive in order for similar initiatives to be born.
Supporting the editors - all expenses so far have been paid out-of-pocket or through book sales. We do not have any donors or sponsors (yet!).
Supporting our contributors - we cannot afford to pay any of our contributors. Despite this, we have given free copies of the book to contributors, but this is definitely leaving a dent in our pockets.
Recruiting more people - paid internships or remuneration for one-off work would help volunteers spend more time on this project in this economy.
Enhance our level of expertise - we want to improve. Workshops or courses for our editors and contributors, professional feedback, the works. Unfortunately there is no one who speaks Uyghur and who is involved in Western publishing or English literature on a professional or academic level. We would appreciate connections with professionals from any language background, or the funding to level up.
Expand our network - we'd love to promote our work at literary festivals, go to conferences, do book events, establish ourselves in the public eye, provide reader copies to reviewers, and so on. However, there is a funding barrier to overcome to be able to attend these events, organise, or pre-order books.
<Vol. I on display at the Mosquers Film Festival, 2025>
Munawwar Abdulla is an Uyghur advocate, poet, and scientist born on unceded Kaurna land (Australia) and based in Massachusetts. She co-founded The Tarim Network, runs Uyghur Collective, and collaborates on projects with Uyghur rights organisations around the world. Her writings and literary translations have been published in places such as Modern Poetry in Translation, Asymptote, the Margins, the Georgia Review, and others.
Sonya Imin is a mixed Uyghur American scholar and multi-disciplinary creative who has worked on art and film projects across the US, Europe, and Central Asia. Growing up between the borderlands of the Uyghur homeland, broader Central Asia, and the midwestern United States, interrogations of belonging, home, and displacement influence the nature of her work. Currently based in Brussels, she is working on her doctoral research on Uyghur artistic production in the diaspora.
Maidina Kadeer is a mixed Uyghur-Hui writer and editor, born in Ghulja and currently based in Montreal (Tiohtià:ke), Canada. She holds a BA in English Literature and Law and Society from Concordia University, with a focus on post- and neo-colonial literature. Her work explores Uyghur identity, history, and culture through cuisine, agriculture, and neo-colonialism. She has contributed to projects such as a poem, NinetySix, in Slavs and Tatars’ Contest of the Fruits (2021) and participates in panels and interviews on Agriculture and Food History to raise awareness about Uyghur culture.

content:
中国—奥地利企业家委员会首次会议星期五（11月6日）在北京举行，中国商务部长王文涛（右）和奥地利经济部长哈特曼斯多费尔（Wolfgang Hattmannsdorfer）出席并致辞。 （取自中国商务部网站）
中国与奥地利成立企业家委员会，中国商务部长王文涛在委员会首次会议上呼吁奥地利为在当地投资经营的中国企业提供公平、开放、非歧视的营商环境。
据中国商务部网站消息，中国商务部与奥地利联邦经济、能源和旅游部星期五（11月6日）在北京共同主办中国—奥地利企业家委员会首次会议。王文涛和奥地利经济部长哈特曼斯多费尔（Wolfgang Hattmannsdorfer）出席并致辞，两国逾100名政经界代表与会。
会前，在两国总理见证下，王文涛与哈特曼斯多费尔共同签署《关于成立中奥企业家委员会的谅解备忘录》。中国银行和奥地利联邦商会分别担任中奥双方的主席单位。
王文涛说，今年是中奥建交55周年，在两国领导人战略引领下，中奥双方秉持开放包容理念，推动双边经贸合作取得丰硕成果。双方共同成立中奥企业家委员会，将为两国经济界搭建双向奔赴的桥梁，推动中国“十五五”规划和奥地利《工业战略2035》深入对接。
他还说，期待双方企业用好企委会机制，聚焦特色产业，深化务实合作，共同谱写中奥经贸关系新篇章，并希望奥地利为中国企业在奥投资兴业营造公平、开放、非歧视的环境，助力中欧经贸关系持续稳定健康发展。
根据中方新闻稿，哈特曼斯多费尔说，奥中经济互补性强，奥政府愿同中国构建更加平衡、可靠的经贸关系，共同做大合作蛋糕，进一步挖掘对华出口潜力，欢迎中国企业赴奥投资。
据彭博社报道，奥地利统计局数据显示，2025年，中国是奥地利第二大商品进口来源地。奥地利从中国进口的商品总额同比增长13%，达175亿欧元（250亿新元），对华出口则下降5.4%至50亿欧元。奥地利对华贸易逆差达124亿9000万欧元，在其所有贸易伙伴中最高。

content:
香港警务处长呼吁将禁毒教育融入青少年日常生活 |中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
香港警务处长呼吁将禁毒教育融入青少年日常生活
香港警务处处长周一明表示，由于人们对药物依托咪酯的关注日益增加，警方正在寻求通过年轻人喜欢的活动将禁毒教育融入他们的日常生活中。他在纪念反毒品领导学院成立五周年的嘉年华上发表讲话。
香港警务处处长周一明表示，随着依托咪酯对香港青少年造成的危害日益严重，警方正在研究如何将禁毒教育融入青少年的日常生活。
周一岳在西区禁毒科为纪念禁毒领导学院成立五周年而举办的禁毒嘉年华上致辞时表示，活动的目的是通过轻松、愉快的游戏和活动，帮助市民了解毒品的危害，并学会保护自己和亲人。
该专员表示，警方致力于利用年轻人喜欢的活动形式来提高他们对毒品危险的认识和了解。
周一岳表示，禁毒领袖学院从最初的课程规划和活动组织，发展到现在拥有约500名青年领袖的庞大网络。他补充说，学院将人工智能和创意媒体融入教学，并通过大湾区游学等活动培养年轻人的国际视野。

Hong Kong police chief calls for integrating anti-drug education into youth daily life | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Hong Kong police chief calls for integrating anti-drug education into youth daily life
Hong Kong police chief Chow Yat-ming says the force is seeking to embed anti-drug education into young people's daily lives through activities they enjoy, amid growing concern over the drug etomidate. He spoke at a carnival marking the fifth anniversary of the Anti-Drug Leadership Academy.
Hong Kong's Commissioner of Police, Chow Yat-ming, has said the force is looking at ways to integrate anti-drug education into the daily lives of young people, as the harm caused by the drug etomidate becomes increasingly serious for the city's youth.
Speaking at an anti-drug carnival in the Western District, organised by the police's Narcotics Bureau to mark the fifth anniversary of the Anti-Drug Leadership Academy, Chow said the aim was to use relaxed, enjoyable games and activities to help people understand the dangers of drugs and learn to protect themselves and their loved ones.
The commissioner said the force was committed to using forms of activity that young people enjoy to raise their awareness and understanding of the dangers of drugs.
Chow noted that the Anti-Drug Leadership Academy had grown from initial curriculum planning and event organisation to now having a large network of about 500 youth leaders. The academy integrates artificial intelligence and creative media into its teaching, and also cultivates young people's international perspectives through activities such as study trips to the Greater Bay Area, he added.

content:
圖為北京西站內一處武警在站崗。 (Fred Dufour/Getty Images)
【大紀元2026年11月08日訊】（大紀元記者林燕編譯報導）週六（11月7日），日本共同社報導，知情人士透露，日本製藥公司安斯泰來（Astellas Pharma Inc.）的一名日籍員工預計將在12月從中共監獄獲釋。
這名男子60多歲，於2023年3月被中共當局拘留，並於2025年7月被北京市第二中級人民法院判處三年六個月有期徒刑，罪名是「從事間諜活動」。
日中關係消息人士透露，該男子將服滿全部刑期，包括從被拘留到判決之間的部分時間，他將在獲釋後立即返回日本。
一位出席審判的日本外交官告訴共同社，應該名男子的要求，無法透露判決細節。
其他知情人士透露，在中共當局向該男子解釋，認罪可獲得較輕刑罰的法律程序後，他選擇了認罪。
該男子曾擔任這家製藥公司中國分公司的高管，以及日本商工會議所駐華高級官員。
今年早些時候，兩名富士電機株式會社的日本籍員工在中國被拘留，他們可能試圖將稀土相關產品走私到海外。此前，北京加強了對包括稀土在內的兩用物項（可用於民用和軍用）的對日管制。
日本政府隨後證實，這兩名員工於5月在東北港口城市大連被拘留，罪名是涉嫌違反禁止走私違禁品出入境的法律，但出於隱私考慮，未透露更多細節。

title: 程万军遭遣返 台移民署：因自伤、抗拒曾采取“必要措施”
summary: 文章来源：rfa 记者：Alan Lu 流亡海外的中国媒体人程万军指控，台湾移民署在遣返他回泰国、押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 (图截取自程万军视频) 曾任中国央视《法律讲堂》主讲人的程万军，周二(3日)在台湾桃园机场寻求人道庇护，随后被遣返泰国。他11月4日公开指控，台湾移民署人员押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 程万军搭乘的班机原定从泰国曼谷经台湾转机返回北京，他11月2日抵达桃园机场后，向移民署人员表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暂时留在台湾，等待前往
content: 文章来源：rfa 记者：Alan Lu 流亡海外的中国媒体人程万军指控，台湾移民署在遣返他回泰国、押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 (图截取自程万军视频) 曾任中国央视《法律讲堂》主讲人的程万军，周二(3日)在台湾桃园机场寻求人道庇护，随后被遣返泰国。他11月4日公开指控，台湾移民署人员押送他登机期间，曾对他捆绑、堵嘴及殴打。 程万军搭乘的班机原定从泰国曼谷经台湾转机返回北京，他11月2日抵达桃园机场后，向移民署人员表示自己遭受中共政治迫害，希望暂时留在台湾，等待前往第三国寻求庇护。 不过，台湾主管机关审查后未同意其申请，并于3日晚间将他送返曼谷。 程万军4日向自由亚洲电台指控移民署人员在执行遣返过程中，将他捆绑押送，并以毛巾堵嘴、口罩蒙面及勒住手腕等方式限制行动。他还指控自己在机上遭到殴打，身体多处受伤，抵达曼谷后前往医疗机构接受急救。 程万军称，有移民署人员曾对他说“你的死活与我们无关”，并批评台湾陆委会没有详细审查其提交的材料，便决定将他遣返。他表示，将向台湾监察院及法院提出控告。 上述程万军有关遭捆绑、殴打及台湾官员言论的说法，本台无法独立核实。 台湾移民署回应表示，程万军未能就其诉求提出具体事证，不符合援助条件及资格，且没有有效入境许可，因此依《入出国及移民法》第50条，将他送返泰国曼谷。 移民署同时表示，程万军在登机过程中极力抗拒，并出现“自伤”行为，因此采取必要措施维护飞航安全，相关作为均属依法行政。移民署的声明未逐项回应程万军所称遭到殴打，以及有官员发表不当言论等指控。 程万军提供照片，称自己遭受殴打，以致身体多处受伤，并于抵达曼谷后前往医疗机构接受急救。  (程万军提供) 陆委会：无法核实遭迫害情形 台湾陆委会4日发布声明表示，每年都会发生多起中国人士在台湾机场寻求暂时留置的类似案件，政府必须建立甄别机制，不可能每件申请都予以接受。 陆委会指出，本案的主要关键，是政府无法核实程万军所称遭受迫害的情况。除当事人本人的声明外，目前没有其他第三方事证可以佐证；程万军也能够自由进出中国，没有受到人身自由限制。因此，主管机关只能依既有机制将他送回泰国。 陆委会强调，台湾政府对中国异议人士一向抱持尽量援助的立场，但有关申请仍须遵守台湾法律及国境管理制度。 程万军则表示，他离开中国后曾在泰国发表反对中共的言论，因此担心遭遣返回中国。目前他的泰国签证即将到期，正透过独立中文笔会及加拿大救援团队，申请前往第三国避难。 台湾学者：应评估未来风险 台湾华人民主书院协会理事长曾建元接受本台采访时表示，庇护审查不应只判断当事人过去是否已经遭受政治迫害，也应评估其未来遭迫害的风险。 他说，程万军能够合法离开中国，并不代表返国后没有风险。程万军在抵达泰国后发表的反共言论，可能增加他被遣返后遭到追究的危险。审查重点应是这种风险是否存在及程度高低，而不是等到迫害事实已经发生，才考虑是否提供保护。 曾建元指出，台湾至今没有通过《难民法》，政治庇护也缺乏完整的法律及行政程序。政府只能针对个案作出政治判断及职权裁量，容易受到不同时空、两岸关系及国际环境影响，也可能产生处理标准前后不一的问题。 他建议，即使《难民法》短期内难以通过，台湾政府至少应制定行政命令，明确申请条件、审查程序、所需证据及驳回理由，并让民间团体及申请人了解决定依据。 “每个个案都是政治决定，这并不好。”曾建元说，建立公开标准，才能使申请人知道可能面对哪些风险，也能让政府的处理立场较为一致。 近年已有多名中国维权人士在桃园机场转机时寻求庇护。2023年，陈思明在没有入境台湾的情况下，最终获准前往加拿大；今年9月，为北京锡安教会辩护的律师王夏红一家，也获台湾暂时人道安置。但其他数起申请者则遭送返前一出发地。 曾建元认为，台湾社会对于接纳难民仍缺乏高度共识，朝野政党也多半回避相关立法，因此《难民法》何时能够通过仍不乐观。程万军案再次凸显，在缺乏明确法律及审查标准的情况下，台湾如何处理中国异议人士的庇护申请，仍高度依赖政府对个案作出的行政裁量。

title: Bank of England pours cold water on AI productivity boom
zh_title: 英格兰银行给人工智能生产力繁荣泼冷水

content:
英国央行表示，尽管在人工智能领域投入了数十亿美元，但该技术并没有为英国企业带来生产力的提高。在最新的货币政策报告中，央行发现过去三年人工智能使英国生产力提高了约 0.5%。这意味着自 2024 年初以来，年生产率仅额外增长 0.1 至 0.2 个百分点，这远不是硅谷所希望的经济革命。英国央行表示：“人工智能投资似乎对当前的需求强劲做出了一定贡献，但到目前为止，只有证据表明人工智能推动了英国生产率增长的适度增长。”即使是被认为最有可能从这项技术中受益的行业也没有什么值得夸耀的。信息和通信等人工智能密集型行业的生产率增长有所改善，但尚未超过大流行前的平均水平。这并不是说人工智能没有为英国经济做任何事情。该银行估计，自 2026 年初以来，人工智能相关活动占英国 GDP 增长的近五分之一，尽管其中大部分似乎来自开发和部署该技术的公司，而不是通过使用该技术提高生产力的企业。
报告称：“迄今为止，人工智能对经济增长的贡献似乎反映了人工智能技术上游开发和实施的活动，而不是在经济其他领域采用人工智能技术所带来的更广泛的收益。”换句话说，事实证明，销售人工智能比实际使用它更有利可图。该银行还警告称，不要将英国近期生产率提高的功劳过多地归功于人工智能。增长的主要原因似乎是企业雇用的工人减少了，而产出却持续增长，部分原因是企业放松了大流行后的人员配置决定并应对更高的就业成本。尽管预测人工智能将导致大量劳动力失业，但接受世行决策者小组调查的公司报告称，迄今为止对就业几乎没有总体影响。然而，这项技术使得一些雇主不太愿意雇用新员工或替换离职员工。其他研究表明，企业仍在等待回报。 Gartner 上个月发布的一项调查发现，虽然四分之三的企业董事会成员期望人工智能能够提高生产力并削减成本，但只有 3% 的组织实际上实现了目标。与此同时，38% 的人在人工智能方面的支出已经超出预算，但 85% 的人计划明年支出更多。
2 月份发布的另一项涉及近 6,000 名高管的研究发现，超过 80% 的公司没有看到人工智能对就业或生产力产生明显影响。显然，解决令人失望的回报的答案是继续写支票。人工智能支出与实际回报之间日益脱节也引起了金融监管机构的注意。国际货币基金组织上个月警告称，如果承诺的利润没有兑现，人工智能支出热潮可能会再次给投资者带来损失，并可能拖累更广泛的经济。国际清算银行 (Bank for International Settlements) 在 6 月份发出了类似的警报，将当前的支出热潮与 20 世纪 90 年代的互联网泡沫进行了比较。它担心的是，科技巨头正在向基础设施投入巨额资金，因为他们假设人工智能最终将带来同样巨大的回报，例如
