content:
中国2026年前三季度结婚登记量持续下滑；人口学家预测，2027年的出生人数将暴跌
中国2026年前三季度结婚登记量持续下滑；人口学家预测，2027年的出生人数将暴跌
中国2026年前三季度结婚登记量持续下滑；人口学家预测，2027年的出生人数将暴跌
资料照片：在中国“十一”假期间，一位中国新娘在北京故宫附近拍摄婚纱照。(2021年10月3日)
中国民政部刚刚公布的数据显示：2026年前三季度，全国结婚登记仅有464.8万对。人口学家预测，这意味着2027年的出生人口将暴跌。
中国民政部星期四(11月5日)发布了《2026年3季度民政统计数据》报告。报告显示：2026年前三季度，中国全国结婚登记464.8万对，比上年同期减少50.4万对；从季度上看，第一季度与去年同比下降6.2%，第二季度下降8.7%，第三季度下降14.9%，三季度降幅明显扩大。
美国威斯康星大学麦迪逊分校人口统计学家易富贤在接受美国之音(VOA)采访时表示，这意味着2027年的出生人口数量将暴跌。
易富贤说：“因为结婚与下一年的出生数是高度相关的，这就意味着2027年的中国出生数会非常快速地下降。”
自2025年5月10日起，中国正式施行新修订的《婚姻登记条例》。该条例取消了婚姻登记的地域限制，大陆居民可以在全国任何一个县级以上婚姻登记机关办理结婚或离婚登记。同一年，中国全国依法办理结婚登记为676.51万对，比2024年610.6万对增长了大约10.8%。
易富贤表示，当时，很多人很高兴，认为中国政府终于遏制了结婚下降的趋势，必将带来出生人口的上升，但这其实只是政策变动带来的短期反弹而已。他解释说，放宽婚姻登记限制可以满足部分积压需求，就像以旧换新补贴可以提前释放消费需求一样。
易富贤告诉美国之音：“(中国)去年结婚数量增加了11%，今年的出生数也会有所增加，今年的出生数会提高到八百多万。但是由于今年的结婚数下降了10%，也就意味着明年的出生数将会下降，大概只有七百多万。”
易富贤表示，中国人口的一些结构性因素，比如适婚人口萎缩、初婚年龄推迟、生育意愿下降等等并未改变，因此，不能把短期政策效应误判为人口趋势的逆转。
民政部的统计数据还显示，中国第一季度至第三季度的离婚登记数量几乎保持不变，仅增加0.5万对，总数达到208.2万对。
中国是世界人口第二大国，但其人口老龄化速度很快。由于从1980年至2015年实行的的“一胎化(或称一孩)政策”、改革开放期间快速的城镇化，以及高企的房价、不稳定的就业市场和前景、高昂的育儿成本等因素，导致中国人结婚和育儿的意愿持续下降，中国的新生儿出生率近年来更是遭遇断崖式下降。这一趋势正在对中国社会的经济、家庭、医疗支出及公共服务等方方面面带来深远影响。
为了应对结婚率持续下降和人口快速萎缩的问题，近年来中国从中央到地方出台了一系列综合性政策与创新举措，其中包括婚姻登记“全国通办”、延长婚假、物质奖励、消费补贴等措施，但是仍然无法提升结婚数量。
长期研究中国人口问题的易富贤告诉美国之音，中国导致结婚减少、出生下降的原因很多，有众多短板，只有全部补齐才能提升生育率；但是中国政府到目前为止只是补了其中很少的几块，有些短板在哪里都不知道。
易富贤举例说，比如中国居民可支配收入占GDP比例太低，象2025年，中国居民可支配收入只占GDP的43%，远低于国际社会的60-70%，这样生育率很难稳定在1.0，更遑论提升。
易富贤指出，而中国要提高居民可支配收入占比，那便是个天大的难题。

summary: 法拉利F40在香港公交车前冲出，乘客受伤中国劳工布告栏，星期日，2026 年 11 月 8 日 · 香港 香港和中国劳工英文新闻 法拉利 F40 在香港公交车前冲出，乘客受伤 一段视频显示，一辆法拉利 F40 从一条小路驶入浅水湾道，险些与一辆城巴擦肩而过。巴士急刹车，乘客被抛向前。法拉利开走了。网友批评司机没有让路。 11 月 8 日星期六，网上流传的一段视频显示，一辆罕见的红色法拉利 F40 价值数千万美元，从一辆汽车中驶出。
content:
法拉利F40在香港公交车前冲出，乘客受伤中国劳工公告栏
星期日, 8 十一月 2026 · 香港 香港及中国劳工新闻英文版
法拉利F40在香港巴士前冲出 乘客受伤
一段视频显示，一辆法拉利 F40 从一条小路驶入浅水湾道，险些与一辆城巴擦肩而过。巴士急刹车，乘客被抛向前。法拉利开走了。网友批评司机没有让路。
11月8日星期六网上流传的一段视频显示，一辆价值数千万美元的罕见红色法拉利F40从一条小路驶入浅水湾道，差点被一辆城巴侧面撞上。
周六晚上 7 点左右发布的这段视频显示，这辆左驾 F40 从浅水湾附近的一条小路上驶出。司机在停车前似乎没有检查道路，险些与驶来的公交车相撞。
城巴司机及时紧急刹车，但下层乘客失去平衡，向前摔倒。然后法拉利开走了，剪辑结束，但没有显示接下来发生的事情。
据记录，浅水湾周六举办了一场经典汽车活动，现场有多辆经典跑车，其中包括法拉利F40。晚上，一大群汽车爱好者聚集在外面拍摄汽车，一些人走上马路，站在交通岛上。
网民批评法拉利司机不屈服地退出，包括“F40差点撞死城巴司机”、“巴士司机反应太快了”、“如果巴士满了，再卖两辆F40都不够赔偿”。

Ferrari F40 pulls out in front of Hong Kong bus, passengers injured | China Labour Bulletin Board
Sunday, 8 Nov 2026 · Hong Kong Hong Kong and China labour news in English
Ferrari F40 pulls out in front of Hong Kong bus, passengers injured
A video shows a Ferrari F40 emerging from a side road onto Repulse Bay Road, narrowly missing a Citybus. The bus braked hard, throwing passengers forward. The Ferrari drove off. Netizens criticised the driver for failing to yield.
A video circulating online on Saturday 8 November shows a rare red Ferrari F40, worth tens of millions of dollars, pulling out from a side road onto Repulse Bay Road and nearly being hit broadside by a Citybus.
The footage, posted around 7pm on Saturday, showed the left-hand-drive F40 emerging from a side road near The Repulse Bay. The driver appeared not to have checked the road before pulling out, narrowly avoiding a collision with the approaching bus.
The Citybus driver braked hard in time, but passengers on the lower deck lost their balance and fell forward. The Ferrari then drove off, and the clip ended without showing what happened next.
According to records, The Repulse Bay hosted a classic car event on Saturday featuring several classic sports cars, including the Ferrari F40. A large crowd of car enthusiasts gathered outside in the evening to photograph the cars, with some stepping onto the road and standing on traffic islands.
Netizens criticised the Ferrari driver for pulling out without yielding, with comments including "the F40 almost got the Citybus driver killed," "the bus driver reacted fast," and "if the bus had been full, selling two more F40s wouldn't cover the compensation."

content:
Fundraiser by Su Lee : Wipe Away Su Lee's Tears from her Composing Nights
Su Lee is organizing this fundraiser.
Dear friends, music lovers, and new music supporters,
It’s me, Su Lee, and I am currently working on my dissertation concert (for my Ph.D. in composition) which will be held on Sept. 9th 2019 Monday at 7:30pm in Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall at University at Buffalo.
The title of my dissertation composition and concert is Die Radikalen Tasten (The Radical Keys) in terms of aesthetics, Klang (sound), and theme.
I am writing a concerto for organ with keyboard ensemble, namely for our own tremendous Fisk Op.95 organ at UB. It will involve organ soloist with 1 assistant, 2 pianos (1 quarter-tone flat piano), 2 harpsichords (1 quarter-tone flat harpsichord), and 2 vibraphones which is a very rare instrumentation for microtonal new music.
The 1st half of the program features significant keyboard works from the 20th century such as Messiaen's solo organ work and Ives's quarter-tone piano pieces. As a special request from Dr. Fuller, who was in charge of the installation of the Fisk Op.95 organ at UB, I'm playing my very first organ transcription of Wagner's orchestral work.
The 2nd half of the program features my own 'radical' politically inspired compositions including a choral piece with organ accompaniment (dedicated to the UUCB Choir family) and my dissertation organ concerto. Both works are based on the Korean Democratic Uprising in May 1980 and the protest song written for the victims of the subsequent Gwangju massacre - a song that has became widely popular for activists and protesters, including those participating in the on-going Hong Kong protests.
Overall, it is a very colorful and unique combination and a rare program which is a you-don’t-want-to-miss concert.
I am modestly asking you for a little or big help in making my dissertation concert happen smoothly, especially given my financial struggles in not being able to even work legally for money off campus in America due to my visa status.
Your generous donation will be spent towards, (besides helping me wipe away all my tears and whining from composing numerous nights over the past few months and rehearsing in the upcoming days and nights):
Nine Musicians’ Performance Fee, about $3,000 – 3,300
Rent/Labor for Lippes Concert Hall in Slee Hall, about $1,000
Other concert related costs; buying performing materials, copying/binding score/parts, printing poster/program book, audio/video recording, photographing, tuning, reception, etc. about $1,200 – 1,500
Fortunately, I got awarded the MDRF (research fund) for $3,000 at UB so that I can be reimbursed afterwards, but I need money upfront now to pay first, and possibly more, to pay my dream team musicians fairly and to cover other costs.
Your genuine help means SO MUCH to me being an international Ph.D. student with many restrictions on earning money (3 months summer break without job, seriously!), as it will lighten my financial burdens and psychological anxiety when I absolutely need to focus more on my creative activities.
Simply speaking, you are contributing to a potentially "fabulous" new music piece, stimulating my further musical activities and making me believe that life (and the world) is so beautiful!
Every single one of your names will be acknowledged in my concert program book, and to thank you all, but not nearly enough, I like to give you in return as below:
$1~$49: a thank-you-card with a cover of a handwritten excerpt of my score
$50~$99: a thank-you-card like above AND a dvd of my dissertation concert (after my concert)
$100~$199: a thank-you-card AND a dvd like above, PLUS the autographed full score of my dissertation composition
$200~$299: EVERYTHING above AND one additional dvd of my Masters organ recitals (your choice of “Über den Namen B-A-C-H” or “Celebrating Lou Harrison’s 100th Birth-Year at Thunder Night”)
$300 or more: EVERYTHING above, PLUS a gift pack of Korean snacks/sweets/tea etc.
Please write me an email with your home address!
I am really excited to prepare my dissertation concert. Though I feel like this is sadly going to be my last self designed concert during my time in Buffalo (at UB), so I cannot wait to see many of you there!
Thank you so much for reading this and considering your donation.
I promise to pay you back with my "fabulous" new compositions and my performance, with the great help of my dream team of musician fellows!
Please feel free to spread the link to your social pages like Facebook, Instagram, or Twitter, or to emails, to help get the word out!
FYI, I am collecting your donations from now till October and GoFundMe takes 2.9% for transaction fee plus $0.30 PER Donation. Or you can donate by sending me a check to my place (email me for asking my address please!)

2026 年 10 月，中国辽宁舰航母编队穿越巴西兰海峡前往西里伯斯海，这至少是自 2025 年 12 月以来据报道的第二次通过。此次部署还包括穿越吕宋海峡。其意义在于展示通过第一岛链的其他路线。 CSIS 对日本观测结果的分析显示，2025 年辽宁省和山东省在第一岛链以外的停留时间总计为 58 天，高于 2024 年的 32 天。
对于中国来说，这些选择的影响不仅仅是导航。中国不断扩大的海军和空中影响力使其有更多机会向试图中断其海上能源供应的部队施加成本。封锁联盟必须保护自己的业务及其成员的贸易，同时持续对中国施加压力。
就中国而言，马六甲困境指的是其通过马六甲海峡的大部分海运能源进口和贸易受到干扰的风险，以及这种脆弱性给其他国家带来的强制影响力。 《外交家》在之前的分析中已经研究了马六甲海峡的战略重要性，以及制裁和合规压力的破坏性潜力。然而，凭借更广泛的海军和空军存在，中国正在使马六甲困境不再是单向的。任何封锁联盟现在都必须考虑到中国人民解放军（PLA）影响范围的扩大。
解放军的存在使联军规划复杂化的一种具体方式是监视。菲律宾南部的做法说明了这种负担。 USNI新闻报道称，BRP Sarangani跟踪辽宁舰，BRP Diego Silang和BRP Emilio Jacinto也监视该组织。
然而，成功的局部阴影并不能建立持续的覆盖。日本联合参谋部记录了 10 月 14 日的航母飞行行动以及 10 月 15 日编队向南中国海的移动； Bilyonaryo新闻频道获得的菲律宾监测记录描述了10月22日至23日的跟踪情况。这些报告没有考虑到中间的一周。作战情报可能仍处于保密状态，因此这种差距并不会造成失去联系，但公共记录并不支持菲律宾监控不间断的假设。

The Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS Carl Vinson (CVN 70) and the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS Sterett (DDG 104) transit the Strait of Malacca, July 16, 2025.
Credit: U.S. Navy photo by Mass Communication Specialist 1st Class Jacob I. Allison
In October 2026, China’s Liaoning carrier group transited the Basilan Strait toward the Celebes Sea, at least its second reported passage since December 2025. The deployment also included a transit through the Luzon Strait. Its significance lies in demonstrating additional routes through the First Island Chain. A CSIS analysis of Japanese observations recorded Liaoning and Shandong beyond the First Island Chain for a combined 58 days in 2025, up from 32 in 2024.
For China, those options have implications beyond mere navigation. China’s expanding naval and air reach gives it more opportunities to impose costs on forces seeking to interrupt its seaborne energy supply. A blockade coalition would have to protect its own operations and its members’ trade while sustaining pressure on China.
In China’s case, the Malacca dilemma refers to its exposure to disruption of the large share of its seaborne energy imports and trade that passes through the Strait of Malacca, as well as to the coercive leverage that this vulnerability gives others. The Diplomat has already examined the strategic importance of the Strait of Malacca in previous analyses, along with and the disruptive potential of sanctions and compliance pressure. With its broader naval and air presence, however, China is making the Malacca dilemma no longer one-directional. Any blockade coalition must now account for the increased reach of the People’s Liberation Army (PLA).
One concrete way that PLA presence complicates coalition planning is surveillance. The southern Philippine approaches illustrate the burden. USNI News reported that BRP Sarangani shadowed Liaoning, while BRP Diego Silang and BRP Emilio Jacinto also monitored the group.
Yet successful local shadowing does not establish continuous coverage. Japan’s Joint Staff documented carrier flight operations on October 14 and the formation’s movement toward the South China Sea on October 15; Philippine monitoring records obtained by Bilyonaryo News Channel described tracking on October 22-23. The intervening week was not accounted for in those reports. Operational intelligence may remain undisclosed, so that gap does not establish lost contact, but the public record doesn’t support an assumption of uninterrupted Philippine surveillance.
USNI described the Philippine military’s force posture in Mindanao as focused on counter-piracy and counterinsurgency missions, while PLA Tracker’s Ben Lewis characterized the Sulu Sea as less closely watched than Luzon. Separately, Chinese ships have used the Sibutu Passage in 2019, well before the Liaoning deployment. Such activity broadens the area in which U.S. partners may need to maintain contact with Chinese forces. If Philippine coverage proves insufficient, additional U.S. or allied surveillance assets would be required, reducing what remains available for other missions.
The surveillance burden created by these southern transits matters even if the coalition does not intend to intercept ships there. A coalition need not patrol every Philippine passage to stop tankers west of Malacca. However, it would have to account for Chinese forces operating elsewhere in the theater and the additional protection required by exposed ships and support facilities. This competition for resources connects the southern transits to blockade sustainability.
Selectivity adds another burden: restricting China-bound cargo while allowing other trade requires more than identifying a vessel’s flag or next port. U.S. maritime sanctions guidance already calls for scrutiny of cargo documentation, counterparties, and ownership. Transshipment through an intermediate hub can complicate the determination of a cargo’s ultimate destination. In a blockade scenario, inspections and disputed records would consume time while Chinese military activity increases force-protection requirements. Shipowners or insurers might withdraw before an interception occurred. Such uncertainty could increase pressure on China, but it could also undermine the credibility of the U.S. promise that allied trade would remain unaffected. China’s regional presence creates leverage by making that promise harder and more expensive to keep.
The United States would face these requirements with a fleet whose sustained availability is already constrained. A 2025 Government Accountability Office review identified shortages of spare parts and qualified maintenance personnel, alongside deferred surface-ship maintenance. An August 2026 report found that maintenance delays and idle time had cost active attack submarines more than 15,000 operational days during fiscal years 2016-2025.
USS Benfold’s July 2026 engineering casualty illustrated the immediate consequences. The destroyer lost power and required towing to Subic Bay before repairs were completed. During a blockade, replacing a disabled ship’s surveillance or escort functions would draw on other assets. The problem is cumulative: more protection against Chinese interference increases demand for ships already needed for rotations, among other additional maintenance and crew-recovery demands. A coalition’s initial strength therefore says little about how much capability it can keep available month after month.
American naval constraints would increase pressure on allies to contribute, but Japan and South Korea have vulnerabilities of their own. U.S. Energy Information Administration data identify both countries as major destinations for crude oil passing through Malacca. Their governments would need assurances that participation would not jeopardize the supplies their economies require. Chinese operations across the wider region could increase the escorts and surveillance needed to protect that shipping route, further draining forces available for coalition enforcement.
The Liaoning’s operation beyond the First Island Chain does not establish an ability to threaten every tanker supplying Northeast Asia, but it illustrates the geographic breadth planners must consider when assessing possible Chinese responses. China could seek to discourage participation in any blockade by increasing the expected cost to coalition members. Allied participation therefore cannot be assumed. Japan’s Reciprocal Access Agreement with the Philippines facilitates defense cooperation, but it does not constitute advance consent to joining a blockade. Contributions to an interdiction operation would also compete with each country’s other defense requirements.
Support from the states bordering the strait is equally consequential. In April, Singaporean Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan ruled out participation in attempts to close, interdict, or impose tolls in Singapore’s neighborhood. He described Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia as strategically aligned in keeping the straits open, and said Singapore had conveyed its position on transit passage to both China and United States. The statement directly challenges any assumption that existing security relationships guarantee local support for maritime interdiction. Without cooperation, an enforcing coalition could face longer support routes and more demanding arrangements for access and resupply. Singapore’s position and the Philippines’ surveillance challenge are different constraints: one concerns partner alignment, the other resources and capacity. Together, they show why regional partnerships cannot be treated as ready-made reserve of enforcement capacity.
China nevertheless remains exposed beyond its immediate region. Peacetime transits do not demonstrate the ability to keep ships, aircraft, and replenishment vessels operating under attack.
A 2020 Naval War College study identified PLA logistics, air-defense, and antisubmarine limitations in the Indian Ocean. Rather than establish China’s current capability ceiling, the assessment identifies the functions that distant operations must sustain. Interdiction farther west would stretch Chinese support and protection requirements, rendering the military options demonstrated by operations around the first island chain less feasible. The regional deterrent is therefore conditional and geographically uneven, with its value lying in raising the cost of coercing China rather than eliminating China’s vulnerability to economic pressure.
Only when a coalition seeks to blockade the Malacca Strait or enforce selective interdiction against China do Chinese operations create additional force-protection requirements for coalition forces and exposed shipping. U.S. availability constraints then limit the capacity to meet those requirements, while partners’ exposure makes assurances about permitted trade harder to sustain. These interactions make coalition participation harder to justify. The Malacca dilemma, therefore, increasingly runs both ways. For the United States, the central question is whether a coalition can maintain selective interdiction long enough to meaningfully change China’s calculations while absorbing Chinese counterpressure against its own forces and its most exposed partners.

棒球/仙童第二次访问台湾加深棒球以外的联系

周四，台裔美国外野手斯图尔特·费尔柴尔德 (Stuart Fairchild) 在台北举行的新闻发布会上。中央通讯社照片2026年11月5日
中新网台北11月5日电美籍台裔外野手斯图尔特·费尔柴尔德(Stuart Fairchild)第二次到访台湾，将与台湾的联系扩展到棒球以外的领域，支持动物救援和青少年棒球，同时与家人一起探索母亲的家乡。
周四在台北举行的新闻发布会上，费尔柴尔德表示，他希望自己与台湾的联系“继续年复一年增长”。
台湾动物基金会林口护理中心的一位代表告诉中央社，仙童已捐款并计划与妻子汉娜一起前往帮助照顾获救的流浪狗，包括给它们洗澡。
Fairchild 表示，原因是个人原因：他和 Hanna 于 2019 年从北卡罗来纳州的一个收容所收养了他们的狗 Ollie。
“基本上，他是我们的孩子，”他说，并解释说奥利对他们生活的影响使动物救援对他来说很重要。
30岁的他通过母亲获得了代表台湾参加三月世界棒球经典赛（WBC）的资格。他在对阵捷克的比赛中打出大满贯，在对阵韩国的比赛中打出两分全垒打，帮助台湾队在东京巨蛋赢得了两场比赛。
周四，仙童家族在台北举行的新闻发布会上合影留念。中央通讯社照片2026年11月5日
尽管台湾队在小组赛中出局，但他击球率为 0.250，打出 2 个本垒打、6 个打点和 3 个盗垒。
在美国职业棒球大联盟 (MLB) 赛季，费尔柴尔德为克利夫兰队出战 14 场比赛，为西雅图队出战 1 场比赛，19 次击球中击出 3 个安打，打点 1 次，盗垒 2 次。
当被问及是否有可能在台湾参加棒球俱乐部时，费尔柴尔德将他的下一步职业发展留给了他的代表。
GSI (@gsi.agency) 分享的帖子
“被通缉总是一种荣幸，我对此表示感谢，”他说。 “我只是让我的经纪人来决定什么对我的职业生涯来说是最好的。”
全球体育一体化（GSI）机构在访问前发表的一份声明中表示，飞兆半导体希望逐渐将重点转向亚洲，并每年至少返回台湾一次。周四，他表示他想定期访问并更多地了解那里的人民和文化。
他的访问包括棒球训练营和球迷活动。费尔柴尔德表示，他支持草根棒球，因为设备成本可能会阻碍孩子们体验这项运动的友谊和团队合作。
这次旅行也让他的母亲自12岁移居美国以来首次回到台湾。
周三，一家人游览了仙童母亲长大的地方台中，然后在湿地观看了日落。他说：“台湾现在是我的第二个家，台湾人民是我家庭的一部分。”
味全龙之队的美国右投手蒋焊周一荣获中国职业棒球联盟（CPBL）年度最有价值球员奖，为夺冠赛季再添个人最高荣誉。
三个赛季过去了，台湾选手滕凯伟终于感觉自己像 MLB 球员了
对于台湾右投手邓恺威来说，2026 年随休斯顿太空人队首次入选美国职业棒球大联盟开幕日名单让他感觉自己属于大联盟。

BASEBALL/Fairchild deepens ties beyond baseball on second visit to Taiwan

Taiwanese-American outfielder Stuart Fairchild at a Taipei press event Thursday. CNA photo Nov. 5, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 5 (CNA) Taiwanese-American outfielder Stuart Fairchild is extending his ties with Taiwan beyond baseball on his second visit, supporting animal rescue and youth baseball while exploring his mother's hometown with his family.
At a Taipei press event Thursday, Fairchild said that he hoped his connection with Taiwan "continues to grow year after year."
A representative of Animals Taiwan's Linkou care center told CNA that Fairchild had donated money and planned to visit with his wife, Hanna, to help care for rescued stray dogs, including bathing them.
Fairchild said the cause was personal: He and Hanna adopted their dog, Ollie, from a North Carolina shelter in 2019.
"He's our baby, basically," he said, explaining that Ollie's impact on their lives had made animal rescue important to him.
The 30-year-old qualified to represent Taiwan at March's World Baseball Classic (WBC) through his mother. He hit a grand slam against the Czech Republic and a go-ahead two-run homer against South Korea, helping Taiwan win both games at the Tokyo Dome.
The Fairchild family pose together for a family photo at a Taipei press event Thursday. CNA photo Nov. 5, 2026
He batted .250 with two homers, six RBIs and three stolen bases, although Taiwan exited in the group stage.
This Major League Baseball (MLB) season, Fairchild appeared in 14 games for Cleveland and one for Seattle, recording three hits in 19 at-bats, one RBI and two stolen bases.
Asked afterward about potentially playing club baseball in Taiwan, Fairchild left his next career move to his representatives.
A post shared by GSI (@gsi.agency)
"It's always a privilege to be wanted, and I'm thankful for that," he said. "I'm just going to leave it to my agents to decide what's the best thing for my career."
In a statement released ahead of the visit, Global Sporting Integration (GSI) Agency said Fairchild hoped to gradually shift his focus toward Asia and return to Taiwan at least once a year. On Thursday, he said he wanted to visit regularly and learn more about its people and culture.
His visit includes baseball camps and fan activities. Fairchild said he supported grassroots baseball because equipment costs could keep children from experiencing the sport's friendships and teamwork.
The trip also brought his mother back to Taiwan for the first time since she moved to the United States at age 12.
On Wednesday, the family explored Taichung, where Fairchild's mother grew up, before watching the sunset at wetlands. "Taiwan is now my home away from home, and its people are part of my family," he said.

探索古迹来世的艺术家荣获台北艺术奖最高奖
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
周五，艺术家胡安博元（右）荣获2026台北艺术奖最高奖。中央通讯社照片2026年11月6日
中新社台北11月6日电 艺术家阮柏远周五荣获2026年台北艺术奖最高奖，其作品探讨了与独裁统治相关的纪念碑在被拆除或拆除后如何获得新的意义。
胡安从 276 份参赛作品中脱颖而出，获得了 55 万新台币（16,767 美元）的奖金，奖金在台北市立美术馆 (TFAM) 展出，该博物馆展出了 10 名决赛入围者的作品。
胡安在获奖感言中表示：“我想从我们这一代人的角度重新思考，我们如何面对似乎已经被充分讨论过的历史，以及我们是否能够找到新的方式来应对它。”
26 岁的胡安毕业于国立台北艺术大学美术系，他于 2023 年开始在立陶宛和 2025 年在捷克共和国驻地期间，在其获奖演讲《寻找 Fronta na maso 下的鼻子》中创作了这两幅作品。
捷克语“Fronta na maso”的意思是“排队买肉”，是对布拉格斯大林纪念碑的一个嘲讽昵称，纪念碑的形状就像人们排队买肉。
仪式结束后，胡安在接受中央社采访时表示，该项目建立在早期利用 3D 打印和数字技术对台湾蒋介石雕像进行探索的基础上。
一件作品将桃园的慈湖纪念雕塑公园与立陶宛南部德鲁斯基宁凯附近的格鲁塔斯公园进行了比较，前者展示了从公共场所拆除的苏联时代纪念碑，后者安置了搬迁的蒋介石雕像。
他说，这两个公园都已成为旅游目的地，改变了游客遇到曾经象征政治权威的物体的方式。
另一件作品通过笑话、口述和网络都市传说探讨了布拉格被拆除的斯大林纪念碑如何幸存下来，让人们通过幽默来看待历史创伤。
该项目还利用生成人工智能、视频和 3D 打印，探索数字技术如何填补历史记忆的空白。
“它从台湾的角度出发，并与全球背景相联系，”胡安说。 “我们都在拆除雕像，都在经历一种转变。我们如何面对这些问题？”
骆丽真馆长表示，自1983年美术馆开馆以来，每年举办一次比赛，为新兴艺术家提供展示作品和探讨当代问题的机会。
她说，今年的决赛入围者讨论的主题包括自然与人造环境之间的关系、记忆与权力以及新材料和技术的使用。
“艺术是我们理解现在、想象未来的重要手段，”罗说。
获得优异奖的艺术家有杨健生、廖昭豪、郭柏彦、苏长庆、蔡昱廷五人，每人价值新台币十二万元。
另外四人获得荣誉奖：陈柏欣、黄冠钧、周韦辰和耿杰生。
展览持续至2027年2月14日。

Artist exploring monuments' afterlives wins Taipei Art Awards top prize
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Artist Juan Po-yuan (right) wins the top prize at the 2026 Taipei Art Awards on Friday. CNA photo Nov. 6, 2026
Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Artist Juan Po-yuan (阮柏遠) won the top prize at the 2026 Taipei Art Awards on Friday for works exploring how monuments associated with authoritarian rule acquire new meanings after being removed or demolished.
Juan was selected from 276 submissions to receive the NT$550,000 (US$16,767) prize at the Taipei Fine Arts Museum (TFAM), where works by the 10 finalists are on display.
"I wanted to rethink, from my generation's perspective, how we confront history that seems to have already been fully discussed, and whether we can find new ways to engage with it," Juan said in his acceptance speech.
Juan, 26, a graduate of Taipei National University of the Arts' Department of Fine Arts, developed the two works in his winning presentation, "Searching for the Nose beneath Fronta na maso," during residencies in Lithuania beginning in 2023 and the Czech Republic in 2025.
The Czech phrase "Fronta na maso," meaning "queue for meat," was a mocking nickname for Prague's Stalin monument, whose figures resembled people lining up to buy meat.
Speaking to CNA after the ceremony, Juan said the project built on earlier explorations of Chiang Kai-shek (蔣介石) statues in Taiwan using 3D printing and digital technology.
One work compares Cihu Memorial Sculpture Park in Taoyuan, which houses relocated Chiang statues, with Grutas Park near Druskininkai in southern Lithuania, which displays Soviet-era monuments removed from public spaces.
Both parks have become tourist destinations, changing how visitors encounter objects once intended to embody political authority, he said.
The other work examines how Prague's demolished Stalin monument survives through jokes, oral accounts and online urban legends, allowing people to approach historical trauma through humor.
Using generative artificial intelligence, video and 3D printing, the project also explores how digital technologies can fill gaps in historical memory.
"It starts from a Taiwanese perspective and connects with a global context," Juan said. "We are all dismantling statues and undergoing a kind of transition. How do we face these questions?"
TFAM Director Loh Li-chen (駱麗真) said the competition has been held annually since the museum opened in 1983, giving emerging artists opportunities to present their work and explore contemporary issues.
This year's finalists addressed themes including the relationship between nature and human-made environments, memory and power, and the use of new materials and technologies, she said.
"Art is an important means for us to understand the present and imagine the future," Loh said.
Five artists received merit awards worth NT$120,000 each: Yong Kian-sam (楊健生), Liao Chao-hao (廖昭豪), Kueh Peh Gan (郭柏彥), Su Chang-ching (蘇長慶) and Tsai Yu-ting (蔡昱廷).
Four others received honorable mentions: Chen Po-hsin (陳柏欣), Huang Kuan-chun (黃冠鈞), Chou Wei-chen (周韋辰) and Keng Chieh-sheng (耿傑生).
The exhibition runs through Feb. 14, 2027.

（中央社記者侯姿瑩華盛頓7日專電）巴布亞紐幾內亞7月片面宣布關閉台灣駐巴紐代表處，台灣外交部本週宣布決定主動關閉巴紐駐處。美國國務院今天回應表示，對巴紐片面要求關閉台灣駐處的報導深感關切，同時也批評，這是北京對台恫嚇又一例證，威脅全球和平與繁榮。
面積：462840平方公里（約為台灣12.86倍）
地理位置：位於太平洋西南部，北東南三面分別與密克羅尼西亞、索羅門群島及澳洲等國隔海相望
外長特卡琴科（Justin Tkatchenko）今年7月發布聲明，片面宣稱將立即關閉台灣駐巴紐代表處並停止運作，台灣外交部隨後宣布以停止在現貨市場進口巴紐液態天然氣作為因應，但巴紐政府近日再度片面要求台灣駐處人員限期離境及推動關閉駐處。
外交部於台北時間6日表示，政府基於國家尊嚴、外交自主及整體國家利益，經通盤評估後，決定主動關閉巴紐駐處，撤回所有派駐人員，並全面終止對巴紐提供的各項技術合作及援助計畫。
對此，美國國務院一名發言人今天以背景方式回覆中央社記者提問表示，對巴紐政府片面下令關閉位於莫士比港（Port Moresby）的台北經濟辦事處之報導深感關切。
發言人說，台灣是可靠、理念相近且民主的夥伴，其與世界各地的關係為這些國家的公民帶來重大益處，其中也包括巴布亞紐幾內亞。
同時，發言人指出，這是北京針對台灣及其全球支持者展開的恫嚇行動又一例證，此舉「損害各國選擇與台灣合作的主權決定，並威脅國際和平與繁榮」。
台灣外交部也表示，巴紐政府近期作為已嚴重影響雙方長期合作所建立的互信基礎，且反映中國持續運用政治壓力及經濟影響力，干預他國外交決策、打壓台灣國際空間。（編輯：洪培英）1151108

content:
台湾海巡署6日表示，侦获4艘中国海警船侵扰金门水域。为应对中国压力，台湾正投入大量资金发展无人载具，本周举行的第一届「台湾海洋科技暨无人载具展」，有具有美台合作背景的STR8及美国MARTAC等防务公司的无人艇参加动态演示，展现无人载具对海洋环境的情报及监视能力。
台湾的政府官员、研究人员及国际防务科技企业本周齐聚台南，参加第一届「台湾海洋科技暨无人载具展」。
与会人员表示，台湾必须加速发展海上无人系统、人工智能以及本土防务科技，以应对日益增长的中国军事威胁及“灰色地带”挑战。
台湾“海洋委员会”主任委员管碧玲表示：“但我们面临着诸多挑战，包括‘灰色地带’骚扰的威胁、自然灾害带来的风险、海上搜救需求，以及保障水下信息安全等——这些都是我们团队所面临的挑战。”
台湾副总统萧美琴说，“面对这些前所未有的挑战，我们的防务思维也必须与时俱进。过去需要依赖大型平台才能执行的任务，如今已可由更灵活、成本相对较低的无人载具来完成。这不仅能让我们宝贵的人力资源得到更有效的运用，还能大幅提升我们整体的防务韧性。”
美国科技防务公司 STR8 Industries展示了该公司的“幽灵尾迹”(Ghostwake)无人艇，菲尔·何(PHIL HO) 是该公司共同创办人。
STR8 INDUSTRIES共同创办人兼执行长菲尔·何说，“看到行政部门和国会都在朝着发展这些能力的方向迈进，这是一个非常积极的信号。归根结底，关键在于‘非对称性’。台湾有2300万人口，因此我们需要考虑‘一对一’的比例——特别是在作战层面，即一名操作员对应一个平台。而借助这类技术，便可实现‘一对多’的模式；这不仅能让你投射出可扩展的作战力量，还能构建起你所需要的非对称优势。”
STR8 INDUSTRIES虽然是一家美国公司，但是总部及研发、制造中心都设在台湾。
STR8 INDUSTRIES共同创办人兼执行长菲尔·何说，“世界上能同时具备上述所有优势的国家并不多——即在高端制造、电子、计算以及造船业方面都有着良好的过往表现。因此，这里是我们进行建设的最佳地点。我们之所以做出这一决定，正是看中了这里能够支持我们业务的技术与制造生态系统。其次，地理位置也至关重要。我们正处于‘第一岛链’的核心地带。从外部视角来看，在印太地区建立这样一个前沿产业基地，对于应对未来可能出现的各种突发状况具有关键意义。”
美国MARTAC公司的Devil Ray T24，以及台湾雷虎科技的海鲨600都参与了动态展演。
台湾国家科技政策智库“科技、民主与社会研究中心”（DSET）国家安全项目副组长方怡然表示，无人系统的发展对台湾的防卫格外重要。
科技、民主与社会研究中心政策分析師方怡然说，“从乌克兰的经验中我们得知，无人水面艇（USV）不仅能执行情报、监视与侦察（ISR）任务，还能进行水雷搜寻及水雷反制（MCM），甚至能执行打击任务；此外，它们在后勤保障方面也能发挥作用。因此，我认为我们当前面临的挑战更为严峻。而我们目前主要依靠的是有人驾驶舰艇和人员，我们需要将这些宝贵的人员和资源留给最关键的任务，同时也为了保障人员的生命安全。这就是为什么无人系统显得如此重要。”
台湾政府强调，中国对台湾周边海域并无管辖权，中方试图通过巡航来宣示管辖权的行为，已违反了国际法。台湾海巡署6日表示，侦获4艘中国海警船侵扰金门水域。为应对中国压力，台湾正投入大量资金发展无人载具，本周举行的第一届「台湾海洋科技暨无人载具展」，有具有美台合作背景的STR8及美国MARTAC等防务公司的无人艇参加动态演示，展现无人载具对海洋环境的情报及监视能力。

这张 CNA 档案照片中的旅客穿过桃园国际机场前往转机航站楼，以供说明之用
中新社台北11月7日电 台湾旅游局已将桃园国际机场为外国过境旅客提供的600新台币（18.30美元）礼券计划延长至2028年底。
政府在最近的一份声明中表示，原定于2025年11月1日至2026年10月31日运行的代金券计划已延长至2028年12月31日，或直至分配的资金用完。
该公司表示，延期的目的是鼓励过境旅客入境并在机场消费，同时使该计划与 3 号航站楼预计在 2027 年底竣工保持一致。
当局表示，该计划最初拨款新台币2200万元，足以发放约36,666张价值新台币600元的消费券。截至10月31日，已发放33,525张代金券，剩余供应预计将在11月底用完。
为确保该计划顺利进行，政府表示，计划额外印制4万张代金券，数量将根据实际发放和需求进行调整。
2025年11月1日推出“走进台湾，享好礼！”持非中华民国护照经桃园国际机场转机入境台湾停留不超过24小时的旅客，可获赠新台币600元礼券。
符合条件的旅客须先在活动网站注册，抵达机场后，凭护照和联程航班登机牌到旅游局游客服务中心领取凭证。
该优惠券适用于机场内参与活动的企业，包括餐厅、免税店、纪念品商店和其他零售服务。活动网站上提供了参与企业的列表，以方便参考。
作为台湾主要的国际门户，桃园国际机场将迎来大量过境旅客，根据桃园机场公社的数据，2025 年将有 669 万人次过境旅客。

Taiwan extends airport voucher program for transit passengers to 2028
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Travelers traverse through Taoyuan International Airport to a transfer terminal in this CNA file photo for illustrative purposes
Taipei, Nov. 7 (CNA) Taiwan's Tourism Administration has extended its NT$600 (US$18.30) gift voucher program for foreign transit passengers at Taoyuan International Airport to the end of 2028.
In a recent statement, the administration said the voucher program, originally scheduled to run from Nov. 1, 2025 to Oct. 31, 2026, has been extended to Dec. 31, 2028, or until the allocated funds are exhausted.
It said the extension was intended to encourage transit passengers to enter the country and spend money at the airport, while aligning the program with the expected completion of Terminal 3 by the end of 2027.
The administration said the program was initially allocated NT$22 million, enough to issue approximately 36,666 vouchers worth NT$600 each. As of Oct. 31, 33,525 vouchers had been handed out, with the remaining supply expected to be exhausted by the end of November.
To ensure a smooth continuation of the program, the administration said it plans to print an additional 40,000 vouchers, with the amount subject to adjustment depending on actual distribution and demand.
Launched on Nov. 1, 2025, the "Enter Taiwan, Enjoy a Gift!" program offers NT$600 gift vouchers to passengers holding non-ROC passports who transit through Taoyuan International Airport and enter Taiwan for stays of up to 24 hours.
Eligible travelers must first register on the campaign website, then present their passports and boarding passes for connecting flights to collect the vouchers at the Tourism Administration's Visitor Service Centers upon arrival at the airport.
The voucher is valid at participating businesses within the airport, including restaurants, duty-free stores, souvenir shops, and other retail services. A list of participating businesses is available on the campaign website for easy reference.
As Taiwan's major international gateway, Taoyuan International Airport sees a large number of transit passengers -- 6.69 million passengers in 2025, according to the Taoyuan International Airport Corp.

2026年11月6日，中共十四届全国人大常委会第二十五次会议闭幕。据人大常委会公告显示，江西省原省长叶建春，河南省政府原副秘书长、办公厅主任何雄，湖南中烟工业有限公司总经理籍涛，四川天府银行董事长黄毅被罢免全国人大代表职务。此前，他们四人已被通报落马，其中，叶建春于2026年8月27日落马；何雄于2026年8月20日落马。
另外有5人辞去中共全国人大代表职务，包括一名官员和四名少将，分别是浙江舟山市原市长徐仁标，以及广东省军区司令、海军少将张弓，宁夏军区原政委、火箭军少将郭建军，海军少将吴育红，以及甘肃省军区原政委、陆军少将孟庆斌。
截至目前，中共第十四届全国人民代表大会实有代表2839人。
2023年初，中共军队和武警部队26个选举单位举行军人代表大会，总共产生281名中共全国人大代表。据最近更新的中共全国人大官网“代表名单”显示，目前有229名中共军方全国人大代表。
从中可以看出，已经有52名军方全国人大代表被终止代表资格。
值得注意的是，在张弓、郭建军、吴育红和孟庆斌这四名少将“辞去”全国人大代表职务前，总共有46名军队全国人大代表被“罢免”第十四届全国人大代表职务，其中有22名上将、18名中将和6名少将。
2026年10月29日，中共五中全会在北京闭幕，有162名中央委员和117名候补中央委员出席，共出席279人，比2025年四中全会出席人数减少36人。中共中央军委副主席张升民在五中全会上被增选为中央政治局委员。
五中全会会议公报称，中共中央军委副主席张又侠、中央军委联合参谋部参谋长刘振立等16名军方高层被开除中共党籍。
2025年1月，召开二十届中纪委四次全会期间，有22名中共军队中央纪委委员出席，出席率为100%。
2026年1月，召开二十届中纪委五次全会期间，有12名军队中央纪委委员出席，出席率为55%。
2026年8月，召开二十届中纪委六次全会期间，有9名军队中央纪委委员出席，出席率为41%。
2026年10月，召开二十届五中全会期间，有6名军队中央纪委委员出席或列席，占总数的27%。
中央政治局委员、中央军委副主席、中央纪委副书记张升民（火箭军上将）；中共中央军委纪委书记张曙光（陆军上将）；海军政治工作部主任胡瑜海（海军中将）；武警部队原副政委朱国标（武警中将）；海军后勤部政委莫永成（海军少将）；中央军委国防动员部原副部长韩宪锋（空军少将）。
对此，X平台博主“中国人事观察”在2026年10月31日发帖表示，按中共惯例，所有中央纪委委员，不论担任什么职务，不管是否已退居二线或是彻底退休，都会继续担任中央纪委委员的中共党内职务，因此每次中纪委全会都应出席，而这次中央全会，全体中纪委委员都应列席。
贴文指出，而刘训言、马学蒂、刘军、张爱华这四名军队中纪委委员，此前曾出席今年8月召开的中纪委全会，却没有列席五中全会。而所有出席今年8月中纪委全会的文官中纪委委员，五中全会期间全部列席。
而负责中共军事科学院政治工作的军事科学院副政委张天宝少将，今年8月已经缺席二十届中纪委六次全会，这次又没列席二十届五中全会。“中国人事观察”指出：也许，张天宝缺席今年8月22日纪委全会的原因，终究不是“某些工作原因”。而张天宝的最后一次公开亮相，是在2026年8月14日召开的江泽民国防和军队建设思想研讨会。
中共西部战区副司令员文俊飞中将则首次现身中央会议，排在西部战区副政委兼政治工作部主任张韶颖的前面。“中国人事观察”认为，这表明文俊飞已开始负责西部战区的军事工作。但西部战区司令员一职仍处于空缺状态。前任西部战区司令员汪海江上将从2025年开始已经“失踪”，在五中全会上因“严重违纪违法”被确认开除中共党籍。
文俊飞获任后，中共五大战区的军事和政治（代理）主官，目前只剩下最后一个空缺。
南部战区现在只有负责军事工作的中将，即王显峰副司令员兼参谋长，但南部战区没有负责政治工作的中将。南部战区原政委王文全上将长期失踪，也缺席五中全会。
二十届三中全会有42名军队中央委员出席，出席率为95%。
二十届四中全会有15名军队中央委员出席，出席率为34%。
二十届五中全会只有5名军队中央委员出席，出席率为11%。
中共国防部长、海军上将董军；中共中央军委战略规划委员会专职委员、陆军上将杨学军；南部战区海军原政治委员、海军中将杨志亮；空军原副司令员，空军中将俞庆江。
X平台网友表示：“这比清洗还严重，这叫一锅端了。”“全军覆没”；“三次全会，95%掉到11%，军队这边来开会的人比开除的还少”。
出席五中全会的军队中央候补委员人数也在大幅度减少。
二十届三中全会有21名军队中央候补委员出席，出席率为91%。
二十届四中全会有16名军队中央候补委员出席，出席率为70%。
二十届五中全会有5名军队中央候补委员出席，出席率为22%。
这5人是南部战区副司令员、海军中将魏文徽；海军副司令员、海军中将崔玉忠；北部战区原副司令员兼参谋长、海军中将姜国平；国防科技大学原政委、空军少将傅爱国；火箭军研究院总工程师、火箭军（专业技术）少将李贤玉。
有四名上将列席五中全会，分别是中共中央军委纪委书记、陆军上将张曙光；东部战区司令员、空军上将杨志斌；中部战区司令员、空军上将韩胜延；空军司令员、空军上将王刚。
对此，“中国人事观察”指出，他们这四个人是中共二十一届中央军委的“主力军”。
出席五中全会的中共空军司令员王刚接受中共党媒新华社采访时称，“政治建军是人民军队立军之本，关乎国防和军队现代化建设方向和底色。”
“党中央和中央军委刀刃向内，全面从严治党、全面从严治军，”“要按照党中央要求，坚定不移、持之以恒推进全面从严治党，坚持政治建军、持续深化政治整训，加强练兵备战......提升打赢现代战争能力，”
据悉，王刚是在2026年7月3日晋升为空军上将军阶。
出席五中全会的军队中央委员、军队中央候补委员、军方中央纪委委员人数在三年来接连创下新低，可以看出，军方的人事大清洗已经让军队遭到重创。

summary: Fundraiser by Hillary Johnson : Hong Kong Photojournalism Trip Hillary Johnson is organizing this fundraiser. Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong.
content:
Fundraiser by Hillary Johnson : Hong Kong Photojournalism Trip
Hillary Johnson is organizing this fundraiser.
Hi everyone, my name is Hillary Johnson, and I’m a photographer living in Chicago, working all over the Midwest and in Hong Kong. I have two main threads to my photography practice, photojournalism and fine art.
Though it feels awkward, I confess, I’m pushing ahead because I need your help.
I’m going to Hong Kong on November 12 to cover the protest and the election of a new cabinet in Hong Kong.
You might wonder why bother giving money to me or why my voice particular needs to be added to this news event, or even why this matters to you at all. I hear that and I’ll do my best to answer your questions. I’ll also explain what you can do if you’re interested in helping out.
A little bit about me: in addition to being a photographer I’m also someone who studies a martial art called Ving Tsun. This art is extremely popular in Hong Kong for various reasons that I won’t go into right now but if you’re curious you can ask me and I’ll be happy to answer. It was the practice of this martial art that introduced me to my husband, Matt Johnson who runs a kung fu school here in Chicago.
This martial art has a code of ethics that involves being a good citizen, being humble, promoting peace, and standing up for what is right and protecting those who need protection from bullies and so forth.
I made my first trip to Hong Kong a couple of years ago and I’ve been back a few times since then. Though I’m someone who likes spend a lot of time in remote locations being quiet and letting the busyness of my mind and heart settle down, I felt 100% in love with the city of Hong Kong, it’s culture, it’s people, and of course with my kung fu family there.
As a result it has been difficult watching the news and worrying about this place I love so much and the people who live there.
My concern for all of this led me to do a story for the Chicago Reader.
Here's a link to that: https://www.chicagoreader.com/chicago/photos-hong-kong-protest-freedom/Content?oid=73815391
I’m extremely grateful to the reader for giving me the time and space that it did. I made all the photographs, did all the interviews, and wrote all the text with guidance from the amazing Reader staff. In the process of working on that story I began to see, that much that was going on in Hong Kong seems to not quite be making it into the news. This made me want to go to Hong Kong and do more.
The stories we have been seeing her only the tip of the iceberg. I’m interested in the stories of ordinary people, their everyday life, and what they do.
How do they support each other in the midst of such extreme difficulty?
I want to understand the impact of what’s happening in this interaction between the Beijing mainland Chinese government in the city of Hong Kong in the Hong Kong people.
It’s interesting that Hong Kong has roots and connections stretching out from the city, all over the globe. While working on the story I’ve met many people here in Chicago who have a deep connections to Hong Kong.
I want to go and photograph an interview to help amplify the voices of those people not being heard as much as they might be.
Why do the events Hong Kong matter to you wherever you might live?
Number one. Hong Kong people are simply asking for fundamental human rights to be recognized.
Number two. The Hong Kong people are asking for the promises made by the Chinese government to be kept.
Number three. The Hong Kong people want their freedom.
All people everywhere around the world want their fundamental human rights, they want promises to be kept and they want freedom.
If we all look into our own hearts I believe we will see this truth is self evident.
What’s happening in Hong Kong matters to all of us, because all of us want the same things; freedom, respect- both given and received, dignity, and agency.
Further, for those of us living in other parts of the world, if we think that what’s happening in Hong Kong cannot happen to us wherever it is that we happen to live, I think if you forgive me, that view is naïve.
The road to tyranny is a slippery slope.
First one right is eroded, then another, then another.
For this trip to Hong Kong all the groundwork is in place.
Because of the network being built up over the years and as a result of my recent work, there are people on the ground in Hong Kong ready to help with making connections, translation, safety and getting around and so forth.
My intention is to get to Hong Kong do my work at the photographer and then do my best to get those stories out into the world so that everyone can know what is going on.
But I need help with the expenses.
Airfare and hotel around $2100-2400 depending on flight details
Transportation in Hong Kong When the MTR is shut down taxis may be necessary - estimating maybe $300
Money to pay translators and other fixtures and facilitators estimating $300-500
A laptop to process photos while I’m there so I can send them out to editors at various news outlets - around $200-300
I’m hoping to raise $3500. to cover all of that as well as some of my bills while I’m away so that the lights and heat are still on when I return home.
Addition I’ll provide links to news outlets as well as the story I did for the reader so that you can get more information about the situation over there.
I’ll also link or attach a video that I made about the story.
As things when I’m planning to offer in addition to publicly thinking everyone who supports this is the creation of a private Facebook group where I post updates photos and video from my time in Hong Kong.
This content will be exclusively for anyone who supports this trip.
I’m excited to announce that someone already made a first donation of $500 before even launched this campaign which let me adjust the amount needed to $3500
Honestly I wasn’t even planning on doing this but so many people said to me that they wanted to support the trip and believe in the mission of supporting truth and openness and democracy, that I pushed past my own discomfort and jumped in.
I want to thank all of you in advance for your support and help.
Please know that even if you can’t donate money to this trip, I’d be very grateful for your repeated sharing of the campaign. We all know how this works, and whether we like it or not it requires a certain diligence. A lather rinse and repeat process.
For those of you who can donate, please know how grateful I am for your support. And that no donation is too small or too large.
Again my heartfelt thanks. You should know also that I’ve never felt more sense of mission or purpose in going after story. This has my whole heart and I hope very much but I’ll find out that’s for publishing material of the world to know what is going on in Hong Kong at this critical time in history.
As a final note, I want to add that one of the things I’ve heard lately, is that China may be starting to crack down on the practice of martial arts.
This truly is history repeating itself. This happened during the period of conflict between the Ming and Qing dynasty.
It happened again during the cultural revolution.
And now it’s happening once again.
Why does China always clamp down on martial artists?
Because martial artists, as part of their training, learn how important it is to stand up and fight when it’s necessary. The core of traditional martial arts is about values that respect all people and offer protection to those who need it.
I like to think that with my camera I’m bringing the spirit of kung fu, of the Ving Tsun I love, to my practice using my camera to help protect and defend those in Hong Kong.
I hope that you’ll join me in this fight.
Let me know what questions you may have.
Happy to try my best to answer.
May all be safe, happy, strong and at ease. ❤️

Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
A memo circulated earlier this year claimed that technology executive Alice Huang was recruited by China’s Ministry of State Security to spy on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, according to multiple media reports.
The New York Times, which had previously said Nvidia’s chief executive had been the target of Chinese intelligence, was the first to report on the memo, which was reportedly based on U.S. intelligence. The Financial Times subsequently reported that the memo also claimed Jensen Huang had a romantic relationship with Alice Huang, an executive at a Singapore-based company called Megaspeed.
An Nvidia spokesperson told the NYT that Jensen Huang’s interactions with Alice Huang were “not unusual,” and that the company does not share classified information with its customers.
A separate NYT report examined New Matrix, a Chinese company authorized by the U.S. Commerce Department to buy advanced Nvidia chips. But at the office address listed by New Matrix, reporters only found “a hollow gray shell,” raising concerns that it could be a front for a blacklisted private equity firm.
The Nvidia spokesperson said the company sells “the first, best and most of our technology in America.”

content:
Fundraiser by Hong Kong Forum : 自由雕塑公園之『香港地』香港抗爭者雕像金屬牌匾 及 新壁畫
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
Hong Kong Forum is organizing this fundraiser to benefit Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles.
Hong Kong Forum for Hong Kong Forum Los Angeles
5年過去了，彷彿一切烽煙已經在時間中沈沒，然而有些人仍然選擇不去遺忘。
Five years have passed since Hong Konger's last attempt to maintain their freedom, and it seems that all dust has settled. However, some people still choose not to forget.
經過多方努力，我們在Yermo的自由雕塑公園（Liberty Sculpture Park）建立起了香港地，用藝術去銘記香港人的意志不滅。
After many efforts, we have established Hong Kong Corner in the Liberty Sculpture Park in Yermo, using art to remember the unyielding will of the Hong Kongers.
香港地的維護和創作需要長期的投入，我們亟需你的支持。不論捐款多少，都代表著你對香港所出的一分力。
The maintenance and creation of Yermo's "Hong Kong Corner" requires long-term investment, and we urgently need your support. Any donation, no matter the amount, represents your contribution to the undying spirit of Hong Kongers.
We hope to meet in a free Hong Kong someday.
Donation serves 3 main purposes.
1. 現時香港地有四件展品，沙漠氣候極端，冬寒夏焰，烈日風沙，我們要定期維修，提供防曬材料予連儂牆， 令他們可以日久維新。
1. Currently, Hong Kong Corner has four exhibits. We need to perform regular maintenance for some of the art works and provide sun & water protection sealants in the harsh desert weather condition.
2. 香港抗爭者的雕像現時沒有任何解釋。 在我們維修的過程當中，經常見到美國本地人到訪，但他們對於2019抗爭一事並不了清楚。希望可以籌款建立一塊金屬牌匾， 刻上中英文描述，令到到訪者了解究竟發生了什麼事。
2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened.
3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。
3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.

zh_title: 美国寻求扣押在伊朗航行后扣押的中国注册湾流G550
summary: 美国司法部已要求加州联邦法官允许政府保留联邦特工于 2026 年 5 月在阿拉斯加扣押的一架在中国注册的湾流 G550。检察官表示，这架美国制造的公务机未经美国授权从北京飞往德黑兰，并在伊朗停留了六天。 10 月 28 日的民事没收起诉书显示，这架飞机为 2012 款湾流 G550，注册号为 B-8259，注册人为金鹿公务航空（北京）有限公司。根据备案文件，这架飞机于 2024 年 12 月 13 日飞往德黑兰，并一直停留在那里，直到 2024 年 12 月 13 日返回北京。
content:
美国司法部已要求加州联邦法官允许政府保留联邦特工于 2026 年 5 月在阿拉斯加扣押的一架在中国注册的湾流 G550。检察官表示，这架美国制造的公务机未经美国授权从北京飞往德黑兰，并在伊朗停留了六天。 10 月 28 日的民事没收起诉书显示，这架飞机是 2012 款湾流 G550，注册号 B-8259，注册人为金鹿公务航空（北京）有限公司。根据备案文件，这架飞机于 2024 年 12 月 13 日飞往德黑兰，并在那里停留，直到 12 月 19 日返回北京。湾流在德黑兰停留的六天是政府案件的核心。当时，美国财政部的通用许可证允许某些在外国注册的民用飞机访问伊朗长达 72 小时，前提是它们满足许可证的其他条件。检察官声称，财政部外国资产控制办公室从未批准 B-8259 延长停留时间。他们还辩称，这次飞行本身需要美国的批准。从技术上讲，由于湾流飞机是在美国制造的，根据美国出口管制法，将其从中国空运到伊朗算作再出口。诉状称，商务部工业安全局从未为此次旅行颁发许可证。 2026 年 5 月 24 日，联邦特工根据搜查令扣押了湾流飞机，当时该飞机从德黑兰返回安克雷奇已经一年多了。
当检察官立案时，这架飞机已被联邦调查局在弗吉尼亚州扣押。司法部要求法院在法官决定谁拥有这架飞机之前，为任何拥有这架飞机的人提供对没收提出异议的机会。如果法院批准没收，美国政府可以出售湾流或保留其供官方使用。司法部的投诉没有说明打算如何处理这架飞机。 AeroTime 率先报道伊朗之旅后，美国寻求扣押在中国注册的湾流 G550 飞机。

【原文 English Original】
The US Justice Department has asked a federal judge in California to allow the government to keep a Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 seized by federal agents in Alaska in May 2026. Prosecutors say that the US-built business jet flew from Beijing to Tehran without the required US authorization and spent six days in Iran. The October 28 civil forfeiture complaint identifies the aircraft as a 2012 Gulfstream G550, registration B-8259, registered to Deer Jet (Beijing) Co., Ltd. According to the filing, the jet flew to Tehran on December 13, 2024, and stayed there until it returned to Beijing on December 19. The six days the Gulfstream spent in Tehran are central to the government’s case. At the time, a US Treasury Department general license allowed certain foreign-registered civil aircraft to visit Iran for up to 72 hours, provided that they met the other conditions of the license. Prosecutors claim that the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control never approved a longer stay for B-8259. They also argue that the flight itself required US approval. Technically, because the Gulfstream was built in the United States, flying it from China to Iran counted as a reexport under US export control laws. The Commerce Department’s Bureau of Industry and Security never issued a license for the trip, according to the complaint. Federal agents seized the Gulfstream under a warrant when it landed in Anchorage on May 24, 2026, more than a year after it returned from Tehran. By the time prosecutors filed the case, the jet was in FBI custody in Virginia. The Justice Department asked the court to give anyone with a claim to the aircraft an opportunity to contest the forfeiture before the judge decides who gets to keep it. If the court grants forfeiture, the US government could sell the Gulfstream or keep it for official use. The Justice Department’s complaint does not state what it intends to do with the jet. The post US seeks to keep Chinese-registered Gulfstream G550 seized after trip to Iran appeared first on AeroTime .

title: Inside ARTEX: AI Hacking Tools, Exposed Servers and South Korean Bank Breaches
zh_title: ARTEX 内部：人工智能黑客工具、暴露的服务器和韩国银行漏洞
summary: Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 10 月 7 日报道和 Genians 安全中心
content:
Hunt.io 追踪了影响七家韩国金融机构的 ARTEX 服务器和人工智能黑客工具。 2026 年 9 月底至 10 月初期间，七家韩国金融机构的数据通过面向互联网的系统遭到泄露。约 66,000 至 67,000 人以及约 2,200 家企业受到影响，个人、就业、收入和贷款数据被曝光。 Hunt.io 深入研究了该活动背后的基础设施，其发现为 CrowdStrike 和 Genians 已经发布的内容增添了很多内容。 CrowdStrike 于 10 月 7 日报道，Genians 安全中心于 10 月 12 日报道，均指向 ARTEX，这是一个在中国开发并获得 AGPL-3.0 许可的开源自主渗透测试框架。 CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该组织是由一个受金钱驱动的讲中文的个人操控的，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。 DeepSeek v4.1 Flash 是主要模型，GLM 5.3 和 Grok 4.6 作为备份，部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 实现。公共指标是位于 38.244.50[.]120 的服务器，该服务器托管 ARTEX 控制台，以及一个香港地址和 9 个代理。 Genians 表示，ARTEX GitHub 存储库和 Docker 镜像已于 10 月 11 日删除，但分支和镜像仍然存在。 “CrowdStrike 的评估有一定的把握，认为该操作者是一个讲中文的个人，其动机是经济利益，而不是一个既定的威胁组织。” Hunt.io 发布的报告中写道。
“据报道，基础设施部分通过经销商域 xcai[.]pro 访问这些服务。两份报告都描述了双服务器配置，包括用作主要基础设施的香港 IP 地址和托管 ARTEX 控制台的 38.244.50[.]120 。” Hunt.io 在发布前通知了相关国家 CERT，并表示该报告没有任何个人记录或凭证。该公司自己的扫描显示 38.244.50[.]120 位于洛杉矶 Cogent 的网络上，有 15 个开放端口。 ARTEX 登录页面的中文标题是“自主渗透测试控制台”，出现在端口 443 和 8090 上。其他服务包括 Gemini2API 管理控制台和 Tinyproxy 服务器。 Hunt.io 在其 AttackCapture 平台上搜索该地址时，发现了另一个开放目录：23.248.226[.]250，这是位于香港 AS138415 上的跳转服务器。它在 2 个子目录中包含 42 个文件，总共 105 MB，该平台已于 9 月 5 日、9 月 26 日和 10 月 5 日记录了警告。其中的一个文件将 38.244.50[.]120 命名为跳转主机，其注释告诉操作员切勿将凭据粘贴到会话中。它位于一个开放的目录中。三个脚本支持链接。他们保持反向 SSH 隧道处于活动状态，运行本地中继，并将文件复制到跳转主机，其中一条隧道名为 grok2api，凭证文件还保存智普 AI 的 GLM 模型、兼容 OpenAI 的中继和代理服务的密钥。
这解释了多个语言模型如何在一次活动中运行。人工智能设置是最引人注目的部分。状态文件显示该工具是 Claude Code 本身，版本 2.1.221，自 8 月 4 日以来启动了 510 次，但它没有与 Anthropic 对话。一个小型代理 ds-models-shim.py 通过伪造模型列表并向 DeepSeek 发送请求来修复兼容性问题，另一个代理 xcai-effort-shim.py 添加推理设置，因为 DeepSeek 后端会跳过其推理步骤。该路线从 Claude Code 出发，通过 Claude Code Router（一个开源软件）

【原文 English Original】
Hunt.io traced ARTEX servers and AI-powered hacking tools used in breaches affecting seven South Korean financial institutions. Between late September and early October 2026, seven South Korean financial institutions had data breached through internet-facing systems. About 66,000 to 67,000 people and around 2,200 corporations were affected, and personal, employment, income and loan data was exposed. Hunt.io dug into the infrastructure behind the campaign , and its findings add a lot to what CrowdStrike and Genians already published. CrowdStrike reported on October 7 and Genians Security Center on October 12 , and both pointed to ARTEX , an open-source autonomous penetration testing framework developed in China and licensed under AGPL-3.0. CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by money ran it, and not an established threat group. DeepSeek v4.1 Flash was the main model, with GLM 5.3 and Grok 4.6 as backups, reached partly through a reseller domain, xcai[.]pro. The public indicators were a server at 38.244.50[.]120, which hosted the ARTEX console, plus a Hong Kong address and nine proxies. Genians said the ARTEX GitHub repository and Docker image were removed on October 11, though forks and mirrors remain. “CrowdStrike assessed with moderate confidence that the operator was a single Chinese-speaking individual motivated by financial gain rather than an established threat group.” reads the report published by Hunt.io. “The infrastructure reportedly accessed these services in part through the reseller domain xcai[.]pro . Both reports described a two-server configuration, consisting of a Hong Kong-based IP address used as primary infrastructure and 38.244.50[.]120 , which hosted the ARTEX console.” Hunt.io notified the relevant national CERT before publishing, and says the report holds no personal records or credentials. The company’s own scanning showed 38.244.50[.]120 sits on Cogent’s network in Los Angeles, with 15 open ports. The ARTEX login page, with a Chinese title meaning “autonomous penetration testing console”, appears on ports 443 and 8090. Other services include a Gemini2API admin console and a Tinyproxy server. Searching its AttackCapture platform for that address, Hunt.io found another open directory at 23.248.226[.]250, a jump server in Hong Kong on AS138415. It held 42 files in 2 subdirectories, 105 MB in all, and the platform had logged warnings on September 5, September 26 and October 5. A file in it names 38.244.50[.]120 as the jump host, and its own comment tells the operator never to paste the credentials into a session. It sat in an open directory. Three scripts back up the link. They keep reverse SSH tunnels alive, run a local relay, and copy files to the jump host, one tunnel is named grok2api, and the credentials file also holds keys for Zhipu AI’s GLM models, an OpenAI-compatible relay and a proxy service. That explains how several language models ran in one campaign. The AI setup is the most striking part. A state file shows the harness is Claude Code itself, version 2.1.221, started 510 times since August 4, but it isn’t talking to Anthropic. A small proxy, ds-models-shim.py, fixes a compatibility problem by faking a model list and sending requests to DeepSeek, and another, xcai-effort-shim.py, adds a reasoning setting because the DeepSeek backend otherwise skips its reasoning step. The route runs from Claude Code through Claude Code Router, an open-source project, to xcai and then to DeepSeek. “A small local proxy, ds-models-shim.py , addresses a compatibility issue: the official /v1/models endpoint returns a 404 response when queried against a non-Anthropic backend, preventing Claude Code from discovering the available models. The shim intercepts that specific request and returns a locally defined model list containing deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-flash . All other requests are forwarded to api.deepseek.com/anthropic.” states the report. The same file counts 19 custom skills, reusable instruction sets for the agent, with 147 recorded uses. They cover code audit, reconnaissance, web injection, WAF bypass testing, authentication testing, Telegram Mini Apps, APK download and decompiling, cloud phone control and payment logic testing. Next to the payment skill sat three self-registered test accounts with tokens for a cash-in deposit API, dated September 12, and a comment calls them an authorized, self-built test. The setup fits testing for insecure direct object reference flaws, a technique CrowdStrike and Genians described against Korean loan and inquiry services. The directory also held supporting tools. A script queried FOFA, a Chinese asset search engine like Shodan, through a third-party API, and a comment says the primary membership had expired and a backup key was in use. Proxy scripts enumerated a rotating proxy service at 154.201.79[.]246:443, where 79 unique exit IPs showed up among the first 100 identities tested. A separate directory at 23.248.226[.]250:8001 held a small staged setup for JNDI and LDAP exploitation, retrieved on October 5 at 03:42 UTC. It confirms command execution through a DNS callback, and one script lets web and LDAP traffic share a single port. Hunt.io’s analysis describes the tooling without publishing steps to reproduce it. Other recovered files include tools aimed at a cryptocurrency exchange’s admin session and withdrawals, Linux privilege escalation exploits, iOS probe source code and Android kernel and firmware utilities. Hunt.io says their connection to the Korean breaches isn’t confirmed. Hunt.io then showed how to hunt ARTEX servers. Searching for an ARTEX certificate issuer returned 19 IP addresses, and searching its malware classification returned 1,303 addresses across 30 countries, led by the United States, China and Hong Kong. Those figures show where addresses are registered, not where the operator sits. “The result returned 19 distinct IP addresses, including 38.244.50[.]120. This method is precise but limited to hosts that expose a matching certificate. Systems using a different certificate will not appear in these results.” continues the report. Matching the console’s page title returned about 1,300 IPs, and a looser search found 21 title strings, 19 of them likely ARTEX consoles, in English, Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Portuguese and Vietnamese. A malware-name search in AttackCapture gave 280 results with open directories. One at 130.94.31[.]86:18888 in Seoul held two small scripts, and another at 156.251.11[.]39 held an SMB reconnaissance toolkit whose test script writes a file named artex_probe_11876.txt. More hosts held exploitation kits for DedeCMS and FangCMS, a CAPTCHA bypass suite, a RuoYi and Spring administrative console exploit and CAPTCHA-based login automation. Together they show the framework attracting many operators. For defenders, the advice is plain. Remove public access and put administration behind VPNs or allowlists, and reset SSH passwords and rotate API keys, proxy credentials and tokens that exposed files may have revealed. Patch internet-facing services, watch for unexpected LDAP and JNDI activity, DNS callbacks and remote script downloads, and store secrets in a managed vault with least-privilege permissions. Also restrict access to model gateways, watch their requests, and enforce compliance rules on managed phones. Hunt.io’s lesson is that an investigation shouldn’t stop at the first list of indicators, because The company also published indicators of compromise in its analysis. “The findings highlight risks associated with exposed administrative services, reusable credentials, remote access tunnels, proxy infrastructure, and exploitation tooling.” concludes the report. Follow me on Twitter:  @securityaffairs  and  Facebook  and  Mastodon Pierluigi Paganini ( SecurityAffairs – hacking, ARTEX)

title: Taiwan to close representative office in Papua New Guinea, withdraw staff
zh_title: 台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并撤回人员
summary: 台湾将关闭在巴布亚新几内亚的代表处，撤回人员 - 聚焦台湾 台湾将关闭在巴布亚新几内亚的代表处，撤回人员 要启动文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。中新网台北11月6日电 外交​​部周五表示，应巴布亚新几内亚政府再次要求关闭该代表处，台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，并撤回所有驻扎人员。外交部在一份声明中表示，这一决定是考虑到台湾的国家利益而做出的。

台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处并撤回人员
要激活文字转语音服务，请首先同意以下隐私政策。
中新网台北11月6日电 外交​​部周五表示，应巴布亚新几内亚政府再次要求关闭该代表处，台湾将关闭驻巴布亚新几内亚代表处，并撤回所有驻扎人员。
外交部在一份声明中表示，在巴布亚新几内亚最近重申要求台湾人员在规定期限内离境后，外交部在一份声明中表示，这一决定是考虑到台湾的国家尊严、外交自主权和整体利益而做出的。
巴布亚新几内亚7月份单方面宣布将关闭台湾代表处，促使台湾暂停从这个太平洋国家现货市场购买液化天然气（LNG）。
外交部表示，巴布亚新几内亚的行为严重破坏了多年合作建立的互信。它还指责中国利用政治压力和经济影响力干涉其他国家的外交决策并限制台湾的国际空间。
台湾国防部表示，在关闭办事处的同时，台湾将终止在巴布亚新几内亚的所有技术合作和援助计划，包括技术和医疗任务、奖学金和人员培训。
外交部表示，台湾已停止在现货市场上从巴布亚新几内亚购买液化天然气，也不会签署任何新的现货采购合同。
该部门表示，台湾原计划在2026年上半年从巴布亚新几内亚购买约50万吨现货液化天然气。
据外交部称，台湾长期以来一直是巴布亚新几内亚液化天然气出口的主要市场，其采购总量约占这个太平洋国家出口的三分之一。
能源部表示，台湾已评估国内天然气需求，调整采购计划并确保替代供应，以确保在暂停现货采购的情况下保持稳定的能源供应。
外交部重申，台湾是主权独立国家，与中华人民共和国互不隶属。
它还敦促国际社会反对中国利用政治和经济压力影响其他国家的外交决策，限制台湾的国际参与。

Taiwan to close representative office in Papua New Guinea, withdraw staff
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Taiwan will close its representative office in Papua New Guinea (PNG) and withdraw all personnel stationed there following renewed demands from the PNG government to shut down the office, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Friday.
In a statement, MOFA said the decision was made in consideration of Taiwan's national dignity, diplomatic autonomy and overall interests, after PNG recently reiterated its demand that Taiwanese personnel leave the country by a set deadline.
PNG unilaterally announced in July that it would close Taiwan's representative office, prompting Taiwan to suspend spot-market purchases of liquefied natural gas (LNG) from the Pacific nation.
MOFA said PNG's actions had seriously undermined the mutual trust built through years of cooperation. It also accused China of using political pressure and economic influence to interfere in other countries' diplomatic decisions and restrict Taiwan's international space.
Along with closing the office, Taiwan will terminate all technical cooperation and assistance programs in PNG, including technical and medical missions, scholarships and personnel training, the ministry said.
Taiwan has already stopped purchasing LNG from PNG on the spot market and will not sign any new spot purchase contracts, MOFA said.
The ministry said Taiwan had originally planned to purchase about 500,000 tonnes of spot LNG from PNG in the first half of 2026.
Taiwan has long been a major market for PNG's LNG exports, with its total purchases accounting for about one-third of the Pacific nation's exports, according to MOFA.
The ministry said Taiwan had assessed its domestic gas demand, adjusted procurement plans and secured alternative supplies to ensure a stable energy supply despite the suspension of spot purchases.
The ministry reiterated that Taiwan is a sovereign, independent country, and that it and the People's Republic of China are not subordinate to each other.
It also urged the international community to oppose China's use of political and economic pressure to influence other countries' diplomatic decisions and restrict Taiwan's international participation.

title: 众院关键委员会关切英伟达的黄仁勋与疑似中国情报人员接触，要求其赴国会作证
summary: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋于2026年10月21日星期三在德国柏林举行的公司GTC大会上发表主题演讲。 因担心国家安全，美国众议院三个重要委员会主席星期三(11月4日)联名致函英伟达执行官黄仁勋要，求其赴国会作证，以了解他与疑似中国情报人员、总部设在新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed高级主管爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang，黄小乐)的关系。 众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·J·马斯特(Brian J. Mast)、众议院中国问题特设委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moo
content:
英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋于2026年10月21日星期三在德国柏林举行的公司GTC大会上发表主题演讲。
因担心国家安全，美国众议院三个重要委员会主席星期三(11月4日)联名致函英伟达执行官黄仁勋要，求其赴国会作证，以了解他与疑似中国情报人员、总部设在新加坡的数据中心公司Megaspeed高级主管爱丽丝·黄(Alice Huang，黄小乐)的关系。
众议院外交事务委员会主席布莱恩·J·马斯特(Brian J. Mast)、众议院中国问题特设委员会主席约翰·穆勒纳尔(John Moolenaar)以及众议院常设情报特别委员会主席埃里克·A·“里克”·克劳福德(Eric A. “Rick” Crawford)在信中要求黄仁勋出席三个委员会举行的联合闭门简报会。
三位主席在信中说，简报会内容涉及“英伟达公司针对外国敌对势力间谍活动的安全协议，以及您与一位已公开报道的中华人民共和国情报人员--Megaspeed公司高管Alice Huang的互动。”
他们还说，近期报道引发了人们对中国获取敏感的美国技术和信息的重大国家安全担忧。而中国渗透和获取美国尖端技术的问题，是我们三个委员会在本届国会调查工作的核心。
10月29日，《纽约时报》发表一篇题为《黄仁勋被认为是中国间谍行动的目标》的文章，“曝光”了这名科技大佬与一个叫爱丽丝·黄的中国女子的关系。
报道说，因涉嫌向中国转运英伟达的先进人工智能芯片，这名女子此前受到调查。现在美国官员得出结论，认定该高管是一名向北京传递信息的中国情报人员。报道又说，调查人员在对阿丽斯·黄的监视中发现，她与英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋建立了密切联系。
英伟达随后表示，雇佣爱丽丝·黄的Megaspeed公司与任何地区客户并无区别，且公司此前已对该新加坡企业向中国走私芯片的指控进行了调查，得出了否定的结论。
议员们在信中说，国会必须确定美国国家安全面临的风险程度。所以，他们正式要求黄仁勋于2026年11月18日前往国会，向委员会作出简报。
此前，也有报道说，美国联邦参议员伊莉莎白·沃伦(Elizabeth Warren)要求黄仁勋及董事会赴国会作证，称黄仁勋以及英伟达董事会需要向国会作出解释。

中新社台北11月6日电 台湾乒乓球运动员陈忞鑫当地时间周四在2026年达喀尔青奥会上夺得女子单打冠军，为台湾在青奥会上夺得首枚乒乓球金牌。
17岁的陈在塞内加尔达喀尔举行的金牌争夺战中击败了新加坡选手雷明英。
在比赛中以2-1领先后，陈在第四局中表现不佳，最终输给了洛伊。
第五局陈慧娴重新掌控局面，连得三个局点之一以3-2领先。
第六局两人打成10-10平，随后陈连得两分锁定金牌。
这场胜利标志着台湾在青奥会中获得首枚乒乓球金牌，也是自2010年首次参加奥运会以来的第四枚乒乓球奖牌。
陈说决赛很艰难，但她努力保持稳定的节奏，一次专注一个点。
她还不断提醒自己，尽管感到疲惫，但仍要坚持下去。
她的教练黄圣盛表示，10号种子罗伊发球质量很高，但陈最终调整了战术，打乱了对手的节奏。
青奥会是由国际奥委会主办、面向14岁至18岁运动员举办的国际体育赛事。

TABLE TENNIS/Taiwan's Chen wins women's singles table tennis gold at Dakar Youth Olympics
To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.
Table tennis player Chen Min-hsin. Photo courtesy of Team Taiwan at the Youth Olympic Games
Taipei, Nov. 6 (CNA) Taiwanese table tennis player Chen Min-hsin (陳忞昕) won the women's singles title at the 2026 Dakar Youth Olympic Games on Thursday (local time), securing Taiwan's first-ever table tennis gold medal at the Youth Olympics.
Chen, 17, defeated Singapore's Loy Ming Ying in the gold medal match in Dakar, Senegal.
After taking a 2-1 lead in games, Chen struggled in the fourth game, which she eventually lost to Loy.
Chen regained control in the fifth game, converting one of three game points to take a 3-2 lead.
The two players were tied at 10-10 in the sixth game before Chen won the next two points to clinch the gold medal.
The victory marked Taiwan's first table tennis gold medal at the Youth Olympics and its fourth medal in the sport since making its debut at the Games in 2010.
Chen said the final was difficult, but she tried to maintain a steady pace and focus on one point at a time.
She also kept reminding herself to push through despite feeling exhausted.
Her coach, Huang Sheng-cheng (黃聖盛), said Loy, the tournament's 10th seed, delivered high-quality serves, but Chen eventually adjusted her tactics and disrupted her opponent's rhythm.
The Youth Olympic Games is an international sporting event organized by the International Olympic Committee for athletes generally aged 14 to 18.

title: AutoFlight stages world’s first formation flight with 5 unmanned eVTOLs: video
zh_title: AutoFlight 使用 5 架无人驾驶 eVTOL 进行世界首次编队飞行：视频
summary: 中国的AutoFlight公司在白莲湖飞行试验基地进行了全球首次由五架自动电动汽车起降（eVTOL）飞机组成的编队飞行。 AutoFlight 分享了 2026 年 11 月 5 日令人惊叹的首飞消息，即该活动在中国昆山举行约五天后。据 AutoFlight 称，编队飞行涉及一架 5 吨重的 V5000 和 4 架 2 吨重的 eVTOL，涉及三种飞机型号。五架无人驾驶 eVTOL（或空中出租车）垂直起飞，然后一起飞行了 45 分钟多一点，覆盖了超过 133 公里
content:
中国的AutoFlight公司在白莲湖飞行试验基地进行了全球首次由五架自动电动汽车起降（eVTOL）飞机组成的编队飞行。 AutoFlight 分享了 2026 年 11 月 5 日令人惊叹的首飞消息，即该活动在中国昆山举行约五天后。据 AutoFlight 称，编队飞行涉及一架 5 吨重的 V5000 和 4 架 2 吨重的 eVTOL，涉及三种飞机型号。五架无人驾驶 eVTOL（即空中出租车）垂直起飞，然后一起飞行了 45 分钟多一点，飞行里程超过 133 公里。 AutoFlight “协调不同尺寸和任务概况的飞机需要精确的航线规划、飞行控制、通信和安全管理，”AutoFlight 发言人表示。据 AutoFlight 称，2026 年 11 月 1 日，五架 eVTOL 在强风中再次成功完成编队飞行。该公司表示：“在 2026 年 5 月进行的三机编队演示的基础上，这一最新成果标志着在协调多种 eVTOL 型号和重量级别方面取得了进一步进展。”
“它还展示了 AutoFlight 在自主多机运营方面不断增强的能力，为未来连接长途、支线和最后一英里航线的低空运输网络奠定了技术基础。”  参加编队飞行的机型包括AutoFlight的V2000CG CarryAll（专为现代航空物流设计的无人驾驶货运电动垂直起降飞机）和消防改型V2000CGF。参加此次编队飞行的还有该公司的V5000 Maxtrix，它被称为“世界上第一架也是最大的五吨级电动垂直起降飞机”。 V2000CG是第一款获得中国民航总局（CAAC）全部三项适航证书的吨级电动垂直起降飞机。这包括型号证书 (TC)、生产证书 (PC) 和适航证书 (AC)。 AutoFlight eVTOL 飞机如何飞行 AutoFlight 采用“升力和巡航”配置，飞机从垂直升力过渡到水平运动。 AutoFlight eVTOL 像直升机一样垂直起飞，使用专用升力旋翼升空。一旦到达一定高度，后螺旋桨就会推动飞机前进，这样固定翼就可以接管飞行，使垂直旋翼完全关闭，从而实现像飞机一样的高效巡航。相关 AutoFlight 推出 Matrix：世界上第一架 5 吨级 eVTOL，最多可容纳 10 名乘客 AutoFlight 上演了世界上首次由 5 架无人驾驶 eVTOL 组成的编队飞行：视频首先出现在 AeroTime 上。

【原文 English Original】
China’s AutoFlight has staged the world’s first formation flight involving five autonomous electric vehicle takeoff and landing (eVTOL) aircraft at the developer’s Bailian Lake Flight Test Base.   AutoFlight shared news of the stunning first flight on November 5, 2026, around five days after the event was held in Kunshan, China.  According to AutoFlight, the formation flight involved a single five-ton V5000 and four two-ton eVTOLs, across three aircraft variants.   The five unmanned eVTOLs, or air taxis, took off vertically before flying together for just over 45 minutes, covering more than 133 kilometers. AutoFlight “Coordinating aircraft of different sizes and mission profiles requires precise route planning, flight control, communication, and safety management,” a spokesperson for AutoFlight said.   On November 1, 2026, the five eVTOLs completed another successful formation flight despite navigating strong winds, according to AutoFlight. “Building on its three-aircraft formation demonstration in May 2026, this latest achievement marks further progress in coordinating multiple eVTOL models and weight classes,” the company said. “It also demonstrates AutoFlight’s growing capabilities in autonomous multi-aircraft operations, laying the technical foundation for future low-altitude transport networks connecting long-haul, regional, and last-mile routes.”  The aircraft models featured in the formation flight included AutoFlight’s V2000CG CarryAll, an unmanned cargo eVTOL designed for modern aerial logistics, and the firefighting variant V2000CGF. Also participating was the company’s V5000 Maxtrix, which is described as the “world’s first and largest five-ton eVTOL” . The V2000CG is the first ton-class eVTOL to receive all three airworthiness certificates from the Civil Aviation Administration of China (CAAC). This includes Type Certificate (TC), Production Certificate (PC), and Airworthiness Certificate (AC). How AutoFlight eVTOL aircraft fly AutoFlight adopts a ‘Lift & Cruise’ configuration where the aircraft transitions from vertical lift to horizontal motion.  The AutoFlight eVTOL takes off vertically like a helicopter using dedicated lift rotors to get airborne.  Once at altitude, rear propellers push the aircraft forward so its fixed wings can take over the flying, allowing the vertical rotors to shut off completely for efficient, airplane-like cruising.  RELATED AutoFlight unveils Matrix: world’s first five-ton eVTOL for up to 10 passengers The post AutoFlight stages world’s first formation flight with 5 unmanned eVTOLs: video appeared first on AeroTime .

（中央社耶路撒冷7日綜合外電報導）在以色列上月舉行國會大選後，總統赫佐格今天宣布，將優先授權總理尼坦雅胡的政敵艾森科特籌組新政府。在尼坦雅胡的對手眼中，這是讓這位在以色列在任最久的總理下台的第一步。
法新社報導，政壇新秀艾森科特（Gadi Eisenkot）曾任以色列參謀總長，他一直試圖爭取世俗派與自由派民眾支持。
他領導的反對派陣營已為與極度正統派猶太人結盟敞開大門，他們若形成這一度看似不可能的聯盟，有望讓反對派取得足夠席次組成聯合政府。
艾森科特在社群平台X發文回應：「現在是籌組全國緊急政府的時候了。我將竭盡所能，確保我們不負所託。」
赫佐格（Isaac Herzog）表示，本週與所有政黨協商後，他將給予艾森科特在選後優先籌組政府的機會。
以色列因尼坦雅胡（Benjamin Netanyahu）的強硬右派統治而嚴重分化，也因長達3年的戰爭而疲憊不堪，這次選舉雙方陣營均未取得國會過半席次。
赫佐格辦公室宣布，正式授權儀式將於明天在耶路撒冷的總統官邸舉行。（編譯：洪培英）1151108
